TQ-1 — Cyclic Capacity & Treated Water Quality

The AKRO datasheet for the BlueSoft BS-D2/RV series lists for the
BS3200D2/RV model: resin volume 2 × 800 L and cyclic capacity 2 × 3,200 m³×°dH, with a salt consumption range of 80–192 kg per regeneration per column and flow rate 32–40 m³/h.

Please confirm and provide:

Confirm that the cyclic capacity of 2 × 3,200 m³×°dH stated in the datasheet applies to the exact unit offered under quotation S02146 (800 L resin per column).

Based on the data sheet of the producer, and the canature resin used inside the vessels, yes this is
the theoretical and lab tested capacity.

However based on our experience, considering the brute water has also different metallic ions in smaller
or greater concentrations [ like iron, manganese, aluminium and so on] –a cationic resin will be able to retain this ions as well, reducing punctual hardness exchange capacity. We normally do sizing calculations with a exchange capacity of around 3.2-3.3 m3
x 0dH / each L of resin.

Provide the performance calculation for the following evaluation basis: softened water flow rate Q = 30 m³/h; raw water hardness = 12.5 °Fr — please state the equivalent hardness in °dH
used in your calculation; one column in service at a time (duplex alternating).

I will do the calculation with the tested physical ion exchange capacity of 3.3
0dH x m3 / L of resin. So we have 800L x 3.30dh = 26400dh x m3 / each tank.

Inlet water hardness is 12.50dF – this means it is roughly 70dH.

In this conditions, each column will regenerate after 2640 / 7 = around 375m3 of treated water
.

State the calculated regeneration interval (hours) at the above conditions.

The system will work volumetric – this means it will regenerate each 375m3 of treated water.

If you have a constant 30m3/h flow – this means the regeneration will start each +-12.5 H

Confirm, as a contractual performance guarantee, that treated water hardness at the outlet will be ≤ 0.5 °Fr throughout the full service cycle — not only at the start of the cycle.

We will need to wait for the producer official response, but normally for the capacity presented above,
we can guarantee.

However, because I see this is a very sensitive aspect, I suggest you to also install an on-line softener
sensor/monitor to continuously check the water hardness on the outlet of the softener.[in this way you can assure all the parts work properly]. A Sycon 2800 or Testomat panel is around 5-6000 euro

Confirm the minimum number of regeneration cycles achievable with one full brine tank loading (project requires ≥ 10 cycles).

Again this is very hard to assure, because both the draw of the brine and filling is done through venturi
injector. So depending of the inlet pressure fluctuation the system will bring more or less water in the brine tank.

If we discuss of ideal conditions than:

The ideal pure salt needed for regeneration of 1L of resin is around 120g/L of resin.

Considering the system has 800 L of resin, than we estimate a salt consumption of around 96kg of salt/ regeneration.

The brine tanks offered have a total capacity of 1500L

To dilute 96 kg of salt – you need around 280 L of water [ at a temperature of 200C]

To sum up, we have 10 x 96 kg /1.25[ salt density] + 280-300L of water for dissolving the salt needed for 1 regeneration = +-1070 L of media - so will
fit in a 1500L brine tank .

If this is the total available height of the room, than this is enough for installing the system . We will need around 3.5m for a easy fill of the unit with media.

TQ-5 — DCS Signals & Controller Integration

Your e-mail of 21 April states: "The system is able to send a signal through 2 dry contacts – that can be set only during the regeneration time."

The project specification (FT It-10.1 §1) requires the following signals to be exchanged with the plant central DCS:

Start/Stop command — binary input from DCS to the softening unit.

Unit status Running — binary output from unit to DCS.

Unit status Stopped — binary output from unit to DCS.

Unit status Regenerating — binary output from unit to DCS.

Based on your e-mail, we understand the 2 available dry contacts are active only during regeneration and are designed for triggering an external pump or valve — not for general status reporting or remote start/stop command.
Please clarify:

Can the 2 dry contacts be configured to report any of the four DCS signals listed above? Please describe exactly what each contact can be set to signal.

Is a remote Start/Stop input from DCS to the unit possible with the standard RX-D2/RV controller?

Does the electronic controller feature an electronic display as required by the specification?

If the standard controller cannot provide the required DCS signals: can AKRO offer an alternative control panel or PLC upgrade? If yes, please provide specifications and the additional
cost.

I will need to wait the producer automation manual to present to you and see what signals you can use
. the dry contacts can deliver signal only during backwash steps.

Anyway, I want to assure you that this unit, or any other softener unit, cannot provide the signals
you are asking without an external automation.

For example - Start/Stop – A softener unit never STOPS! this happens only when you
close the water circuit, but the softener’s automation does not stopping the water flow.

So this control that you are asking, can be done but only with an external automation
which is not included

TQ-6 — Upstream Filter: 50 Micron Requirement

Your e-mail confirms that a 50 micron solution would require
3× FTA 180/E 2" in parallel + FTA-DP controller, at approximately 3,200 € without VAT, in lieu of the offered SUFV 3" at 100 microns.

The project specification (FT It-10.1 §1) explicitly requires a self-cleaning filter with a stainless steel mesh rated at 50 microns. This is a stated technical requirement. Acceptance of a 100 micron filter instead of
the specified 50 microns can only be considered subject to formal written approval by the project designer.

Please confirm and provide:

Is the mesh of the offered SUFV 3" filter constructed from stainless steel as required by the specification?

Yes, but the filtration efficiency is 100 microns.

Please formally include the 3× FTA 180/E 2" parallel filter configuration as a separate alternative line item in your revised offer, with full technical specifications, dimensional data,
and the exact price delta versus the standard SUFV 3".

We do not recommend this solution . We gave it as alternative because you asked specifically for a NOBEL
softener and most likely you have consider also their filters in the project. But installing 3 filters in parallel we cannot assure a perfect divide of the water flow through the 3 elements, so in time there might appear operating problems.

For the parallel FTA filter configuration: confirm that water flow to the softener is uninterrupted during automatic backwash of any individual filter element.

As I mentioned we do not recommend this solution. But if the designer included this type of filters in the project than he might answer you .

However, your request is not clear. So you ask for a automated self cleaning filter [ which will clean by itself every time the DP is reached] but it must deliver clean water 24h/day. Of course this is impossible
– it is normal that during its cleaning procedure, the filter will not supply filtered water. Anyhow – the total cleaning time for a SUFV is less than a minute. If you still want this filtering stage to assure you non stop filtered water, than you need to
mount a secondary SUF in parallel [1 A+1STBy] – the second unit + installing materials are not included in the offer.

TQ-7 — Materials in Contact with Potable Water

The softening station treats potable water (apă potabilă) for preparation of hot make-up water in the district heating circuit. Please confirm:

Now this is not clear at all. So the treated water will be used as make-up water in the closed heating circuit. Why does the system
needs potable certificates ? will this closed circuit water be drank ? Please clarify in each point this water will be used as drinking water.

All materials in contact with the water — including resin, internal vessel lining, valves, seals, gaskets and brine tank components — are suitable for potable water application.

We can give you certificates only for:

Internal paint of the filter sufv – WRAS certif

Hygienic certificate for the CANATURE pressure vessels

Hygienic certificate for the resin

Hygienic certificate for the support gravel

Provide relevant certificates or declarations confirming potable water suitability (e.g. ACS, WRAS, KTW, or equivalent European approval).

The above mentioned certificates will be delivered with the equipment

TQ-8 — Warranty: Basis of Calculation

Offer S02146 states: "Warranty: 36 months from delivery of the goods". The project specification (FT It-10.1 §4) requires
minimum 36 months from the date of commissioning (PIF — Punere în Funcțiune). Given that delivery and commissioning may be separated by several months, this is a material contractual difference.

Confirm whether you can agree to a warranty period of 36 months calculated from the date of commissioning (PIF).

The warranty will start from the delivery of the goods
date

Confirm: defect resolution time ≤ 5 days from notification, and spare parts availability in the post-warranty period ≤ 15 days.

We can assure a <5 days response, not a resolution time.

If different components break [ like a electric valve] – we do not keep this in stock so it must be delivered
from the supplier in order to be exchanged. Generally the delivery time is 1-2 weeks + service schedule time less than 7 days.

TQ-9 — CE Marking & Quality Documentation

The Caiet de Sarcini (§10) requires CE marking and ISO 9001 compliance for all supplied equipment. Please provide:

CE Declaration of Conformity (DoC) for the BS3200D2/RV softener and for the upstream filter (SUFV 3" or FTA alternative). If not yet available, confirm CE marking will be provided at delivery.

List of applicable standards used for design and manufacture.

Confirm ISO 9001:2015 certification of the manufacturing facility (or equivalent quality management system).

Confirm that AKRO SRL holds the required importer/distributor authorization or equivalent documentation required for placing and supplying this equipment on the Romanian/EU market, as
per the Caiet de Sarcini.

Waiting for the producer response in this direction

TQ-10 — Hydraulic Connections: Interface with Project Piping

The dimensional drawing BS-3200D2-RV confirms
Inlet DN80 flanged / Outlet DN80 flanged / Drain 2". The project process line 00GHD01-BR001 is designed with
DN100 PN16 flanged connections (carbon steel P265GH). The project drain line is DN50 PN16.

Yes this was taken into account in the mounting materials. [ mounting section from the offer] . Be aware
that we where informed the current piping is PVC-U – Dn100 . If there is other material the costs will differ.

If you do not order this installing services than – flanges/transitions will not be include

Same answer as above. Be aware that if there is a longer distance than 5 m from the softener site up to
the drainage – the mounting costs will increase

For all transition spools included in AKRO scope: specify the material, pressure rating, flange standard and confirm that bolts, nuts and gaskets are included.

I had a quick look on the documents you sent.

So based on this documents you are asking for a automatic filter with a screen of 50 microns + 1 duplex softener – dimensioned for 30m3/h considering a 6.22
0G Hardness in the brute water .

Based on my calculation you will need minimum 600 L of media on each column [ tank 36x72 ] – but the filtration velocity in this case will be around 47m/h – which is rather high for
a softener!

I suggest using for this application at least 800-850L softener [ the tank used in this case is 42x72 ] – resulting a filtration velocity of 34m/h –assuring a medium contact time, or
for a optimal filtration velocity – 48x72 tanks [ and 1000-1100L of resin on each tank] – resulting a velocity of around 26m/h.

For sure you want to integrate an industrial skid softener [ considering you also want to control the unit manually ]. I have sent you several photos with similar softeners integrated
in different projects as a reference.

Now what is unclear for me in this tender - from the technical point of view, is the following:

What will this treated water be used for? Is this for a steam boiler?

I am asking this because the treated water parameters are a little problematic to be achieved:

the pH of 9.5-1.5 , but the initial pH is around 7.8 [ I think this can be assured only through dosing of NaOH in the water
not to influence hardness ]

The iron level < 0.3μg/L
– but the initial iron level is around 10 μg/L – so the softener will most probably adsorb a small part of the iron ions [ this as
a secondary effect], but has no control on how much will be retained.

You need the Oxidability of the water to be 30
mgO2/L [ permanganate index] - [ this normally in the water treatment plants – means the water will be very contaminated with mostly organic compounds] – I think this is not correct asked .

Normally for this type of softeners the max operating pressure should not exceed 6-7bar. [ in the tender is asked for a 10bar
system]

What is the current state of this tender – you are in construction phase/ project phase ?

I saw you also need a 2d/3d model for the softener in max 2 weeks from order, this I will need to check with the producer if

I am looking forward in receiving your response!

Conform OUG.41/11.04.2022 de la 01.07.2022 este implementat Sistemul national RO E-Transport pentru monitorizarea transporturilor de bunuri cu risc fiscal ridicat precum, legume ,fructe ,bauturi alcolice ,produse minerale ,imbracaminte si incaltamainte .
In baza acestei ordonante este obligatoriu sa va declarati aceste bunuri in sitemul Ro E-Transport si sa ne furnizati codurile UIT ,aceste coduri UIT trebuie sa se regaseasca si pe documentele insotitoare ale marfurilor..
Lipsa codului " UIT " pe documentele de transport , duce la sanctionarea cu o amenda si confiscarea bunurilor pentru care nu a fost emis codul UIT.

attachments.name: myOrder_manual utilizatori_clienti_RO.pdf
attachments.text:
MY ORDER:
MANUAL DE UTILIZARE
PENTRU CLIENȚI
1. LOGAREA ÎN MY RABEN
1.1. Introduceți adresa: myraben.com
1.2. Logați-vă utilizând adresa de e-mail și parola:
1.2.1. Datele de logare sunt trimise de Raben pe e-mail. Vă rugăm să vă schimbați parola generată automat cu una
personalizată

1.3. Click în secțiunea myOrder – unde regăsiți disponibile:
1.3.1. Expedieri
1.3.2. Cotații
1.3.3. Comanda de transport
1.3.4. Adminstrare date generale
2. EXPEDIERI
2.1. Vizualizarea generală a secțiunii:

2.1.1. Expedieri curente – Tab-ul este utilizat pentru a vizualiza și a gestiona operațional toate transporturile nou
create. În mod implicit, transporturile sunt prezentate în funcție de data creării sau de orice alte criterii
suplimentare definite de utilizatori. Datele de expediere sunt prezentate până la 14 zile în urmă de la data
încărcării.

2.2. Expedieri curente – Crearea unei noi expedieri:

2.2.1. Click “+ Expediere nouă”

2.2.2.Completați detaliile adreselor:
2.2.2.1. Puteți utiliza o adresă deja existentă în baza de date
2.2.2.2. Crearea unei noi adrese

*Câmpuri obligatorii: Nume, Țara, Cod poștal, Oraș, Addresa, Persoana de contact, Telefon

2.2.3. Alegeti caracteristicile mărfurilor
2.2.3.1. Lista predefinită
*Caracteristicile vizibile depind de termenii și condițiile agreate în contract
2.2.3.2.Dacă tipul de marfă este ADR:

2.2.3.2.1. Dacă comanda conține bunuri periculoase, trebuie completate detaliile ADR
2.2.3.2.2. Dacă transportul conține mărfuri periculoase în cantitate limitată, greutatea LQ trebuie
furnizată în detalii.

Mai multe info despre ADR pot fi găsite în ADR Shipments User Manual.

2.2.4. Completați liniile de marfă
2.2.5. Activați servicii suplimentare dacă este necesar. Lista serviciilor disponibile depinde de termenii și condițiile
individuale ale contractului cu Raben. Informații detaliate pot fi găsite în Additional Services User Manual

2.2.6. Completați secțiunea informații suplimentare (unele pot fi obligatorii pentru R clienți)

2.2.7. Se completează datele și orele în cazul țn care sunt preferențiale
2.2.8. Click pe opțiunnea Salvați / Salvați și trimiteți :

2.3. Expedieri curente – pentru a economisi timp, utilizatorul poate face o nouă expediere folosind una deja existentă:
2.3.1. Întoarcere - Folosind această opțiune, puteți crea rapid returnarea mărfurilor către expeditorul comenzii
create anterior.
2.3.2. Redirecționare - Folosind această opțiune, puteți redirecționa rapid expedierea către alt loc de livrare așa
cum a fost creat anterior (altul decât locul expeditorului).

3. COTAȚII
3.1. Funcționalitate care permite trimiterea unei cereri de cotație de transport intern sau internațional către
transportator.
Informații detaliate pot fi găsite în SPOT User Manual

3.2. Dacă utilizatorul acceptă oferta primită, poate trece cu ușurință la crearea și trimiterea unei comenzi de
expediere către transportator - completarea automată a unor date din ofertă într-o nouă expediere
3.3. SPOT-ul poate fi:
3.3.1. Creat: +Ofertă nouă
3.3.2. Previzualizat cu detalii: previzualizați oferta
3.3.3. Verificată: Oferta
3.3.4. Utilizat pentru plasarea unei comenzi: Creați expedierea
3.3.5. Cerut din nou: Reofertare
3.3.6. Respinge – dacă Utilizatorul decide să nu plaseze o comandă. Trebuie selectat un cod pentru motiv din lista
implicită

4. CURRENT VERSION
Varsiunea curentă a acestui document este poblicată în platforma mtRaben. De asemenea, tot acolo regăsiți și alte
materiale necesare utilizării platformei.

Pentru disfuncționalități observate în accesarea platformei, vă rog sa le sesizați către

Mădălina Matei
madalina.matei@raben-group.com

messages.subject: Detalii statie tratare apa tehnologica cu ozon
messages.conversation_topic: Detalii statie tratare apa tehnologica cu ozon
messages.body:
Buna ziua Dl. Saramet!

Gasiti atasat oferta de pret pentru un generator de 60 grame, dublu la capacitate in comparatie cu cel care trebuie livrat in urmatoarele zile.

Pentru solutia de tratare a apei tehnologice o sa apelam la furnizorul nostru din Germania pentru a primi o recomandare tehnica.

Mai sunt cateva chestiuni tehnice de lamurit. Vezi lista de intrebari mai jos.

Am atasat o schema generala pentru a avea o baza de discutie.

Debitul maxim și debitul mediu la iesirea din bazinul de stocare apa bruta, în m³/h.

Care este consumul zilnic estimat pentru apa tehnologica?

Care este debitul maxim instantaneu către consumatori, de la cele doua bazine de apa filtrata?

Cele două bazine funcționează:

în serie, bazinul 1 alimentând bazinul 2;

alternativ;

sau independent?

Cele doua bazina cu apa filtrata se umplu direct din aceeași linie de apa bruta prin selectarea unui bazin sau vor fi două linii separate care alimenteaza cele doua bazine?

Timpul maxim în care apa poate rămâne în fiecare bazin.

Bazinele sunt închise și au conducte de aerisire controlabile?

Se acceptă un rezidual de ozon la consumator sau se doreste o valoare nedetectabilă a ozonului in apa?

Daca apa este distribuită către angajați ca apă potabilă, aceast detaliu schimbă criteriul de ozon rezidual la ieșire si implicit fluxul tehnologic. Va rog clarificati.

Astept cu interesraspunsul dvs.

From: Mihai Saramet <mihai.saramet@valvis-holding.com>
Sent: Tuesday, July 28, 2026 1:36 PM
To: aurel.caras@akro.ro
Cc: 'AKRO Romania , Alexandru Soare' <alexandru.soare@akro.ro>; 'Alexandru Soare' <sales@akro.ro>
Subject: RE: Detalii statie tratare apa tehnologica cu ozon

Stimate domn ,

In urama analizei interne , am ales petru tratarea apei tehnologice , varianta cu ozon . In consecinta vom redesena fluxul de tratare -filtrare stocare . In principiu tancurile dr stocare vor fi aceleasi , 3x150 mc , unul pt apa bruta si celelalte doua pt apa tratata filtrata .

messages.conversation_topic: Solicitare ofertă pentru înlocuirea rășinii și a crepinelor – stație de dedurizare Duplex
messages.body:
Stimate domnule Soare,

Revin către dumneavoastră cu rugămintea de a ne transmite o ofertă pentru înlocuirea rășinii schimbătoare de ioni și a crepinelor din
cadrul stației de dedurizare Duplex, echipată cu vase de rășină de 1.000 litri (un total de rasina de 2000 litri).

De această dată, aș dori să analizăm posibilitatea utilizării unui alt tip de rășină față de cea montată în prezent. Din experiența ultimilor
ani, aceasta nu reușește să atingă capacitatea de funcționare pentru care a fost proiectată instalația.

Stația a fost dimensionată pentru un ciclu de aproximativ
300 m³ de apă dedurizată înainte de regenerare. Cu rășina originală, instalată din fabrică, obțineam în mod constant aproximativ
250–260 m³ de apă dedurizată până la inițierea regenerării, ceea ce era un rezultat foarte bun.

În schimb, după înlocuirea rășinii în urmă cu aproximativ trei ani, capacitatea a scăzut semnificativ, iar în prezent nu mai reușim să
obținem decât 180–190 m³ de apă dedurizată înainte de regenerare.

Menționez că anul trecut am înlocuit complet toți robineții pneumatici ai stației, astfel încât în acest moment echipamentul funcționează
cu robineți noi, iar problema nu pare să fie cauzată de sistemul de automatizare sau de distribuția apei.

Vă rog să ne recomandați o rășină cu o capacitate de schimb ionic mai ridicată și cu performanțe mai bune decât cea utilizată în prezent,
astfel încât să ne apropiem cât mai mult de performanțele inițiale ale instalației. De asemenea, vă rog să includeți în ofertă și înlocuirea crepinelor, precum și toate materialele și manopera necesare pentru efectuarea lucrării.

Dacă apreciați că este necesară o vizită în teren înainte de întocmirea ofertei, vă stăm la dispoziție pentru a programa o întâlnire.

Aștept cu interes recomandarea și oferta dumneavoastră.

Vă mulțumesc!

Cu stimă/
Best Regards/ Mit freundlichen Grüßen

PRODUCT INFORMATION
LEWATIT® S 1567

Lewatit ® S 1567 is a food grade, strongly acidic cation exchange resin with beads of uniform size
(monodisperse) based an a styrene-divinylbenzene copolymer. Lewatit® S 1567 is manufactured without the
use of solvent.

The monodisperse beads are chemically and osmotically very stable, and they can effectively be disinfected
for the drinking water processing. The optimized kinetics lead to an increased operating capacity compared
to ion exchange resins with heterodisperse bead size distribution.

Lewatit® S 1567 is especially applicable for:

» softening in special systems with regular disinfection
» softening of drinking water

Lewatit® S 1567 is adding special features to the resin bed:

» high exchange flow rates during regeneration and loading
» a good utilization of the total capacity
» a low demand for rinse water
» homogeneous throughput of regenerants, water and solutions; therefore a homogeneous working zone
» nearly linear pressure drop gradient for the whole bed depth; therefore operation with higher bed depth is
possible

The special properties of this product can only be fully utilized if the technology and process used
correspond to the current state-of-the-art. Further advice in this matter can be obtained from Lanxess,
Business Unit Liquid Purification Technologies.

Additional Information & Regulations
Safety precautions
Strong oxidants, e.g. nitric acid, can cause violent reactions if they come into contact with ion exchange
resins.

Toxicity
The safety data sheet must be observed. It contains additional data on product description, transport,
storage, handling, safety and ecology.

Disposal
In the European Community Ion exchange resins have to be disposed, according to the European waste
nomenclature which can be accessed on the internet-site of the European Union.

Storage
It is recommended to store ion exchange resins at temperatures above the freezing point of water under
roof in dry conditions without exposure to direct sunlight. If resin should become frozen, it should not be
mechanically handled and left to thaw out gradually at ambient temperature. It must be completely thawed
before handling or use. No attempt should be made to accelerate the thawing process.

Packaging
The experience has shown that the packaging stability for reliable resin containment is limited to 24 months
under the storage conditions described above. It is therefore recommended to use the product within this
time frame; otherwise the packaging condition should be checked regularly.

Technical Data Sheet

Version 1.0 Issue date: 08. 07. 2025 Revision date: -

Brightion SFC 90

Descriptions
Brightion SFC 90 is a high purity strong acid cationic exchange resin, gel type. It is mainly designed for
the industrial water softening and demineralization, also can be used in potable water softening.
The high excellent mechanical strength and good ion exchange kinetics makes it a good general-purpose
resin in different applications, compared with other resins in market, this resin is distinguished for its long
service life. It is available in other particle size distribution ranges, and available in Na+ or H+ form.

Physical and Chemical Characteristics

Matrix Structure Polystyrene Crosslinker with DVB
Shipping form Sodium or Hydrogen
Physical Appearance Yellowish Spherical beads
Particle size (mm) 0,315 – 1,25
Moisture content (%) 45 – 50 (Sodium form)
Total Capacity (eq/l) ≥ 1,9
Bulk Density (g/l) 770 – 870
Density (g/l) 1240 – 1280
Whole beads count (%) ≥ 95

Key features and benefits
- High operating capacity
- Good kinetic performance
- Long lifetime

Recommended Operating Conditions

Maximum Operating Temperature 120 °C
Service Flow Rate (BV/h) 5 – 50
Regeneration
Regenerants NaCl HCl H2SO4
Concentration (%) 10 5–8 0,7 – 6

Precautions
Resins should be stored in sealed containers or bags where temperature was above 0℃ in dry conditions
without exposure to direct sunlight.
Do not mix ion exchange resin with strong oxidizing agents; otherwise it will cause violent reactions.
In case of eyes contact with resins, rinse eyes immediately with plenty of water, and consult a specialist.
Material and samples must be disposed according to local regulations.
Dry polymers will expand when become wetted and may cause an exothermic reaction.
Spilled materials may be slippery.

messages.subject: Clarificare responsabilitati in procesul de derulare a contractelor
messages.conversation_topic: Clarificare responsabilitati in procesul de derulare a contractelor

headers.thread-topic: Clarificare responsabilitati in procesul de derulare a contractelor

messages.body:
Salutare,

Pornind de la situatia aparuta in cadrul contractului
YDA – Targu Mures, este necesara clarificarea responsabilitatilor fiecarui departament in procesul de derulare a contractelor, astfel incat sa evitam blocajele operationale.

In acest caz, dupa incasarea integrala a contractului si sosirea echipamentelor in depozit, livrarea nu poate fi programata deoarece exista o neclaritate privind gestionarea biletului la ordin.

Contractul prevede ca biletul la ordin se preda Beneficiarului odata cu prima factura de avans si se restituie Furnizorului dupa livrarea echipamentelor.

Responsabilitatile trebuie delimitate pe acelasi principiu aplicat si celorlalte documente generate in cadrul procesului:

Sales gestioneaza partea comerciala: oferta, negocierea, confirmarea comenzii, contractul si predarea dosarului catre departamentele implicate.

Facturarea gestioneaza documentele financiare si contractuale aferente procesului de facturare: emiterea facturilor, urmarirea incasarilor, gestionarea biletelor la ordin si
a celorlalte garantii financiare, precum si recuperarea acestora atunci cand contractul prevede acest lucru.

Logistica gestioneaza livrarea si transmite documentele aferente transportului, respectiv avizul de expeditie si AWB-ul, dupa confirmarea ca toate conditiile comerciale si
financiare sunt indeplinite.

Fiecare departament transmite catre client documentele pe care le genereaza si isi asuma responsabilitatea pentru procesul pe care il gestioneaza.

In forma actuala, anumite activitati si documente nu au un responsabil clar, ceea ce conduce la interpretari diferite intre departamente si poate bloca livrarea unor comenzi, desi toate conditiile contractuale
sunt indeplinite.

Este necesara stabilirea unui flux unic de lucru, cu responsabilitati clar definite pentru fiecare departament, astfel incat astfel de situatii sa nu mai apara pe viitor.

Multumesc.

Buna ziua Dl Clivet,

Va raspund anexat cu oferta de pret [ pentru crepine+nisip+manopera de schimb], insa pentru partea de rasina avem urmatoarele propuneri din care sa alegeti:

Rasina PURE RESIN – PC003 - cost 2000L cu livrare inclusa – 6900euro fara TVA [ termen de livrare 3-4 saptamani poate mai mult in

Las anexate si fisele tehnice de la fiecare.

Astept tipul de rasina ales – pentur a actualiza oferta.

Cu respect,

From: Clivet, Razvan <Razvan.Clivet@amann.com>

Subject: Solicitare ofertă pentru înlocuirea rășinii și a crepinelor – stație de dedurizare Duplex

Stimate domnule Soare,

Revin către dumneavoastră cu rugămintea de a ne transmite o ofertă pentru înlocuirea rășinii schimbătoare de ioni și a crepinelor din cadrul stației de dedurizare
Duplex, echipată cu vase de rășină de 1.000 litri (un total de rasina de 2000 litri).

De această dată, aș dori să analizăm posibilitatea utilizării unui alt tip de rășină față de cea montată în prezent. Din experiența ultimilor ani, aceasta nu reușește
să atingă capacitatea de funcționare pentru care a fost proiectată instalația.

Stația a fost dimensionată pentru un ciclu de aproximativ
300 m³ de apă dedurizată înainte de regenerare. Cu rășina originală, instalată din fabrică, obțineam în mod constant aproximativ
250–260 m³ de apă dedurizată până la inițierea regenerării, ceea ce era un rezultat foarte bun.

În schimb, după înlocuirea rășinii în urmă cu aproximativ trei ani, capacitatea a scăzut semnificativ, iar în prezent nu mai reușim să obținem decât
180–190 m³ de apă dedurizată înainte de regenerare.

Menționez că anul trecut am înlocuit complet toți robineții pneumatici ai stației, astfel încât în acest moment echipamentul funcționează cu robineți noi, iar problema
nu pare să fie cauzată de sistemul de automatizare sau de distribuția apei.

Vă rog să ne recomandați o rășină cu o capacitate de schimb ionic mai ridicată și cu performanțe mai bune decât cea utilizată în prezent, astfel încât să ne apropiem
cât mai mult de performanțele inițiale ale instalației. De asemenea, vă rog să includeți în ofertă și înlocuirea crepinelor, precum și toate materialele și manopera necesare pentru efectuarea lucrării.

Dacă apreciați că este necesară o vizită în teren înainte de întocmirea ofertei, vă stăm la dispoziție pentru a programa o întâlnire.

Aștept cu interes recomandarea și oferta dumneavoastră.

Vă mulțumesc!

Cu stimă/
Best Regards/ Mit freundlichen Grüßen

Răzvan Cliveț

AMANN Group

Team leader

Subject: Project in aquisition state.

Hello Gokhan,

I hope this e-mail finds you well!

We are working on a project for ARTROM STEELTUBES – and we are in the acquisition state for this [ we need just to receive some water analysis to confirm the solution and
we will be ready to order]

I will explain. The Client has some problems with tetra and trichloroethylene . We should normally be able to remove this from well water with a simple chlorination and
then activated carbon filtration [ we have chose a special carbon for this application ] . We have sent a small pilot filter – to test the solution at a scale and we are waiting for the water analysis to confirm it. If everything is well, and it should, we
need to start the acquisition process in the following days.

What I need from you is a price quotation and estimated delivery time for :

3 automatic filters with valve skid – with FRP tank 48x72:

We need the skid to be built with electric actuated valves

The filters will be offered without media [ we will bring the special carbon which we already tested]

The filters must start regeneration at a
set time

The filters will be mount in parallel – all active . So we can built this with only a general PLC

The filters will backwash with water from the same source .

If possible to offer also the connection between the 3 filters [ we are looking for a general DN 80 distributor for
inlet and a DN 80 general distributor for outlet.

It will be good to have 2 extra electric actuated valves for spare parts

We have initially offered to the client this project with BS-4872 filters [ data sheet attached] – but we want to order this from AO SMITH [ to start the collaboration].

I also attached a drawing with the filter battery – just as for info!

I am looking forward in receiving your response!

If you need any other clarifications , I am at your dispose !

Best regards,

TQ-1 — Cyclic Capacity & Treated Water Quality

The AKRO datasheet for the BlueSoft BS-D2/RV series lists for the
BS3200D2/RV model: resin volume 2 × 800 L and cyclic capacity 2 × 3,200 m³×°dH, with a salt consumption range of 80–192 kg per regeneration per column and flow rate 32–40 m³/h.

Please confirm and provide:

Confirm that the cyclic capacity of 2 × 3,200 m³×°dH stated in the datasheet applies to the exact unit offered under quotation S02146 (800 L resin per column).

Based on the data sheet of the producer, and the canature resin used inside the vessels, yes this is
the theoretical and lab tested capacity.

However based on our experience, considering the brute water has also different metallic ions in smaller
or greater concentrations [ like iron, manganese, aluminium and so on] –a cationic resin will be able to retain this ions as well, reducing punctual hardness exchange capacity. We normally do sizing calculations with a exchange capacity of around 3.2-3.3 m3
x 0dH / each L of resin.

Provide the performance calculation for the following evaluation basis: softened water flow rate Q = 30 m³/h; raw water hardness = 12.5 °Fr — please state the equivalent hardness in °dH
used in your calculation; one column in service at a time (duplex alternating).

I will do the calculation with the tested physical ion exchange capacity of 3.3
0dH x m3 / L of resin. So we have 800L x 3.30dh = 26400dh x m3 / each tank.

Inlet water hardness is 12.50dF – this means it is roughly 70dH.

In this conditions, each column will regenerate after 2640 / 7 = around 375m3 of treated water
.

State the calculated regeneration interval (hours) at the above conditions.

The system will work volumetric – this means it will regenerate each 375m3 of treated water.

If you have a constant 30m3/h flow – this means the regeneration will start each +-12.5 H

Confirm, as a contractual performance guarantee, that treated water hardness at the outlet will be ≤ 0.5 °Fr throughout the full service cycle — not only at the start of the cycle.

We will need to wait for the producer official response, but normally for the capacity presented above,
we can guarantee.

However, because I see this is a very sensitive aspect, I suggest you to also install an on-line softener
sensor/monitor to continuously check the water hardness on the outlet of the softener.[in this way you can assure all the parts work properly]. A Sycon 2800 or Testomat panel is around 5-6000 euro

Confirm the minimum number of regeneration cycles achievable with one full brine tank loading (project requires ≥ 10 cycles).

Again this is very hard to assure, because both the draw of the brine and filling is done through venturi
injector. So depending of the inlet pressure fluctuation the system will bring more or less water in the brine tank.

If we discuss of ideal conditions than:

The ideal pure salt needed for regeneration of 1L of resin is around 120g/L of resin.

Considering the system has 800 L of resin, than we estimate a salt consumption of around 96kg of salt/ regeneration.

The brine tanks offered have a total capacity of 1500L

To dilute 96 kg of salt – you need around 280 L of water [ at a temperature of 200C]

To sum up, we have 10 x 96 kg /1.25[ salt density] + 280-300L of water for dissolving the salt needed for 1 regeneration = +-1070 L of media - so will
fit in a 1500L brine tank .

TQ-2 — Regeneration Consumption & Drain/Backwash Data

The datasheet indicates a salt consumption range of
80–192 kg per regeneration per column and brine tanks of 2 × 1,500 L. The following additional data is required for drainage and site piping design:

Salt consumption per regeneration at the evaluation basis of TQ-1 (kg/cycle) — please specify single value, not range.

You have the value above.
Theoretical value is 96kg/regeneration - If you can guarantee us a perfect maintained pressure/flow of the water inlet, a perfect filtered water and no scaling forming in the injector.

Otherwise consider a real salt consumption of 96-120kg/regeneration

Water consumption per regeneration (litres/cycle).

This again can be calculated only as theoretical. I can do all the math but please clarify:

What kind of water will the softener use for regeneration ? Brute water or the system needs to have
a different connection for feeding with clean water during regeneration?

If the system will use brute water to regenerate, than what will be the total available water inlet flow
? if the available flow remains is 30m3/h – than the system will adsorb around 20-30% [ depending of backwash step] – and through it to the drainage. Also this means that during regeneration the production will be reduced with 20-30% because the
other tank is using the water for regeneration. [ all clear?]

Now a system this big will consume around 10-15m3/ regeneration [ but again this can change
through local settings and physical conditions in site]

Regeneration duration (minutes).

Again this will be parametrises in site. Generally you have the following steps/duration:

Backwash – around 8-10mins

Brine absorbtion – around 30-50 mins

Rinse – around 10-15 mins

Fill – around 15 mins

Maximum drain/backwash flow rate during regeneration (m³/h or L/min).

For softener application you need to assure a 20m/h velocity for correct backwash [ this is the main
parameter that must be assured]. – the tanks of the system proposed are 42x72 – this means you need to assure a 15-17m3/h for initial backwash

Volume of water required simultaneously during the regeneration phase (litres).

I do not understand the question. If the question is how much flow you need to assure in order to have
a 30m3/h of treated water and considering the system is using brute water also for regeneration, than the answer is 45 m3/h during regeneration.

TQ-3 — Operating Pressure & Booster Pump Requirement [CRITICAL]

This is the most critical open item. Two independent sources confirm the pressure gap:

• Your e-mail of 21 April 2026: "The softener unit requires a inlet water pressure of at least 2–2.5 bar – otherwise the system will not work properly."

• AKRO datasheet BS-D2/RV: Min. operating pressure = 200 kPa (2 bar).

The project specification (FT It-10.1 §1) defines the available potable water inlet pressure as
1–1.5 bar. This is the pressure available at the softening station inlet (line 00GHD01-BR001). The confirmed pressure deficit is
0.5–1.5 bar.

Please provide formal written responses to the following:

Confirm the exact minimum inlet pressure required for the BS3200D2/RV to operate correctly and guarantee the treated water performance specified in TQ-1.

MINIMUM WATER PRESSURE MUST BE 2-2.5BAR

MAX WATER PRESSURE 6 BAR

Is a booster/pressure-raising pump upstream of the softening station required to bridge this pressure gap?

We do not know the site conditions to make recommendations.
Where does the brute water come from? If it is from municipality than yes a booster pump will help increasing the pressure for the system.

If a booster pump is required: is it included in AKRO's scope of supply under offer S02146? If not, please provide technical specifications and a budget price for a suitable booster pump
and confirm whether AKRO can supply and install it within the same contract.

It is not included and the installation will not be included in our scope

If no booster pump is offered: please confirm explicitly that the system cannot be guaranteed to operate correctly at 1–1.5 bar inlet pressure, so that this can be formally assessed by
the project designer.

The system will not operate correctly for a inlet water pressure that is not in the interval of 2-6bar

TQ-4 — Dimensions & Installation Envelope

A discrepancy has been identified between two AKRO documents provided:

• Dimensional drawing BS-3200D2-RV (AKRO Romania, January 2023): overall dimensions approx. 2,516 mm × 2,193 mm, installed height approx. 2,203 mm.
Please be aware that in the drawing attached, you do not have the overall dimensions of the softener. You do not even have the total height of it .2203mm represents the total width in this positioning.

• AKRO datasheet BlueSoft BS-D2/RV (BlueSoft 3200D2/RV row): H × L × W = 2,425 × 3,200 × 2,750 mm, operating weight 2,430 kg.

Please clarify and provide:

Confirm which set of dimensions applies to the unit offered under quotation S02146 (800 L resin per column, 2 × 1,500 L brine tanks, SUFV 3" filter or FTA alternative).

For the softener please take into account the dimensions from the BlueSoft 3200D2/RV row from the data
sheet present with the mention that the brine tanks can be freely positioned anywhere round the unit;

For the SUFV 3” – please take into account the dimensions from the data sheet link -

https://akro.ro/public/fise/238-Fisa_tehnica_Filtru_cu_autocuratare_otel_carbon.pdf

Provide the final General Arrangement drawing for the complete supplied package, including: softener tanks; valve skid; brine tanks; filter system; inlet/outlet headers; drain connections;
minimum maintenance clearances around the unit.

We cannot provide this drawings – this is design part

Minimum space required for maintenance – at least 0.5m around each unit .

Confirm the final empty weight and operating weight (kg) of the complete package as supplied.

I will give you the fully working total weight , considering the 2 brine tanks full with water + salt
for 10 regenerations in each. + filter filled with water – total weight around 6.3 T

Note: The preliminary maximum installation height is 3,900 mm. Final site coordination is subject to design verification.

If this is the total available height of the room, than this is enough for installing the system . We will need around 3.5m for a easy fill of the unit with media.

TQ-5 — DCS Signals & Controller Integration

Your e-mail of 21 April states: "The system is able to send a signal through 2 dry contacts – that can be set only during the regeneration time."

The project specification (FT It-10.1 §1) requires the following signals to be exchanged with the plant central DCS:

Start/Stop command — binary input from DCS to the softening unit.

Unit status Running — binary output from unit to DCS.

Unit status Stopped — binary output from unit to DCS.

Unit status Regenerating — binary output from unit to DCS.

Based on your e-mail, we understand the 2 available dry contacts are active only during regeneration and are designed for triggering an external pump or valve — not for general status reporting or remote start/stop command.
Please clarify:

Can the 2 dry contacts be configured to report any of the four DCS signals listed above? Please describe exactly what each contact can be set to signal.

Is a remote Start/Stop input from DCS to the unit possible with the standard RX-D2/RV controller?

Does the electronic controller feature an electronic display as required by the specification?

If the standard controller cannot provide the required DCS signals: can AKRO offer an alternative control panel or PLC upgrade? If yes, please provide specifications and the additional
cost.

I will need to wait the producer automation manual to present to you and see what signals you can use
. the dry contacts can deliver signal only during backwash steps.

Anyway, I want to assure you that this unit, or any other softener unit, cannot provide the signals
you are asking without an external automation.

For example - Start/Stop – A softener unit never STOPS! this happens only when you
close the water circuit, but the softener’s automation does not stopping the water flow.

So this control that you are asking, can be done but only with an external automation
which is not included

TQ-6 — Upstream Filter: 50 Micron Requirement

Your e-mail confirms that a 50 micron solution would require
3× FTA 180/E 2" in parallel + FTA-DP controller, at approximately 3,200 € without VAT, in lieu of the offered SUFV 3" at 100 microns.

The project specification (FT It-10.1 §1) explicitly requires a self-cleaning filter with a stainless steel mesh rated at 50 microns. This is a stated technical requirement. Acceptance of a 100 micron filter instead of
the specified 50 microns can only be considered subject to formal written approval by the project designer.

Please confirm and provide:

Is the mesh of the offered SUFV 3" filter constructed from stainless steel as required by the specification?

Yes, but the filtration efficiency is 100 microns.

Please formally include the 3× FTA 180/E 2" parallel filter configuration as a separate alternative line item in your revised offer, with full technical specifications, dimensional data,
and the exact price delta versus the standard SUFV 3".

We do not recommend this solution . We gave it as alternative because you asked specifically for a NOBEL
softener and most likely you have consider also their filters in the project. But installing 3 filters in parallel we cannot assure a perfect divide of the water flow through the 3 elements, so in time there might appear operating problems.

For the parallel FTA filter configuration: confirm that water flow to the softener is uninterrupted during automatic backwash of any individual filter element.

As I mentioned we do not recommend this solution. But if the designer included this type of filters in the project than he might answer you .

However, your request is not clear. So you ask for a automated self cleaning filter [ which will clean by itself every time the DP is reached] but it must deliver clean water 24h/day. Of course this is impossible
– it is normal that during its cleaning procedure, the filter will not supply filtered water. Anyhow – the total cleaning time for a SUFV is less than a minute. If you still want this filtering stage to assure you non stop filtered water, than you need to
mount a secondary SUF in parallel [1 A+1STBy] – the second unit + installing materials are not included in the offer.

TQ-7 — Materials in Contact with Potable Water

The softening station treats potable water (apă potabilă) for preparation of hot make-up water in the district heating circuit. Please confirm:

Now this is not clear at all. So the treated water will be used as make-up water in the closed heating circuit. Why does the system
needs potable certificates ? will this closed circuit water be drank ? Please clarify in each point this water will be used as drinking water.

All materials in contact with the water — including resin, internal vessel lining, valves, seals, gaskets and brine tank components — are suitable for potable water application.

We can give you certificates only for:

Hygienic certificate for the CANATURE pressure vessels

Hygienic certificate for the resin

Hygienic certificate for the support gravel

Provide relevant certificates or declarations confirming potable water suitability (e.g. ACS, WRAS, KTW, or equivalent European approval).

The above mentioned certificates will be delivered with the equipment

TQ-8 — Warranty: Basis of Calculation

Offer S02146 states: "Warranty: 36 months from delivery of the goods". The project specification (FT It-10.1 §4) requires
minimum 36 months from the date of commissioning (PIF — Punere în Funcțiune). Given that delivery and commissioning may be separated by several months, this is a material contractual difference.

Confirm whether you can agree to a warranty period of 36 months calculated from the date of commissioning (PIF).

The warranty will start from the delivery of the goods
date

Confirm: defect resolution time ≤ 5 days from notification, and spare parts availability in the post-warranty period ≤ 15 days.

We can assure a <5 days response, not a resolution time.

If different components break [ like a electric valve] – we do not keep this in stock so it must be delivered

TQ-9 — CE Marking & Quality Documentation

The Caiet de Sarcini (§10) requires CE marking and ISO 9001 compliance for all supplied equipment. Please provide:

CE Declaration of Conformity (DoC) for the BS3200D2/RV softener and for the upstream filter (SUFV 3" or FTA alternative). If not yet available, confirm CE marking will be provided at delivery.

Confirm that AKRO SRL holds the required importer/distributor authorization or equivalent documentation required for placing and supplying this equipment on the Romanian/EU market, as

The dimensional drawing BS-3200D2-RV confirms

I had a quick look on the documents you sent.

0G Hardness in the brute water .

Based on my calculation you will need minimum 600 L of media on each column [ tank 36x72 ] – but the filtration velocity in this case will be around 47m/h – which is rather high for
a softener!

I suggest using for this application at least 800-850L softener [ the tank used in this case is 42x72 ] – resulting a filtration velocity of 34m/h –assuring a medium contact time, or
for a optimal filtration velocity – 48x72 tanks [ and 1000-1100L of resin on each tank] – resulting a velocity of around 26m/h.

For sure you want to integrate an industrial skid softener [ considering you also want to control the unit manually ]. I have sent you several photos with similar softeners integrated
in different projects as a reference.

Now what is unclear for me in this tender - from the technical point of view, is the following:

I am asking this because the treated water parameters are a little problematic to be achieved:

the pH of 9.5-1.5 , but the initial pH is around 7.8 [ I think this can be assured only through dosing of NaOH in the water
not to influence hardness ]

The iron level < 0.3μg/L
– but the initial iron level is around 10 μg/L – so the softener will most probably adsorb a small part of the iron ions [ this as

You need the Oxidability of the water to be 30

Salut Marcel,

Am reluat discutia cu Stabilus pentru noua linie de demineralizare in care sunt incluse si niste pompe.

Datele problemei s-au schimbat putin – vor sa inlocuiasca sistemul de alimentare inclusiv la vechea linie.

La acest moment au nevoie

Cate 1 pompa pentru fiecare linie care sa satisfaca:

Un debit de 6.5-7mc/h

La un H de 60-70m

Pompele sa fie cu convertizor [ se accepta si varianta de convertizor integrat – daca nu varianta cu el in tablou] [ dar vor liniile sa fie separate [adica 2 grupuri nu doar unul comun]

Vor mai avea nevoie si de o pompa – rezerva rece

Pompele vor lucra inecat [ trag dintr-un distribuitor comun – alimentat de un bazin de 2mc]

Mai am si o problema de pierderi de presiune :

Traseul de la pompe la linia de demineralizare este de circa 70-80 m . Desi nu este diferenta de nivel, traseul de apa se va executa pe sus [ circa 5-6 m]. Teava nu s-a ales inca dar cred ca se va merge pe teava de 1.25 sau 1.5”.

Oare ma poti ajuta cu o propunere in acest sens ?

Asteptam cu interes raspunsul tau.

Cu respect,

That you can share the quality documentation

is supervision required? if so, is it included in your proposal?

Supervision is not required considering we must also commission, and mount the system.

The process will happen in the following steps:

receive order + finalizing contract + prepayment

We order to production the Unit;

When everything is ready for delivery, we will pack everything on pallets and deliver to your site – again we need the payment confirmation of second invoice;

You must receive the pallets and safely deposit them. – this is in your charge

When you have the sight ready for us to mount the system [ including piping Dn100 up to the spot where we need to connect, the building itself and space, drainage – Dn50-80 , electric tension near the final
position of the unit] , you must officially announce us and in max 2 weeks from this point we will send a service team to do the piping work and commissioning.

is a weekly liquidated damage if there is a delay in delivery time 0.5% per week acceptable?

Yes, we can accept this penalty/ week if the goods cannot be delivered in the set time. We cannot accept this penalty on the mounting and other services [
because here we are influenced by the situation from the site location].

Considering this project was initially discussed at the end of March, I also suggest of asking again the delivery time when you are in the point of ordering
the units [ this way we can be more specific].

Regarding the request with – sending the goods to Turkey and then to Romania, we do not agree with this proposal.

The offer includes delivery of the goods directly to Romania – plant location.

the theoretical and lab tested capacity.

However based on our experience, considering the brute water has also different metallic ions in smaller
or greater concentrations [ like iron, manganese, aluminium and so on] –a cationic resin will be able to retain this ions as well, reducing punctual hardness exchange capacity. We normally do sizing calculations with a exchange capacity of around 3.2-3.3 m3

Inlet water hardness is 12.50dF – this means it is roughly 70dH.

Your e-mail of 21 April states: "The system is able to send a signal through 2 dry contacts – that can be set only during the regeneration time."

The project specification (FT It-10.1 §1) requires the following signals to be exchanged with the plant central DCS:

Start/Stop command — binary input from DCS to the softening unit.

Unit status Running — binary output from unit to DCS.

Unit status Stopped — binary output from unit to DCS.

Unit status Regenerating — binary output from unit to DCS.

Based on your e-mail, we understand the 2 available dry contacts are active only during regeneration and are designed for triggering an external pump or valve — not for general status reporting or remote start/stop command.
Please clarify:

Can the 2 dry contacts be configured to report any of the four DCS signals listed above? Please describe exactly what each contact can be set to signal.

Is a remote Start/Stop input from DCS to the unit possible with the standard RX-D2/RV controller?

Does the electronic controller feature an electronic display as required by the specification?

If the standard controller cannot provide the required DCS signals: can AKRO offer an alternative control panel or PLC upgrade? If yes, please provide specifications and the additional
cost.

I will need to wait the producer automation manual to present to you and see what signals you can use
. the dry contacts can deliver signal only during backwash steps.

Anyway, I want to assure you that this unit, or any other softener unit, cannot provide the signals
you are asking without an external automation.

For example - Start/Stop – A softener unit never STOPS! this happens only when you
close the water circuit, but the softener’s automation does not stopping the water flow.

So this control that you are asking, can be done but only with an external automation
which is not included

TQ-6 — Upstream Filter: 50 Micron Requirement

Your e-mail confirms that a 50 micron solution would require
3× FTA 180/E 2" in parallel + FTA-DP controller, at approximately 3,200 € without VAT, in lieu of the offered SUFV 3" at 100 microns.

The project specification (FT It-10.1 §1) explicitly requires a self-cleaning filter with a stainless steel mesh rated at 50 microns. This is a stated technical requirement. Acceptance of a 100 micron filter instead of
the specified 50 microns can only be considered subject to formal written approval by the project designer.

Please confirm and provide:

Is the mesh of the offered SUFV 3" filter constructed from stainless steel as required by the specification?

Yes, but the filtration efficiency is 100 microns.

Please formally include the 3× FTA 180/E 2" parallel filter configuration as a separate alternative line item in your revised offer, with full technical specifications, dimensional data,
and the exact price delta versus the standard SUFV 3".

We do not recommend this solution . We gave it as alternative because you asked specifically for a NOBEL
softener and most likely you have consider also their filters in the project. But installing 3 filters in parallel we cannot assure a perfect divide of the water flow through the 3 elements, so in time there might appear operating problems.

For the parallel FTA filter configuration: confirm that water flow to the softener is uninterrupted during automatic backwash of any individual filter element.

As I mentioned we do not recommend this solution. But if the designer included this type of filters in the project than he might answer you .

However, your request is not clear. So you ask for a automated self cleaning filter [ which will clean by itself every time the DP is reached] but it must deliver clean water 24h/day. Of course this is impossible
– it is normal that during its cleaning procedure, the filter will not supply filtered water. Anyhow – the total cleaning time for a SUFV is less than a minute. If you still want this filtering stage to assure you non stop filtered water, than you need to
mount a secondary SUF in parallel [1 A+1STBy] – the second unit + installing materials are not included in the offer.

TQ-7 — Materials in Contact with Potable Water

The softening station treats potable water (apă potabilă) for preparation of hot make-up water in the district heating circuit. Please confirm:

Now this is not clear at all. So the treated water will be used as make-up water in the closed heating circuit. Why does the system
needs potable certificates ? will this closed circuit water be drank ? Please clarify in each point this water will be used as drinking water.

All materials in contact with the water — including resin, internal vessel lining, valves, seals, gaskets and brine tank components — are suitable for potable water application.

We can give you certificates only for:

Internal paint of the filter sufv – WRAS certif

Hygienic certificate for the CANATURE pressure vessels

Hygienic certificate for the resin

Hygienic certificate for the support gravel

Provide relevant certificates or declarations confirming potable water suitability (e.g. ACS, WRAS, KTW, or equivalent European approval).

The above mentioned certificates will be delivered with the equipment

TQ-8 — Warranty: Basis of Calculation

Offer S02146 states: "Warranty: 36 months from delivery of the goods". The project specification (FT It-10.1 §4) requires
minimum 36 months from the date of commissioning (PIF — Punere în Funcțiune). Given that delivery and commissioning may be separated by several months, this is a material contractual difference.

Confirm whether you can agree to a warranty period of 36 months calculated from the date of commissioning (PIF).

The warranty will start from the delivery of the goods
date

If different components break [ like a electric valve] – we do not keep this in stock so it must be delivered
from the supplier in order to be exchanged. Generally the delivery time is 1-2 weeks + service schedule time less than 7 days.

TQ-9 — CE Marking & Quality Documentation

The Caiet de Sarcini (§10) requires CE marking and ISO 9001 compliance for all supplied equipment. Please provide:

CE Declaration of Conformity (DoC) for the BS3200D2/RV softener and for the upstream filter (SUFV 3" or FTA alternative). If not yet available, confirm CE marking will be provided at

per the Caiet de Sarcini.

The dimensional drawing BS-3200D2-RV confirms

Based on my calculation you will need minimum 600 L of media on each column [ tank 36x72 ] – but the filtration velocity in this case will be around 47m/h – which is rather high for
a softener!

I suggest using for this application at least 800-850L softener [ the tank used in this case is 42x72 ] – resulting a filtration velocity of 34m/h –assuring a medium contact time, or
for a optimal filtration velocity – 48x72 tanks [ and 1000-1100L of resin on each tank] – resulting a velocity of around 26m/h.

in different projects as a reference.

Now what is unclear for me in this tender - from the technical point of view, is the following:

What will this treated water be used for? Is this for a steam boiler?

I am asking this because the treated water parameters are a little problematic to be achieved:

the pH of 9.5-1.5 , but the initial pH is around 7.8 [ I think this can be assured only through dosing of NaOH in the water
not to influence hardness ]

The iron level < 0.3μg/L
– but the initial iron level is around 10 μg/L – so the softener will most probably adsorb a small part of the iron ions [ this as
a secondary effect], but has no control on how much will be retained.

You need the Oxidability of the water to be 30
mgO2/L [ permanganate index] - [ this normally in the water treatment plants – means the water will be very contaminated with mostly organic compounds] – I think this is not correct asked .

Normally for this type of softeners the max operating pressure should not exceed 6-7bar. [ in the tender is asked for a 10bar
system]

What is the current state of this tender – you are in construction phase/ project phase ?

Salutări,
Ciprian

messages.body:
Buna, Alexandru,

Poti te rog sa imi recomanzi o solutie completa de tratare a apei pentru un client. Datele sunt urmatoarele:

susa de apa din put forat, are infiltratii- a transmis buletinul de analiza a apei

debit max 20 mc/h ( nominal 16.2 mc/h) pentru uz menajer campus (grup hotelier),

doreste o solutie completa de tratare a apei: eventual osmoza daca este cazul, filtru mecanic cu autocuratare, sistem UV cu curatare
automata a tecilor (are impuritati in apa), rezervor tampon, pompa.

Am vorbit cu clientul. Nu are alte informatii inafara de cele de mai sus si buletinul atasat. In principiu a zius ac doreste sa rezolve urmatoarele aspecte ale apei: clorurile, NH4,
fier, mangan, bacteriile prezente. Vrea sa includem si un rezervor tampon.

Daca totusi mai sunt necesare informatii, te rog sa imi spui si voi reveni catre client.

Multumesc!

Cu stima/Best regards,

Revin la discutia telefonica avuta mai devreme,

Lucrarea in discutie a fost aprobata la nivel de necesitate, in componenta de pachet propusa de dvs in oferta S02384 / 09.06.2026.

Am confirmat ca pachetul va include si urmatoarele elemente:

- livrarea statiei in stare premontata si programata la setarile comunicate de reprezentantul tehnic Airbus inainte de premontaj / livrare;

Livrarea se face cu toate setarile vanelor efectuate + instructiuni de asamblare si incarcare pe pozitie.

- certificate CE si declaratii de conformitate pentru elementele componente ale statiei;

Anexat trimitem toate certificarile disponibile pentru gama aceasta de produs

Anexate

- disponbilitatea reprezentantului dvs de a acorda asistenta telefonica (sau online) la momentul punerii in functiune, daca va fi nevoie.

Putem asigura asistenta tehnica telefonica

Suplimentar, este nevoie de:

- garantie de 24 luni - va rog specificati daca sunt conditii speciale de intretinere de respectat; - se va acorda garantie 24 de luni de la livrarea produselor

- termen de plata de 30 de zile final de luna – se accepta plata integrala la 30 de zile de la livrare

- buget achizitie - trebuie sa ne apropiem de valoarea de 9000 eur; s-a acordat suplimentar 1% discount la oferta

Va rog sa regasiti anexata oferta actualizata conform noilor conditii – in moneda RON

Pentru a demara, va trimit pentru completare:

- formularul cu datele dvs de identificare,

- acord Codul de conduita al furnizorilor

SC Recondi SRL, cunoscand prevederile art.292 Cod Penal cu privire la falsul in declaratii si prevederile legale privind vanzarea produselor si garantiile asociate acestora si
in special ale Legii nr. 449/2003 cu modificarile aduse prin OUG 174/2008 si OUG 34/2014 privind drepturile consumatorului declara pe propia raspundere ca produsele
aferente facturii cu nr. si data mentionate mai sus:

documentelor care insotesc produsul (manual de instalare si exploatare, documente tehnice etc.)
-sunt în conformitate cu “European Community and International Regulations”
-sunt in conformitate cu prevederile Directivelor Consiliului 89 / 392 in ceea ce priveste alinierea legislatiilor Statelor Membre ale CEE, referitoare la performante, utilaje,
materiale, compatibilitate electromagnetica, echipament electric.

CERTIFICAT DE GARANTIE

Va multumim pentru alegerea facuta in achizitionarea produselor comercializate de catre Recondi SRL.

Garantia acordata de RECONDI S.R.L este de:
- 12-24 luni pentru pompe;
- 12 luni pentru robineti;
- 6 luni pentru piese de schimb;
- 6-12 luni pentru alte produse;
- Garantie speciala de……………..,pentru anumite produse, conform contract/factura cu nr….….…...

Garantia se acorda in urmatoarele conditii:
-Garanţia se acorda numai in conditiile unei utilizări corecte si a respectarii de catre cumparator a instructiunilor de transport, depozitare, montaj, utilizare si a fisei tehnice
care insoteste produsul/echipamentul.
-In cazul în care se produce o defecțiune, în perioada de garanție, pentru care producatorul este responsabil, acesta poate dispune fără plată suplimentară, repararea,
înlocuirea, restituirea contravalorii produsului sau rezilierea contractului, în condițiile legii, dacă defecțiunea nu este imputabilă Utilizatorului Final.
-În cazul solicitărilor de reparaţii în perioada de garanţie, Utilizatorul Final trebuie să înainteze o reclamație scrisă (descriere detaliată a defecţiunii cu specificarea condiţiilor
în care a apărut) către RECONDI S.R.L imediat ce a constatat defectul produsului. Reclamația scrisă va fi însoțită de documentele ce atestă achiziția produsului, respectiv
factura fiscală și certificatul de garanție. RECONDI S.R.L își rezervă dreptul de a refuza să acorde service în garanție dacă nu se pot prezenta documentele de mai sus sau
dacă informațiile conținute în acestea sunt incomplete sau ilizibile.
-In perioada de garantie furnizorul va remedia fara cost: orice defect de montaj si va inlocui piese identificate cu defecte de material sau cu vicii ascunse de fabricatie, numai
cu piese noi, originale.
-Perioada de garanţie se prelungeste automat cu durata efectuării testelor şi reparaţiilor.

1. PIERDEREA GARANTIEI rezulta in urmatoarele situatii:
⦁ in conditiile nerespectarii de catre UTILIZATORUL FINAL a instructiunilor de transport, depozitare, montaj si utilizare cuprinse in documentele care
insotesc produsele
⦁ in conditiile in care UTILIZATORUL FINAL efectueaza reparatia cu o persoana/firma neautorizata
⦁ in conditii de defecte cauzate de forta majora (calamitate, inundatii, cutremur etc.)

2. OBLIGATIILE VANZATORULUI:
⦁ Sa explice modul de utilizare a produsului.
⦁ Sa completeze Declaratia de Conformitate si Certificatul de Garantie si sa le inmaneze CUMPARATORULUI, impreuna cu instructiunile de transport,
depozitare, montaj si utilizare.
⦁ Sa asigure service in garantie si postgarantie pentru produsele livrate, pe intreg timpul a duratei medii de utilizare.

3. OBLIGATIILE UTILIZATORULUI FINAL:
⦁ Sa respecte instructiunile tehnice de transport, depozitare, instalare, exploatare si de intretinere ale produsului in cauza.
⦁ Inainte de instalarea si exploatarea echipamentului sa citeasca cu atentie instructiunile de montaj si folosire/ documentatia tehnica a acestuia.
⦁ Sa monteze produsul numai cu persoane/ firme autorizate.
⦁ In cazul în care situația impune constatarea condițiilor de instalare și exploatare a produsului/ echipamentului defect, Utilizatorul Final este obligat să
permită accesul reprezentanților RECONDI S.R.L la poziția de montaj a acestuia.

4. NOTA:

Dear Nursel,

Thank you for your request!

I am responding bellow , marked with yellow to each question sent.

Could you confirm the following points?

That you can share the drawings and the 3D .step file

The Drawing attached is the only document we can provide [ BS-3200D2-RV] [ we do not have access to a Cad document for this]

Warranty period: 36 months

Yes, the warranty for this will be 36 months from the moment we deliver the unit in site

That, should we wish to conduct an inspection, you will provide the factory address and charge no fee for this

The Fabric of the softener unit is in Hungarry.

Adress :

EURO-CLEAR

9071 Gönyű,
Béke utca. 2, Magyarország, Győr-Moson-Sopron

We will need to be informed with at least 1 week before arranging the visit! – there is not visit fee , but you will need to take care of
your own transportation from airport – to fabric.

For Nobel – Milano – the filters producer, we do not have permission of visit

20% payment in advance, 60% payment before delivery of the goods, 20% payment at 15 days from commisioning, but no more than 45 days from delivery of the goods in site.

The payment method we can agree is – 40% in advance ; 40% before delivery of the goods , 20% payment at 15 days from commissioning but no more than 45 days
from delivery in site .

That you can share the quality documentation

I am attaching all the quality documentation we can provide for this Softener unit + filters from Nobel.

Estimated elivery time: ?

At this moment we have a max delivery time of 12 weeks [ considering in August both fabrics are closed for 2-3
weeks], otherwise normal delivery of the goods will be max 9-10 weeks

is supervision required? if so, is it included in your proposal?

Supervision is not required considering we must also commission, and mount the system.

The process will happen in the following steps:

receive order + finalizing contract + prepayment

We order to production the Unit;

When everything is ready for delivery, we will pack everything on pallets and deliver to your site – again we need the payment confirmation of second invoice;

You must receive the pallets and safely deposit them. – this is in your charge

When you have the sight ready for us to mount the system [ including piping Dn100 up to the spot where we need to connect, the building itself and space, drainage – Dn50-80 , electric tension near the final
position of the unit] , you must officially announce us and in max 2 weeks from this point we will send a service team to do the piping work and commissioning.

is a weekly liquidated damage if there is a delay in delivery time 0.5% per week acceptable?

Yes, we can accept this penalty/ week if the goods cannot be delivered in the set time. We cannot accept this penalty on the mounting and other services [
because here we are influenced by the situation from the site location].

Considering this project was initially discussed at the end of March, I also suggest of asking again the delivery time when you are in the point of ordering
the units [ this way we can be more specific].

Regarding the request with – sending the goods to Turkey and then to Romania, we do not agree with this proposal.

The offer includes delivery of the goods directly to Romania – plant location.

With kind regards,

Based on the data sheet of the producer, and the canature resin used inside the vessels, yes this is
the theoretical and lab tested capacity.

However based on our experience, considering the brute water has also different metallic ions in smaller
or greater concentrations [ like iron, manganese, aluminium and so on] –a cationic resin will be able to retain this ions as well, reducing punctual hardness exchange capacity. We normally do sizing calculations with a exchange capacity of around 3.2-3.3 m3
x 0dH / each L of resin.

0dH x m3 / L of resin. So we have 800L x 3.30dh = 26400dh x m3 / each tank.

Inlet water hardness is 12.50dF – this means it is roughly 70dH.

In this conditions, each column will regenerate after 2640 / 7 = around 375m3 of treated water
.

The system will work volumetric – this means it will regenerate each 375m3 of treated water.

If you have a constant 30m3/h flow – this means the regeneration will start each +-12.5 H

we can guarantee.

sensor/monitor to continuously check the water hardness on the outlet of the softener.[in this way you can assure all the parts work properly]. A Sycon 2800 or Testomat panel is around 5-6000 euro

Confirm the minimum number of regeneration cycles achievable with one full brine tank loading (project requires ≥ 10 cycles).

Again this is very hard to assure, because both the draw of the brine and filling is done through venturi
injector. So depending of the inlet pressure fluctuation the system will bring more or less water in the brine tank.

The ideal pure salt needed for regeneration of 1L of resin is around 120g/L of resin.

Considering the system has 800 L of resin, than we estimate a salt consumption of around 96kg of salt/ regeneration.

The brine tanks offered have a total capacity of 1500L

To dilute 96 kg of salt – you need around 280 L of water [ at a temperature of 200C]

To sum up, we have 10 x 96 kg /1.25[ salt density] + 280-300L of water for dissolving the salt needed for 1 regeneration = +-1070 L of media - so will
fit in a 1500L brine tank .
