Instructiuni legate de siguranta in exploatare

Manulalul se adreseaza operatorului si contine informatii generale despre operarea sigura si
intretinerea echipamentului. Manualul trebuie sa fie disponibil la locul de operare

Numai persoanele care au citit si inteles instructiunile pot folosi instalatia. In particular se vor
acorda o atentie deosebita instrustructiunilor legate de siguranta in exploatare

Riscuri

Echipamentul este de ultima generatie si a fost proiectat si construit pentru a satisface cele mai
noi standarde de siguranta. Folosirea lui poate insa expune operatorul sau alte persoane la riscuri, sau
poate defecta instalatia sau alte echipamente.
Folositi instalatia numai pentru scopul propus si atunci cand este in conditii complete de
siguranta.
Disfunctionalitatile care pot afecta operarea sigura trebuie eliminate imediat. Acest lucru
trebuie facut de catre operator sau de firma in sarcina careia este echipamentul.

Riscuri provocate de apa

Pentru a evita inundatiile cauzate de scurgeri, camera in care se amplaseaza trebuie sa fie
dotata cu sensor anti-inundatie cu alarma.

Riscuri provocate de componetele electrice

Nu atingeti componentele electrice cu mana umeda. Inainte de inceperea lucrului la
componetele elctrice decuplati echipamentul de la reteaua electrica

Riscuri provocate de componetele mecanice

O parte din componetele instalatiei sunt preusirzate pana la 25 bar. Faceti depresurizarea lor
inainte de a efectua reparatii sau operatiuni de intretinere.

Scopul instalatiei

Instalatia este proiectata pentru dedurizarea apei potabile, de put sau de suprafata, care nu
contine alte particule sau ioni de metale.
Limetele parametrilor cum sunt presiunea, temperatura si debitul sunt precizate in manual in sectiunea
de date tehnice.
Folosirea instalatiei in orice alt scop este interzisa si exonereaza de raspundere producatorul si
furnizorul.
Scopul propus implica de asemenea:

str. Zizinului nr. 110,
Brașov, 500407, România
contact@akro.ro
0268-413180 / 0728-994472
www.akro.ro
- cunoasterea informatiilor contine in manualul de operare
- instalatia este inspectata si verificata la intervale de timp prestabilite

Se considera neconforma folosirea instalatiei ca:
- filtruv(pentru filtrare mecanica fara regenerare su saramura)
- recipient de stocare (dupa indepartarea rasinii schimbatoare de ioni din interior)
- accumulator hydraulic

Nu alimentati instalatia cu apa fierbinte.
Limitele indicate in Capitolul C „Date Tehnice“ trebuie respectate.

Scoaterea din uz

La scoaterea din uz, trebuie luate in considerare toate normele locale privind deseurile.

Instalatia este compusa din:

- Recipienti cu rasina schimbatoare de ioni (1 la statiile simplex, 2 la statiile duplex, 3 la statiile
triplex).
- Rasina schimbatoare de ioni
- robinet principal de control
- furtune
- vas/ vase de saramura

Functionarea

In instalatiile de dedurizare, componetele chimice prezente in apa cum sunt ionii de calciu (Ca2+) si
magneziu (Mg2+) care dau caracteristica de duritate a apei sunt inlocuite cu ioni de sodium (Na+).
Rasina schimbatoare de ioni este folosita in acest scop.
O unitate schimbatoare de ioni are o capacitate limitata de absorbtie. Dupa filtrarea unei anumite
cantitati de apa rasina schimbatoare de ioni se satureaza si trebuie regenerate.
Cu cat apa are o duritatea mai mare cu atat mai des trebuie regenerate rasina.
Regenerarea se face utilizabd saramusa obtinuta din sare dizolvata( clorura de sodium, NaCl).

Desfasurarea procesului de dedurizare

Ciclul complet de operare a unei statii de dedurizare consta in urmatorii pasi:
- Operare
- Spalare inverse
- Aspirare saramura/ clatire usoara
- Clatire fortata

str. Zizinului nr. 110,
Brașov, 500407, România
contact@akro.ro
0268-413180 / 0728-994472
www.akro.ro
In “operare”, apa intra pe la supapa din partea de sus si trece prin stratul de rasina de sus in jos pana
cand rasina se satureaza cu ioni de sodiu. Momentul in care rasina este saturate este calculata cu
ajutorul debitmetrului care contorizeaza volumul de apa dedurizata.
Pe durata procesului de spalare inverse rasina este afanata de apa care circula de jos in sus. In acelasi
timp particulele aflate in suspensie sunt evacuate prin supapa din partea de sus. Acest process dureaza
5-10 minute. Urmeaza procesul de aspirare a saramurii. Saramura patrunde de sus in jos prin stratul de
rasina. Stratul support de nisip in care se afla sorbul permite patrunderea uniforma a saramurii pe
intrgul diametru al vasului. Ionii care dau duritate apei sunt inlucuiti aproape in totatlitate cu ioni de
sodium. Restul solutiei de saramura NaCl impreuna cu solutiile de CaCl2 si MgCl2 care se formeaza
in timpul procesului de schimbare de ioni sunt evacuate din vas “la canal”. Urmatoarea etapa este
clatirea directa in timpul careia se evacueaza saramura ramasa in vas.
Deoarece aspiratia saramurii si clatirea directa se face fara modificarea pozitie supapelor din sistemul
central de distributie al capului hydraulic, aceasta etapa poate considerate o singura faza in cardul
programului de regenerare si dureaza 45-55 min.

Setarea controlerului
- Cititi capitolul F si manualul de utilizare al controlerului inainte de punerea in functiune
- Verificati daca parametrii locali corespund celor setati din fabrica si ajustati-i daca este cazul
utilizand instructiunile descris in manual

Clatirea recipientelor care contin rasina de dedurizare
Recipientelor care contin rasinile schimbatoare de ioni trebuie sa li se faca o spalare inverse inainte de
pornire
- Deschideti robinetul de intrare in statia de dedurizare
- Apasati butonul REGEN timp de 3 secunde. Se activeaza astfel spalarea inversa (prima faza a
programului de regenerare)
- Asteptati pana se termina faza de spalare inverse si incepe faza de absorbtie a saranurii
(BRINE)
- Apasati butonul REGEN pentru a sari peste aceasta faza. Controlerul trece automat la
urmatoare faza – clatirea (RINSE)
- Apasati butonul REGEN pentru a sari peste aceasta faza. Controlerul trece automat la
urmatoare faza – umplerea vasului de saramura (FILL)
- Asteptati pana se termina aceasta faza
- Verificati inainte de terminarea acestei faze daca nivelul apei in vasul de saramura este
aproximativ 20 mm peste suportul de sare
- Clatiti cel de-al doilea recipient al statie de dedurizare in mod analog sarind peste etapa de
umplere a vasului de saramura

Setarea instalatiei pentru operare

Se recomanda utilizarea de sare tablete in conformitate cu DIN EN 973, tip A
- Turnati sarea in vasul de saramura si raspanditi-o pe suprafata suport
- Deschideti robinetul de apa bruta si de apa dedurizata
- Robinetul de apa de la iesirea din statia de dedurizare trebuie deschis astfel incat sa nu se
depaseasca debitul maxim nominal (vezi datele tehnice). Depasirea debitului nominal
duce la cresterea duritatii apei.

NOTA!
Nu limitati debitul de apa la intrare in statia de dedurizare deoarece nu va fi debit de apa
suficient pentru procedura de regenerare.

Oprirea

Oprirea de scurta durata (mai putin de 2 saptamani)
- Asteptati intotdeauna incheierea procesului de regenerare, odata ce a fost initiat. Daca se face
deconectarea in timpul regenerarii exista riscul ca la re-pornire statoa sa furnizeze apa ne-
dedurizata sau chiar saramura.
- Decuplati conectarea electrica de la priza
- Inchideti robineti de intrare si iesire din statia de dedurizare
- Daca statia de dedurizare alimenteaza echipamente care necesita obigatoriu alimentarea cu apa,
chiar si ne-dedurizata, lasati robinetul de By-pass deschis.

Oprirea de lunga durata (mai putin de 2 saptamani)
Inainte ca dedurizatorul sa fie scos din functiune pentru o durata mai lunga, este necesara
efectuarea unei regenerari complete.
- Initializati manual procesul de regenerare apasand butonul REGEN
- Dupa incheierea procesului de regenerare, deconectati alimentarea electrica a dedurizatorului
- Daca locatia in care este instalat echipamentul poate fi afectata de inghet pana la repunerea in
functiune, dedurizatorul trebuie golit complet de apa. Umiditatea reziduala ramasa in
recipinetii care contin rasina este suficienta astfel incat sa previna uscarea completa a acesteia.

Repornirea

Repornirea dupa oprirea de scurta durata
- Verificati conexiunile hidraulice ale dedurizarorului si nivelul de sare in vasul de saramura.
- Alimentati electric echipamentul
- Deschideti incet robineti de intrare si iesire ai statiei de dedurizare.

Repornirea dupa oprirea de lunga durata
- Verificati conexiunile hidraulice ale dedurizarorului si nivelul de sare in vasul de saramura.
- Deschideti incet robineti de intrare si iesire ai statiei de dedurizare.
- Umpleti vasul de saramura cu apa pana la sare
- Inainte de a initia procesul de regenere, acordati sufficient timp (aprox 5 ore la 15oC) pentru
formarea saramurii. Timpul trebuie calculate de la momentul ultimei regenarari sau de la
ultima alimentare cu sare.
- Alimentati electric echipamentul
- Deschideti incet robinetul de intrare al statiei de dedurizare
- Initializati regenerarea manuala a recipientului nr.1 care contine rasina schimbatoare de ioni
- Dupa terminarea regenerarii astaptati din nou sa se formeze saramura (aprox. 5 ore)
- Initializati regenerarea manuala a recipientului nr.2 care contine rasina schimbatoare de ioni
- Deschideti incet robinetul de iesire al statiei de dedurizare

Modul de Operare

Blocarea accesului la panoul de control
Apasati butonul REGEN
Apasati butonul 􀁖

Apasati butonul 􀁖

- Apasati butonul NEXT – este afisata capacitatea de dedurizare ramasa

Initierea manuala a regenerarii
- Apasati butonul REGEN pentru 3 secunde
- Controlerul initiaza automat diferitele faze ale regenerarii. Acestea pot fi sarite succesiv
apasand butonul REGEN

messages.body:
Salut Marcel,

Am trimis catre constructor:

Iti confirm ca astazi:

Montam manometru + vas de presiune pe refularea fiecarei pompe – dar consider ca ar fi trebuit sa stim de acest lucru inainte sa ofertam;

Vom modifica pozitia T-ului din aspiratie intre clapeta si robinet – dar la fel , am intrebat zilele trecute daca sunt anumite conditii de respectat in montajul senzorilor [ cand am astabilit sa nu punem robineti pe fiecare senzor – astfel incat sa nu se inchida de catre client din greseala , si am stabilit pozitia senzorilor intre robinetii de izolare ai pompelor – in caz de defectiune sa ii putem inlocui fara sa golim circuitul]

Am inteles cu senzorii de 0-10 bar – ii vom da retur .

Problema de rezolvat

Legat de tabloul de alimentare, curentul este in camera tehnica. Nu ati specificat ca pompele trebuiesc alimentate dintr-un TA si s-a considerat ca punerea in functiune implica alimentarea cu tensiune a pompelor. Constructorul nu executa conexiuni electrice si nici beneficiarul. Va rog sa imi faceti o oferta pentru ce inseamna acest tablou si conexiunea pompelor la energie electrica din partea Recondi

Pentru transparenta am lasat in copie si E-mailul constructorului.

Astept cu interes raspuns !

Numai bine,

From: Recondi | Vanzari Pompe <pompe@recondi.ro>
Sent: Friday, July 31, 2026 11:58 AM
To: AKRO Romania , Alexandru Soare <alexandru.soare@akro.ro>
Cc: Akro Filtrare <office@akro.ro>; Recondi Service <service@recondi.ro>; Recondi Pompe <pompe@recondi.ro>
Subject: Re: Deplasare PIF Stabilus 31.07.26 - Comanda P01176 - OF-00043818 - Re: OF-00042871

Salut Alex,

Urmare a deplasarii de azi 31.07.26 a colegilor mei la Stabilus pentru PIF pompe 93147604_CRIE_5-9_NPAEHQQE, confirm faptul ca nu s-a facut PIF din cauza montajului nefinalizat si incorect facut. In anexa gasesti un fiser pdf pe care te rog sa-l trimiti constructorului pentru remediere. Dupa realizarea acestora se va putea vei la PIF.

Mai jos ai operatiunile necesare actualizarii montajului:

= A se monta manometru cu vas cu membrana 8L PN10 in T-ul de pe refularea fiecarei pompe.
= T-ul din aspiratie sa fie montat intre clapeta si robinet, iar in T sa se monteze senzorul 0-1 bar. Pentru fiecare pompa.
= Pompele trebuie alimentate dintr-un TA avand siguranta tripolara pentru fiecare. Trebuie aduse cablurile de alimentare langa fiecare pompa.

In alta ordine de idei, pompele fiind livrate cu senzor de presiune integrat, nu va mai fi nevoie de senzorii 0-10 bar achizitionari si livrati, pe care ni-i poti returna si ii vom storna. Probabil datorita mai multor posibilitati luate in calcul la ofertare, au ramas agatati.

Multumesc.

--

Cu stima / Best regards,

messages.subject: RE: Project in aquisition state.
messages.body:
Hello Gokhan,

Thank you for the price offer!

I just want to inform that the results of the water [ on the test filter] – are good ! so most likely next week, we will sign the contract with the client.

Please find attached the results [ before and after the filter].

Regarding the price quotation [ the price is ok], but I have the following questions:

I saw that this was offered with a single PLC [ that is great] – but I do not know if the piping to mount them in parallel is included or not. [ I think not but just to confirm]

I saw that all the valves are Castiron electric actuated valves. Is it possible to change them with something made in SS as a body – or at least the parts in contact with the liquid [ which I hope they are more durable in time].

What is the producer of the FRP tanks?

Is there a possibility of giving me the dimensions of the filters with the skid installed [ we have a total height there of around 3 m -but there is a little crowded in the maters of space] [ I have sent some photos but they are not that clear]

I will need certificates for the filters [ this is mandatory]:

CE certificate [ at least for the parts in contact with water – FRP tanks + Electric valves]

Some sort of WRAS / or safety certificate that the system is suitable for potable water

Other quality or test certifications will be good.

I am looking forward for your response!

Best regards,

From: GÖKHAN ÖZLER gozler@aosmithtr.com
Sent: Friday, July 31, 2026 3:42 PM
To: AKRO Romania , Alexandru Soare alexandru.soare@akro.ro

Subject: RE: Project in aquisition state.

From: AKRO Romania , Alexandru Soare <alexandru.soare@akro.ro>
Sent: Monday, July 27, 2026 12:31 PM
To: GÖKHAN ÖZLER <gozler@aosmithtr.com>
Cc: 'Akro Filtrare' <office@akro.ro>; 'Aurel CARAS - AKRO' <aurel.caras@akro.ro>; andrei.dobrei@akro.ro
Subject: Project in aquisition state.

Hello Gokhan,

I hope this e-mail finds you well!

We are working on a project for ARTROM STEELTUBES – and we are in the acquisition state for this [ we need just to receive some water analysis to confirm the solution and we will be ready to order]

I will explain. The Client has some problems with tetra and trichloroethylene . We should normally be able to remove this from well water with a simple chlorination and then activated carbon filtration [ we have chose a special carbon for this application ] . We have sent a small pilot filter – to test the solution at a scale and we are waiting for the water analysis to confirm it. If everything is well, and it should, we need to start the acquisition process in the following days.

What I need from you is a price quotation and estimated delivery time for :

3 automatic filters with valve skid – with FRP tank 48x72:

We need the skid to be built with electric actuated valves

The filters will be offered without media [ we will bring the special carbon which we already tested]

The filters must start regeneration at a set time

The filters will be mount in parallel – all active . So we can built this with only a general PLC

The filters will backwash with water from the same source .

If possible to offer also the connection between the 3 filters [ we are looking for a general DN 80 distributor for inlet and a DN 80 general distributor for outlet.

It will be good to have 2 extra electric actuated valves for spare parts

We have initially offered to the client this project with BS-4872 filters [ data sheet attached] – but we want to order this from AO SMITH [ to start the collaboration].

I also attached a drawing with the filter battery – just as for info!

I am looking forward in receiving your response!

If you need any other clarifications , I am at your dispose !

Best regards,

This Pressure UV Systems is manufactured by S.I.T.A. s.r.l.
Warning: This equipment requires regular maintenance to ensure the requirements of the drinking
water treated and the maintenance of the improvements as stated by the manufacturer.

These operating instructions contain important information for the operation and maintenance of the
equipment.

Please ensure that these operating instructions are carefully read by all relevant persons before putting
into operation, to ensure the safe use of the UV system. The operating instructions are an integral part
of the equipment supply.
Before putting into operation, all the conditions necessary for safe operation of the equipment must be
fulfilled.
The installation, commissioning and maintenance of the equipment should only be carried out by
qualified personnel.

The equipment should only be operated by authorized personnel who have been trained accordingly.

No modifications should be made to the equipment without consulting S.I.T.A., as this could affect the
safe operation of the unit. S.I.T.A. shall not be held responsible for damage resulting from unapproved
modifications.

INSTRUCTION:
The operating instructions are to be kept where they will be accessible for operating and
maintenance personnel.

2
2. General Principles and Safety Instructions
Information about UV irradiation:
The UV disinfection system of the RACK LCD series have been planned specially for destroying
harmful bacteria and viruses present in your water.
Their working is based on a physical principle which is a warranty of security: the output of ultra-violet
irradiation.
The UV light given out by special mercury vapours lamps (UV-C rays = 254nm) is highly germicidal
because it interacts with DNA and RNA, at a molecular level.
The deep bio-structural disorder caused by such irradiation interferes with the development and the
ability of reproduction of every kind of micro-organism, making it harmless.
Generally it is better to mount a pre-filter before the UV sterilizer, in this way the impurities of every
nature and consistence are kept.
This system comes to be necessary if we want to have a high degree of sterilization, infact the non-
filtration and removal of suspended particles in the water has, as a consequence, a decrease of the
sterilizer's efficiency.
If the water to be treated contains sulphydric acid or more than 0.3 p.p.m. of iron or filtrable solids,
once passed through the sterilizer, it leaves a residual sediment on the quartz sleeve, which, therefore,
must be periodically cleaned (the frequency depends on the quantity and quality of water treated).
General directions:
According to the European rules EN 60204-1 (safety of the set-up off the electrical equipment-general
rules) the low tension electrical instruments (rule 2014/35/CE) must be connected to a current-tap
provided with grounding.
Electrical Safety Instructions:
The lightning flash and arrowhead symbol is to alert the user to the presence of un-insulated
"DANGEROUS VOLTAGE” within the enclosure. The equipment may only be opened if
main supply is isolated. The main supply must not be restored as long as the equipment is
open. This applies to both the electrical panel and the UV reactor vessel.
ATTENZION: Working on live equipment is forbidden.
UV Light Danger:
The light of ultra-violet lamps can cause serious burns to unprotected skin and eyes,
therefore it is recommended not to connect it to the current tap without having before
ensured the UV lamp in its housing and inserted the PVC cover.

Pressure Danger:
The UV chamber could be under water pressure. Max working pressure is 10 bar. UV chamber must be
installed in accordance with our installation and commissioning instructions and used in accordance
with operating and maintenance instructions.
ATTENTION: Ensure that system is depressurized before attempting any service or repair
Indications for the disposal:
We remind that, according to what is fixed by D.L. 4 May 2014, N°27 "Accomplishment of directive
2011/65/CE, concerning the reduction of dangerous subrtances in electric and electronic equipments"
both mercury vapours lamps and electrical panels, when no more used, must be considered as special
waste, and in the same way disposed of.
To do that, it is possible to address to specialized centres for the recovery of dangerous materials, or to
contact directly our technical department.

3
INFORMATION TO USERS pursuant to art. 14 of the 2012/19 / EU DIRECTIVE OF
THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL of 4 July 2012 on waste
electrical and electronic equipment (WEEE)
The crossed bin symbol on the appliance or on its packaging indicates that the product
at the end of its useful life must be collected separately and not disposed of together
with other mixed urban waste.
Please contact your municipality, or local authority, for all information regarding the separate
collection systems available in the area. The retailer is obliged to collect the old equipment free of
charge when buying new equipment of an equivalent type, for the purpose of starting the correct
recycling / disposal.
Appropriate separate collection for the subsequent start-up of the disused equipment for recycling,
treatment and environmentally compatible disposal helps to avoid possible negative effects on the
environment and on health and favors the re-use and / or recycling of the materials it is composed of
the equipment.

3. Instructions for installation and setting at work
General premise: The installation of the RACK LCD SERIES disinfection units must be carried out
by specialized staff, scrupolously following the instructions hereby given. It has been moreover
considered necessary to give some general information about the electrical and water connections.
Cautions: check that the UV panel is not connected to the power supply and that the tap of the water to
be treated is turned off.
•Connect the delivery of the water to be treated to the special water connection
•Turn on water and check for possible leaks in any part of the unit
•Connect the plug to the current tap
•Check that the disinfected water comes out and that the LEDS on the panel of the control board, signal
the correct working
Let the disinfected water flow down to outlet for at least 10 minutes before using it, in order to make
the possible impurities present in the unit drain out.
NOTE: it is recommended to install a water filter directly before the UV sterilizer in order to remove
the suspended particles, eventually present in the water to be treated, which could limit the efficiency
of sterilization.
CHECKS
The RACK LCD SERIES is ready for producing disinfected water, once the connection to the water
system and to the electrical grid is carried out. The unit works automatically, the electronical boards
which control the signals reaching the control panel, allow the visualizing (or the sounding) of the
correct working or of anomalies which may occur during the operating of the unit.

8. Maintenance
The UV System of DOMESTIC SERIES have been projected and realized by S.I.T.A. Srl with simple
and functional principles which make the checking procedures and the periodical servicing particularly
easy.
The main points which characterize the ordinary servicing are the following: check quarterly the
quartz sleeves, which contain the UV lamps, in order to ensure the maximum disinfection, for the
cleaning.
Maintenance work may only be carried out by personnel who have been trained and authorized for this
work by the owner and/or user. The owner and/or user must ensure that the maintenance personnel are
familiar with the safety measures and regulations, and that they also comply with them, in addition to
having read and understood the operating instructions.
Only original replacement parts from the supplier must be used.
The following are the recommended service intervals for replacement parts:
UV lamp change - once per 9000 hours
UV quartz sleeve clean - frequency depends on the quality of the water
O-ring for quartz sleeve-once per year

Procedure for the UV lamp replacement (9000 h max.)
1. Disconnect the electrical box from the electrical power supply
2. Lift the cover slightly turning, carefully loosen the electrical 4-pins connection and extract the
lamp from the quartz sleeve
3. Remove the lamp from the packing, handling it carefully by its ends or using gloves
4. Insert the new lamp into the quartz sleeve of the sterilizer
5. Connect the lamp to the electrical connection and put again the cover
6. Connect again the equipment.

Important!
For lamps replacement it is not necessary to stop the water flow and drain the UV chamber

Procedure for the quartz sleeve cleaning
1. Disconnect the electrical box from the electrical grid and turn off water
2. Remove the lamp, as described for the replacement procedure
3. Depressurized and drain the UV system
4. Unscrew the sleeve-bolt and extract the quartz sleeve with care
5. Clean the quartz sleeve by wiping it with a cloth soaked with an acid solution such as vinegar or
lemmon
6. Reassemble the sleeve being sure to center the guide-spring fixed on the bottom, put the o-ring on
the quartz sleeve, then tighten the sleeve-bolt; place the o-ring in the seat of the sleeve-bolt, insert
the sleeve inside it, till it leans, then screw on the S/S chamber.
7. Turn on water checking for eventual leaks
8. Mount again lamp, its electrical connection and cover
9. Turn on the UV system.

19
9. Replace the ballast
Ballasts are installed into the motherboard in rack configuration. Each ballast starts one lamp.
Ballast from the left starts lamp 1 to lamp 5.
If one lamp is off then first test its ballast with another lamp. If the second lamp doesn’t start too then
the problem is in the ballast. Check the fuse before replacing the ballast with the following procedure.
If replacement fuse blows then the ballast shall be either repaired or replaced.

CAUTION: Before starting maintenance operation switch off the panel power
supply.

1. Unscrew the protection panel retaining screws.
2. Unlock the ballast from its plastic guides by pressing buttons 1 and 2.
3. Pull out the ballast.
4. Insert the new ballast and lock it pushing button 1 and button 2.
5. Screw the protection panel, close the panel door and start the panel.

TQ-1 — Cyclic Capacity & Treated Water Quality

The AKRO datasheet for the BlueSoft BS-D2/RV series lists for the BS3200D2/RV model: resin volume 2 × 800 L and cyclic capacity 2 × 3,200 m³×°dH, with a salt consumption range of 80–192 kg per regeneration per column and flow rate 32–40 m³/h.

However based on our experience, considering the brute water has also different metallic ions in smaller or greater concentrations [ like iron, manganese, aluminium and so on] –a cationic resin will be able to retain this ions as well, reducing punctual hardness exchange capacity. We normally do sizing calculations with a exchange capacity of around 3.2-3.3 m3 x 0dH / each L of resin.

Inlet water hardness is 12.50dF – this means it is roughly 70dH.

In this conditions, each column will regenerate after 2640 / 7 = around 375m3 of treated water .

The system will work volumetric – this means it will regenerate each 375m3 of treated water.

If you have a constant 30m3/h flow – this means the regeneration will start each +-12.5 H

The brine tanks offered have a total capacity of 1500L

To dilute 96 kg of salt – you need around 280 L of water [ at a temperature of 200C]

To sum up, we have 10 x 96 kg /1.25[ salt density] + 280-300L of water for dissolving the salt needed for 1 regeneration = +-1070 L of media - so will fit in a 1500L brine tank .

I suggest using for this application at least 800-850L softener [ the tank used in this case is 42x72 ] – resulting a filtration velocity of 34m/h –assuring a medium contact time, or for a optimal filtration velocity – 48x72 tanks [ and 1000-1100L of resin on each tank] – resulting a velocity of around 26m/h.

Now what is unclear for me in this tender - from the technical point of view, is the following:

I am asking this because the treated water parameters are a little problematic to be achieved:

the pH of 9.5-1.5 , but the initial pH is around 7.8 [ I think this can be assured only through dosing of NaOH in the water not to influence hardness ]

The iron level < 0.3μg/L – but the initial iron level is around 10 μg/L – so the softener will most probably adsorb a small part of the iron ions [ this as a secondary effect], but has no control on how much will be retained.

You need the Oxidability of the water to be 30 mgO2/L [ permanganate index] - [ this normally in the water treatment plants – means the water will be very contaminated with mostly organic compounds] – I think this is not correct asked .

Normally for this type of softeners the max operating pressure should not exceed 6-7bar. [ in the tender is asked for a 10bar system]

What is the current state of this tender – you are in construction phase/ project phase ?

I saw you also need a 2d/3d model for the softener in max 2 weeks from order, this I will need to check with the producer if it can be available or not . But first we need to clarify what type of vessel should we use, pipping of the skid, automation etc.

Can you tell me more about the scope of the treated water ?

For sure we can schedule a teams meeting as well in the following days, but I suggest first to have a clear view of what equipment will be proper for your application [ because depending of the options we are limited from each producer].

I am looking forward in receiving your response!

Best regards,

Subject: Solicitare ofertă pentru înlocuirea rășinii și a crepinelor – stație de dedurizare Duplex

Stimate domnule Soare,

Revin către dumneavoastră cu rugămintea de a ne transmite o ofertă pentru înlocuirea rășinii schimbătoare de ioni și a crepinelor din cadrul stației de dedurizare Duplex, echipată cu vase de rășină de 1.000 litri (un total de rasina de 2000 litri).

De această dată, aș dori să analizăm posibilitatea utilizării unui alt tip de rășină față de cea montată în prezent. Din experiența ultimilor ani, aceasta nu reușește să atingă capacitatea de funcționare pentru care a fost proiectată instalația.

Stația a fost dimensionată pentru un ciclu de aproximativ 300 m³ de apă dedurizată înainte de regenerare. Cu rășina originală, instalată din fabrică, obțineam în mod constant aproximativ 250–260 m³ de apă dedurizată până la inițierea regenerării, ceea ce era un rezultat foarte bun.

În schimb, după înlocuirea rășinii în urmă cu aproximativ trei ani, capacitatea a scăzut semnificativ, iar în prezent nu mai reușim să obținem decât 180–190 m³ de apă dedurizată înainte de regenerare.

Menționez că anul trecut am înlocuit complet toți robineții pneumatici ai stației, astfel încât în acest moment echipamentul funcționează cu robineți noi, iar problema nu pare să fie cauzată de sistemul de automatizare sau de distribuția apei.

Vă rog să ne recomandați o rășină cu o capacitate de schimb ionic mai ridicată și cu performanțe mai bune decât cea utilizată în prezent, astfel încât să ne apropiem cât mai mult de performanțele inițiale ale instalației. De asemenea, vă rog să includeți în ofertă și înlocuirea crepinelor, precum și toate materialele și manopera necesare pentru efectuarea lucrării.

Dacă apreciați că este necesară o vizită în teren înainte de întocmirea ofertei, vă stăm la dispoziție pentru a programa o întâlnire.

Aștept cu interes recomandarea și oferta dumneavoastră.

Vă mulțumesc!

Cu stimă/ Best Regards/ Mit freundlichen Grüßen

messages.body:
Buna ziua Dl Clivet,

Va raspund anexat cu oferta de pret [ pentru crepine+nisip+manopera de schimb], insa pentru partea de rasina avem urmatoarele propuneri din care sa alegeti:

Rasina PURE RESIN – PC003 - cost 2000L cu livrare inclusa – 6900euro fara TVA [ termen de livrare 3-4 saptamani poate mai mult in aceasta perioada din cauza concediilor] [ lucram cu ea des]

Rasina – Brightion SFC 90 – cost 2000L cu livrarea inclusa – 6400euro fara TVA [ termen de livrare 1 saptamana] – nu lucram de prea mult timp cu ea, dar pana acum nu dezamageste

Rasina Lewatit S1567 – cost 2000L cu livrare inclusa – 7600 euro fara TVA [ termen de livrare 1 saptamana] – am lucrat cu ea in vreo 3 proiecte

Rasina DOWEX HCRS – cost 2000L cu livrare inclusa 9700 euro fara TVA [ livrare in 2-3 saptamani]

Las anexate si fisele tehnice de la fiecare.

Astept tipul de rasina ales – pentur a actualiza oferta.

Cu respect,

From: Clivet, Razvan <Razvan.Clivet@amann.com>
Sent: Thursday, August 6, 2026 8:28 AM
To: AKRO Romania , Alexandru Soare <alexandru.soare@akro.ro>
Cc: contact@akro.ro; Preda, Ionut <Ionut.Preda@amann.com>; Mindru, Gabriel-Marian <Gabriel-Marian.Mindru@amann.com>
Subject: Solicitare ofertă pentru înlocuirea rășinii și a crepinelor – stație de dedurizare Duplex

Stimate domnule Soare,

Revin către dumneavoastră cu rugămintea de a ne transmite o ofertă pentru înlocuirea rășinii schimbătoare de ioni și a crepinelor din cadrul stației de dedurizare Duplex, echipată cu vase de rășină de 1.000 litri (un total de rasina de 2000 litri).

De această dată, aș dori să analizăm posibilitatea utilizării unui alt tip de rășină față de cea montată în prezent. Din experiența ultimilor ani, aceasta nu reușește să atingă capacitatea de funcționare pentru care a fost proiectată instalația.

Stația a fost dimensionată pentru un ciclu de aproximativ 300 m³ de apă dedurizată înainte de regenerare. Cu rășina originală, instalată din fabrică, obțineam în mod constant aproximativ 250–260 m³ de apă dedurizată până la inițierea regenerării, ceea ce era un rezultat foarte bun.

În schimb, după înlocuirea rășinii în urmă cu aproximativ trei ani, capacitatea a scăzut semnificativ, iar în prezent nu mai reușim să obținem decât 180–190 m³ de apă dedurizată înainte de regenerare.

Menționez că anul trecut am înlocuit complet toți robineții pneumatici ai stației, astfel încât în acest moment echipamentul funcționează cu robineți noi, iar problema nu pare să fie cauzată de sistemul de automatizare sau de distribuția apei.

Vă rog să ne recomandați o rășină cu o capacitate de schimb ionic mai ridicată și cu performanțe mai bune decât cea utilizată în prezent, astfel încât să ne apropiem cât mai mult de performanțele inițiale ale instalației. De asemenea, vă rog să includeți în ofertă și înlocuirea crepinelor, precum și toate materialele și manopera necesare pentru efectuarea lucrării.

Dacă apreciați că este necesară o vizită în teren înainte de întocmirea ofertei, vă stăm la dispoziție pentru a programa o întâlnire.

Aștept cu interes recomandarea și oferta dumneavoastră.

Vă mulțumesc!

Cu stimă/ Best Regards/ Mit freundlichen Grüßen

Răzvan Cliveț

PRODUCT INFORMATION
LEWATIT® S 1567

Lewatit ® S 1567 is a food grade, strongly acidic cation exchange resin with beads of uniform size
(monodisperse) based an a styrene-divinylbenzene copolymer. Lewatit® S 1567 is manufactured without the
use of solvent.

The monodisperse beads are chemically and osmotically very stable, and they can effectively be disinfected
for the drinking water processing. The optimized kinetics lead to an increased operating capacity compared
to ion exchange resins with heterodisperse bead size distribution.

Lewatit® S 1567 is especially applicable for:

» softening in special systems with regular disinfection
» softening of drinking water

Lewatit® S 1567 is adding special features to the resin bed:

» high exchange flow rates during regeneration and loading
» a good utilization of the total capacity
» a low demand for rinse water
» homogeneous throughput of regenerants, water and solutions; therefore a homogeneous working zone
» nearly linear pressure drop gradient for the whole bed depth; therefore operation with higher bed depth is
possible

The special properties of this product can only be fully utilized if the technology and process used

Additional Information & Regulations
Safety precautions
Strong oxidants, e.g. nitric acid, can cause violent reactions if they come into contact with ion exchange
resins.

Toxicity
The safety data sheet must be observed. It contains additional data on product description, transport,
storage, handling, safety and ecology.

Disposal
In the European Community Ion exchange resins have to be disposed, according to the European waste
nomenclature which can be accessed on the internet-site of the European Union.

Storage
It is recommended to store ion exchange resins at temperatures above the freezing point of water under
roof in dry conditions without exposure to direct sunlight. If resin should become frozen, it should not be
mechanically handled and left to thaw out gradually at ambient temperature. It must be completely thawed
before handling or use. No attempt should be made to accelerate the thawing process.

Packaging
The experience has shown that the packaging stability for reliable resin containment is limited to 24 months
under the storage conditions described above. It is therefore recommended to use the product within this
time frame; otherwise the packaging condition should be checked regularly.

Descriptions
Brightion SFC 90 is a high purity strong acid cationic exchange resin, gel type. It is mainly designed for
the industrial water softening and demineralization, also can be used in potable water softening.
The high excellent mechanical strength and good ion exchange kinetics makes it a good general-purpose
resin in different applications, compared with other resins in market, this resin is distinguished for its long
service life. It is available in other particle size distribution ranges, and available in Na+ or H+ form.

Resins should be stored in sealed containers or bags where temperature was above 0℃ in dry conditions

Dry polymers will expand when become wetted and may cause an exothermic reaction.
Spilled materials may be slippery.

TQ-1 — Cyclic Capacity & Treated Water Quality

The AKRO datasheet for the BlueSoft BS-D2/RV series lists for the BS3200D2/RV model: resin volume 2 × 800 L and cyclic capacity 2 × 3,200 m³×°dH, with a salt consumption range of 80–192 kg per regeneration per column and flow rate 32–40 m³/h.

Please confirm and provide:

Confirm that the cyclic capacity of 2 × 3,200 m³×°dH stated in the datasheet applies to the exact unit offered under quotation S02146 (800 L resin per column).

Based on the data sheet of the producer, and the canature resin used inside the vessels, yes this is the theoretical and lab tested capacity.

However based on our experience, considering the brute water has also different metallic ions in smaller or greater concentrations [ like iron, manganese, aluminium and so on] –a cationic resin will be able to retain this ions as well, reducing punctual hardness exchange capacity. We normally do sizing calculations with a exchange capacity of around 3.2-3.3 m3 x 0dH / each L of resin.

Provide the performance calculation for the following evaluation basis: softened water flow rate Q = 30 m³/h; raw water hardness = 12.5 °Fr — please state the equivalent hardness in °dH used in your calculation; one column in service at a time (duplex alternating).

I will do the calculation with the tested physical ion exchange capacity of 3.3 0dH x m3 / L of resin. So we have 800L x 3.30dh = 26400dh x m3 / each tank.

Inlet water hardness is 12.50dF – this means it is roughly 70dH.

In this conditions, each column will regenerate after 2640 / 7 = around 375m3 of treated water .

State the calculated regeneration interval (hours) at the above conditions.

The system will work volumetric – this means it will regenerate each 375m3 of treated water.

If you have a constant 30m3/h flow – this means the regeneration will start each +-12.5 H

Confirm, as a contractual performance guarantee, that treated water hardness at the outlet will be ≤ 0.5 °Fr throughout the full service cycle — not only at the start of the cycle.

We will need to wait for the producer official response, but normally for the capacity presented above, we can guarantee.

However, because I see this is a very sensitive aspect, I suggest you to also install an on-line softener sensor/monitor to continuously check the water hardness on the outlet of the softener.[in this way you can assure all the parts work properly]. A Sycon 2800 or Testomat panel is around 5-6000 euro

Confirm the minimum number of regeneration cycles achievable with one full brine tank loading (project requires ≥ 10 cycles).

Again this is very hard to assure, because both the draw of the brine and filling is done through venturi injector. So depending of the inlet pressure fluctuation the system will bring more or less water in the brine tank.

If we discuss of ideal conditions than:

The ideal pure salt needed for regeneration of 1L of resin is around 120g/L of resin.

Considering the system has 800 L of resin, than we estimate a salt consumption of around 96kg of salt/ regeneration.

The brine tanks offered have a total capacity of 1500L

To dilute 96 kg of salt – you need around 280 L of water [ at a temperature of 200C]

To sum up, we have 10 x 96 kg /1.25[ salt density] + 280-300L of water for dissolving the salt needed for 1 regeneration = +-1070 L of media - so will fit in a 1500L brine tank .

This again can be calculated only as theoretical. I can do all the math but please clarify:

What kind of water will the softener use for regeneration ? Brute water or the system needs to have a different connection for feeding with clean water during regeneration?

If the system will use brute water to regenerate, than what will be the total available water inlet flow ? if the available flow remains is 30m3/h – than the system will adsorb around 20-30% [ depending of backwash step] – and through it to the drainage. Also this means that during regeneration the production will be reduced with 20-30% because the other tank is using the water for regeneration. [ all clear?]

Now a system this big will consume around 10-15m3/ regeneration [ but again this can change through local settings and physical conditions in site]

Regeneration duration (minutes).

Again this will be parametrises in site. Generally you have the following steps/duration:

Backwash – around 8-10mins

Brine absorbtion – around 30-50 mins

Rinse – around 10-15 mins

Fill – around 15 mins

Maximum drain/backwash flow rate during regeneration (m³/h or L/min).

For softener application you need to assure a 20m/h velocity for correct backwash [ this is the main parameter that must be assured]. – the tanks of the system proposed are 42x72 – this means you need to assure a 15-17m3/h for initial backwash

Volume of water required simultaneously during the regeneration phase (litres).

I do not understand the question. If the question is how much flow you need to assure in order to have a 30m3/h of treated water and considering the system is using brute water also for regeneration, than the answer is 45 m3/h during regeneration.

TQ-3 — Operating Pressure & Booster Pump Requirement [CRITICAL]

This is the most critical open item. Two independent sources confirm the pressure gap:

• Your e-mail of 21 April 2026: "The softener unit requires a inlet water pressure of at least 2–2.5 bar – otherwise the system will not work properly."

• AKRO datasheet BS-D2/RV: Min. operating pressure = 200 kPa (2 bar).

The project specification (FT It-10.1 §1) defines the available potable water inlet pressure as 1–1.5 bar. This is the pressure available at the softening station inlet (line 00GHD01-BR001). The confirmed pressure deficit is 0.5–1.5 bar.

Please provide formal written responses to the following:

Confirm the exact minimum inlet pressure required for the BS3200D2/RV to operate correctly and guarantee the treated water performance specified in TQ-1.

MINIMUM WATER PRESSURE MUST BE 2-2.5BAR

MAX WATER PRESSURE 6 BAR

Is a booster/pressure-raising pump upstream of the softening station required to bridge this pressure gap?

We do not know the site conditions to make recommendations. Where does the brute water come from? If it is from municipality than yes a booster pump will help increasing the pressure for the system.

If a booster pump is required: is it included in AKRO's scope of supply under offer S02146? If not, please provide technical specifications and a budget price for a suitable booster pump and confirm whether AKRO can supply and install it within the same contract.

It is not included and the installation will not be included in our scope

If no booster pump is offered: please confirm explicitly that the system cannot be guaranteed to operate correctly at 1–1.5 bar inlet pressure, so that this can be formally assessed by the project designer.

The system will not operate correctly for a inlet water pressure that is not in the interval of 2-6bar

TQ-4 — Dimensions & Installation Envelope

A discrepancy has been identified between two AKRO documents provided:

• Dimensional drawing BS-3200D2-RV (AKRO Romania, January 2023): overall dimensions approx. 2,516 mm × 2,193 mm, installed height approx. 2,203 mm. Please be aware that in the drawing attached, you do not have the overall dimensions of the softener. You do not even have the total height of it .2203mm represents the total width in this positioning.

• AKRO datasheet BlueSoft BS-D2/RV (BlueSoft 3200D2/RV row): H × L × W = 2,425 × 3,200 × 2,750 mm, operating weight 2,430 kg.

Please clarify and provide:

Confirm which set of dimensions applies to the unit offered under quotation S02146 (800 L resin per column, 2 × 1,500 L brine tanks, SUFV 3" filter or FTA alternative).

For the softener please take into account the dimensions from the BlueSoft 3200D2/RV row from the data sheet present with the mention that the brine tanks can be freely positioned anywhere round the unit;

For the SUFV 3” – please take into account the dimensions from the data sheet link - https://akro.ro/public/fise/238-Fisa_tehnica_Filtru_cu_autocuratare_otel_carbon.pdf

Provide the final General Arrangement drawing for the complete supplied package, including: softener tanks; valve skid; brine tanks; filter system; inlet/outlet headers; drain connections; minimum maintenance clearances around the unit.

We cannot provide this drawings – this is design part

Minimum space required for maintenance – at least 0.5m around each unit .

Confirm the final empty weight and operating weight (kg) of the complete package as supplied.

I will give you the fully working total weight , considering the 2 brine tanks full with water + salt for 10 regenerations in each. + filter filled with water – total weight around 6.3 T

Note: The preliminary maximum installation height is 3,900 mm. Final site coordination is subject to design verification.

If this is the total available height of the room, than this is enough for installing the system . We will need around 3.5m for a easy fill of the unit with media.

TQ-5 — DCS Signals & Controller Integration

Your e-mail of 21 April states: "The system is able to send a signal through 2 dry contacts – that can be set only during the regeneration time."

The project specification (FT It-10.1 §1) requires the following signals to be exchanged with the plant central DCS:

Start/Stop command — binary input from DCS to the softening unit.

Unit status Running — binary output from unit to DCS.

Unit status Stopped — binary output from unit to DCS.

Unit status Regenerating — binary output from unit to DCS.

Based on your e-mail, we understand the 2 available dry contacts are active only during regeneration and are designed for triggering an external pump or valve — not for general status reporting or remote start/stop command. Please clarify:

Can the 2 dry contacts be configured to report any of the four DCS signals listed above? Please describe exactly what each contact can be set to signal.

Is a remote Start/Stop input from DCS to the unit possible with the standard RX-D2/RV controller?

Does the electronic controller feature an electronic display as required by the specification?

If the standard controller cannot provide the required DCS signals: can AKRO offer an alternative control panel or PLC upgrade? If yes, please provide specifications and the additional cost.

I will need to wait the producer automation manual to present to you and see what signals you can use . the dry contacts can deliver signal only during backwash steps.

Anyway, I want to assure you that this unit, or any other softener unit, cannot provide the signals you are asking without an external automation.

For example - Start/Stop – A softener unit never STOPS! this happens only when you close the water circuit, but the softener’s automation does not stopping the water flow.

So this control that you are asking, can be done but only with an external automation which is not included

TQ-6 — Upstream Filter: 50 Micron Requirement

Your e-mail confirms that a 50 micron solution would require 3× FTA 180/E 2" in parallel + FTA-DP controller, at approximately 3,200 € without VAT, in lieu of the offered SUFV 3" at 100 microns.

The project specification (FT It-10.1 §1) explicitly requires a self-cleaning filter with a stainless steel mesh rated at 50 microns. This is a stated technical requirement. Acceptance of a 100 micron filter instead of the specified 50 microns can only be considered subject to formal written approval by the project designer.

Please confirm and provide:

Is the mesh of the offered SUFV 3" filter constructed from stainless steel as required by the specification?

Yes, but the filtration efficiency is 100 microns.

Please formally include the 3× FTA 180/E 2" parallel filter configuration as a separate alternative line item in your revised offer, with full technical specifications, dimensional data, and the exact price delta versus the standard SUFV 3".

We do not recommend this solution . We gave it as alternative because you asked specifically for a NOBEL softener and most likely you have consider also their filters in the project. But installing 3 filters in parallel we cannot assure a perfect divide of the water flow through the 3 elements, so in time there might appear operating problems.

For the parallel FTA filter configuration: confirm that water flow to the softener is uninterrupted during automatic backwash of any individual filter element.

As I mentioned we do not recommend this solution. But if the designer included this type of filters in the project than he might answer you .

However, your request is not clear. So you ask for a automated self cleaning filter [ which will clean by itself every time the DP is reached] but it must deliver clean water 24h/day. Of course this is impossible – it is normal that during its cleaning procedure, the filter will not supply filtered water. Anyhow – the total cleaning time for a SUFV is less than a minute. If you still want this filtering stage to assure you non stop filtered water, than you need to mount a secondary SUF in parallel [1 A+1STBy] – the second unit + installing materials are not included in the offer.

TQ-7 — Materials in Contact with Potable Water

The softening station treats potable water (apă potabilă) for preparation of hot make-up water in the district heating circuit. Please confirm:

Now this is not clear at all. So the treated water will be used as make-up water in the closed heating circuit. Why does the system needs potable certificates ? will this closed circuit water be drank ? Please clarify in each point this water will be used as drinking water.

All materials in contact with the water — including resin, internal vessel lining, valves, seals, gaskets and brine tank components — are suitable for potable water application.

We can give you certificates only for:

Internal paint of the filter sufv – WRAS certif

Hygienic certificate for the CANATURE pressure vessels

Hygienic certificate for the resin

Hygienic certificate for the support gravel

Provide relevant certificates or declarations confirming potable water suitability (e.g. ACS, WRAS, KTW, or equivalent European approval).

The above mentioned certificates will be delivered with the equipment

TQ-8 — Warranty: Basis of Calculation

Offer S02146 states: "Warranty: 36 months from delivery of the goods". The project specification (FT It-10.1 §4) requires minimum 36 months from the date of commissioning (PIF — Punere în Funcțiune). Given that delivery and commissioning may be separated by several months, this is a material contractual difference.

Confirm whether you can agree to a warranty period of 36 months calculated from the date of commissioning (PIF).

The warranty will start from the delivery of the goods date

Confirm: defect resolution time ≤ 5 days from notification, and spare parts availability in the post-warranty period ≤ 15 days.

We can assure a <5 days response, not a resolution time.

If different components break [ like a electric valve] – we do not keep this in stock so it must be delivered from the supplier in order to be exchanged. Generally the delivery time is 1-2 weeks + service schedule time less than 7 days.

TQ-9 — CE Marking & Quality Documentation

The Caiet de Sarcini (§10) requires CE marking and ISO 9001 compliance for all supplied equipment. Please provide:

CE Declaration of Conformity (DoC) for the BS3200D2/RV softener and for the upstream filter (SUFV 3" or FTA alternative). If not yet available, confirm CE marking will be provided at delivery.

List of applicable standards used for design and manufacture.

Confirm ISO 9001:2015 certification of the manufacturing facility (or equivalent quality management system).

Confirm that AKRO SRL holds the required importer/distributor authorization or equivalent documentation required for placing and supplying this equipment on the Romanian/EU market, as per the Caiet de Sarcini.

Waiting for the producer response in this direction

TQ-10 — Hydraulic Connections: Interface with Project Piping

The dimensional drawing BS-3200D2-RV confirms Inlet DN80 flanged / Outlet DN80 flanged / Drain 2". The project process line 00GHD01-BR001 is designed with DN100 PN16 flanged connections (carbon steel P265GH). The project drain line is DN50 PN16.

Confirm whether DN80-to-DN100 PN16 flanged transition spools / reducers are included in AKRO's scope of supply.

Yes this was taken into account in the mounting materials. [ mounting section from the offer] . Be aware that we where informed the current piping is PVC-U – Dn100 . If there is other material the costs will differ.

If you do not order this installing services than – flanges/transitions will not be include

Confirm whether a Drain 2"-to-DN50 PN16 flanged adapter is included in AKRO's scope.

Same answer as above. Be aware that if there is a longer distance than 5 m from the softener site up to the drainage – the mounting costs will increase

If any of the above transition pieces are excluded from scope: confirm who is responsible for supply and installation, and provide a budget price.

For all transition spools included in AKRO scope: specify the material, pressure rating, flange standard and confirm that bolts, nuts and gaskets are included.

Hello Ismail,

Thank you very much for the request!

I had a quick look on the documents you sent.

So based on this documents you are asking for a automatic filter with a screen of 50 microns + 1 duplex softener – dimensioned for 30m3/h considering a 6.22 0G Hardness in the brute water .

Based on my calculation you will need minimum 600 L of media on each column [ tank 36x72 ] – but the filtration velocity in this case will be around 47m/h – which is rather high for a softener!

I suggest using for this application at least 800-850L softener [ the tank used in this case is 42x72 ] – resulting a filtration velocity of 34m/h –assuring a medium contact time, or for a optimal filtration velocity – 48x72 tanks [ and 1000-1100L of resin on each tank] – resulting a velocity of around 26m/h.

For sure you want to integrate an industrial skid softener [ considering you also want to control the unit manually ]. I have sent you several photos with similar softeners integrated in different projects as a reference.

Now what is unclear for me in this tender - from the technical point of view, is the following:

What will this treated water be used for? Is this for a steam boiler?

I am asking this because the treated water parameters are a little problematic to be achieved:

the pH of 9.5-1.5 , but the initial pH is around 7.8 [ I think this can be assured only through dosing of NaOH in the water not to influence hardness ]

The iron level < 0.3μg/L – but the initial iron level is around 10 μg/L – so the softener will most probably adsorb a small part of the iron ions [ this as a secondary effect], but has no control on how much will be retained.

You need the Oxidability of the water to be 30 mgO2/L [ permanganate index] - [ this normally in the water treatment plants – means the water will be very contaminated with mostly organic compounds] – I think this is not correct asked .

Normally for this type of softeners the max operating pressure should not exceed 6-7bar. [ in the tender is asked for a 10bar system]

What is the current state of this tender – you are in construction phase/ project phase ?

I saw you also need a 2d/3d model for the softener in max 2 weeks from order, this I will need to check with the producer if it can be available or not . But first we need to clarify what type of vessel should we use, pipping of the skid, automation etc.

Can you tell me more about the scope of the treated water ?

For sure we can schedule a teams meeting as well in the following days, but I suggest first to have a clear view of what equipment will be proper for your application [ because depending of the options we are limited from each producer].

I am looking forward in receiving your response!

Best regards,

messages.body:
Salut Lucian,

Iti trimit anexata comanda pentru interventia de luni [ am luat in calcul deplasarea cu masina personala]

Maine dimineata voi avea totul pregatit pentru acest client .

Adresa :

Sat Dobriceni , str Caminului, nr 18 – Judetul Valcea

Alexandru Manea: 0742.873.917.

Vana de acolo este similara cu cea la care ai umblat [doar ca are numai 3 butoane]

Ca sa initiezi regenerare trebuie sa apesi simultan si sa mentii apasat – sageata sus+jos [ aprox 3 secunde]

Pentru reset ballast la sistemul UV [ dupa ce schimbi lampa ] trebuie urmatoa procedura:

Scoti din priza balastul;

Scoti lampa si o montezi pe cea noua [ cu grija ca este fragila]

Introduci lampa inapoi in reactor

Pe ballast , exista un buton de reset [ il apesi si il mentii apasat ]

Mentinand apasat balastul , reintroduce in priza sistemul si mentii butonul apasat pana cand scoate un sunet ascutit [ de obicei 3-5 secunde] – si afiseaza pe ecran 365 zile .

Cu respect,

attachments.text:
Tehnologie energetică

ZENNER

WPD / WPHD

Contor de apă compact
Tip Woltman paralel
Conceput pentru citire de la distanță
WPD / WPHD
Contor Woltman cu axul turbinei amplasat în paralel în raport cu directia fluxului.

Contoarele Woltman de tip paralel sunt
utilizate pentru măsurarea debitelor foarte
mari, cu un profil de debit constant.

Datorită designului lor robust, pot acoperi o
gamă variată de măsurători și pot oferi
rezultate precise ale măsurătorilor pe o
perioadă lungă de timp.

Caracteristici Aplicații

■ Debit redus de pornire, siguranță ridicată la
supraîncărcare ■ Măsurarea debitelor mari
■ Domeniu mare de măsurare, pierdere de presiune mică ■ Instalare orizontală sau verticală
■ Pentru măsurarea consumului de apă potabilă, apă ■ Apă rece până la 50°C
răcită și apă de serviciu până la 50°C
■ Optimizare pentru citirea de la distanță Opțiuni AMR
■ Constructie optimizata pentru reducerea fluxului
■ Echipabil cu până la 2 senzori tip REED
turbionar al apei in contor
■ Pulsator electronic
■ Nu este necesar un un tronson drept de conducta
■ M-bus (pe cablu)
inainte si dupa contor (U0 / D0, conform OIML R49 și
■ M-bus wireless conform OMS (Sistem de măsurare
DIN EN ISO 4064)
deschis)
■ Suport de măsurare repetabil (conform MID)
■ Sistem staționar GSM
■ Numărător de sticlă / cupru sigilat ermetic (IP68)
■ Materialele și straturile de acoperire au fost aprobate
în conformitate cu KTW / W 270

Mai multe despre M-bus cu fir Mai multe despre sistemul radio M-Bus wireless Mai multe despre sistemul staționar GSM
www. zenner. com/bus-systems.html www.zenner.com/opera.html www.zenner.com/gsm.html

Dear Nursel,

Thank you for your request!

I am responding bellow , marked with yellow to each question sent.

Could you confirm the following points?

That you can share the drawings and the 3D .step file

The Drawing attached is the only document we can provide [ BS-3200D2-RV] [ we do not have access to a Cad document for this]

Warranty period: 36 months

Yes, the warranty for this will be 36 months from the moment we deliver the unit in site

That, should we wish to conduct an inspection, you will provide the factory address and charge no fee for this

The Fabric of the softener unit is in Hungarry.

Adress :

EURO-CLEAR

9071 Gönyű, Béke utca. 2, Magyarország, Győr-Moson-Sopron

We will need to be informed with at least 1 week before arranging the visit! – there is not visit fee , but you will need to take care of your own transportation from airport – to fabric.

For Nobel – Milano – the filters producer, we do not have permission of visit

20% payment in advance, 60% payment before delivery of the goods, 20% payment at 15 days from commisioning, but no more than 45 days from delivery of the goods in site.

The payment method we can agree is – 40% in advance ; 40% before delivery of the goods , 20% payment at 15 days from commissioning but no more than 45 days from delivery in site .

That you can share the quality documentation

I am attaching all the quality documentation we can provide for this Softener unit + filters from Nobel.

Estimated elivery time: ?

At this moment we have a max delivery time of 12 weeks [ considering in August both fabrics are closed for 2-3 weeks], otherwise normal delivery of the goods will be max 9-10 weeks

is supervision required? if so, is it included in your proposal?

Supervision is not required considering we must also commission, and mount the system.

The process will happen in the following steps:

receive order + finalizing contract + prepayment

We order to production the Unit;

When everything is ready for delivery, we will pack everything on pallets and deliver to your site – again we need the payment confirmation of second invoice;

You must receive the pallets and safely deposit them. – this is in your charge

When you have the sight ready for us to mount the system [ including piping Dn100 up to the spot where we need to connect, the building itself and space, drainage – Dn50-80 , electric tension near the final position of the unit] , you must officially announce us and in max 2 weeks from this point we will send a service team to do the piping work and commissioning.

TQ-1 — Cyclic Capacity & Treated Water Quality

The AKRO datasheet for the BlueSoft BS-D2/RV series lists for the BS3200D2/RV model: resin volume 2 × 800 L and cyclic capacity 2 × 3,200 m³×°dH, with a salt consumption range of 80–192 kg per regeneration per column and flow rate 32–40 m³/h.

Please confirm and provide:

Confirm that the cyclic capacity of 2 × 3,200 m³×°dH stated in the datasheet applies to the exact unit offered under quotation S02146 (800 L resin per column).

Based on the data sheet of the producer, and the canature resin used inside the vessels, yes this is the theoretical and lab tested capacity.

However based on our experience, considering the brute water has also different metallic ions in smaller or greater concentrations [ like iron, manganese, aluminium and so on] –a cationic resin will be able to retain this ions as well, reducing punctual hardness exchange capacity. We normally do sizing calculations with a exchange capacity of around 3.2-3.3 m3 x 0dH / each L of resin.

Provide the performance calculation for the following evaluation basis: softened water flow rate Q = 30 m³/h; raw water hardness = 12.5 °Fr — please state the equivalent hardness in °dH used in your calculation; one column in service at a time (duplex alternating).

I will do the calculation with the tested physical ion exchange capacity of 3.3 0dH x m3 / L of resin. So we have 800L x 3.30dh = 26400dh x m3 / each tank.

Inlet water hardness is 12.50dF – this means it is roughly 70dH.

In this conditions, each column will regenerate after 2640 / 7 = around 375m3 of treated water .

State the calculated regeneration interval (hours) at the above conditions.

The system will work volumetric – this means it will regenerate each 375m3 of treated water.

If you have a constant 30m3/h flow – this means the regeneration will start each +-12.5 H

Confirm, as a contractual performance guarantee, that treated water hardness at the outlet will be ≤ 0.5 °Fr throughout the full service cycle — not only at the start of the cycle.

We will need to wait for the producer official response, but normally for the capacity presented above, we can guarantee.

However, because I see this is a very sensitive aspect, I suggest you to also install an on-line softener sensor/monitor to continuously check the water hardness on the outlet of the softener.[in this way you can assure all the parts work properly]. A Sycon 2800 or Testomat panel is around 5-6000 euro

Confirm the minimum number of regeneration cycles achievable with one full brine tank loading (project requires ≥ 10 cycles).

Again this is very hard to assure, because both the draw of the brine and filling is done through venturi injector. So depending of the inlet pressure fluctuation the system will bring more or less water in the brine tank.

If we discuss of ideal conditions than:

The ideal pure salt needed for regeneration of 1L of resin is around 120g/L of resin.

Considering the system has 800 L of resin, than we estimate a salt consumption of around 96kg of salt/ regeneration.

The brine tanks offered have a total capacity of 1500L

To dilute 96 kg of salt – you need around 280 L of water [ at a temperature of 200C]

To sum up, we have 10 x 96 kg /1.25[ salt density] + 280-300L of water for dissolving the salt needed for 1 regeneration = +-1070 L of media - so will fit in a 1500L brine tank .

TQ-3 — Operating Pressure & Booster Pump Requirement [CRITICAL]

This is the most critical open item. Two independent sources confirm the pressure gap:

• Your e-mail of 21 April 2026: "The softener unit requires a inlet water pressure of at least 2–2.5 bar – otherwise the system will not work properly."

• AKRO datasheet BS-D2/RV: Min. operating pressure = 200 kPa (2 bar).

The project specification (FT It-10.1 §1) defines the available potable water inlet pressure as 1–1.5 bar. This is the pressure available at the softening station inlet (line 00GHD01-BR001). The confirmed pressure deficit is 0.5–1.5 bar.

Please provide formal written responses to the following:

Confirm the exact minimum inlet pressure required for the BS3200D2/RV to operate correctly and guarantee the treated water performance specified in TQ-1.

MINIMUM WATER PRESSURE MUST BE 2-2.5BAR

MAX WATER PRESSURE 6 BAR

Is a booster/pressure-raising pump upstream of the softening station required to bridge this pressure gap?

We do not know the site conditions to make recommendations. Where does the brute water come from? If it is from municipality than yes a booster pump will help increasing the pressure for the system.

If a booster pump is required: is it included in AKRO's scope of supply under offer S02146? If not, please provide technical specifications and a budget price for a suitable booster pump and confirm whether AKRO can supply and install it within the same contract.

It is not included and the installation will not be included in our scope

If no booster pump is offered: please confirm explicitly that the system cannot be guaranteed to operate correctly at 1–1.5 bar inlet pressure, so that this can be formally assessed by the project designer.

The system will not operate correctly for a inlet water pressure that is not in the interval of 2-6bar

TQ-4 — Dimensions & Installation Envelope

A discrepancy has been identified between two AKRO documents provided:

• Dimensional drawing BS-3200D2-RV (AKRO Romania, January 2023): overall dimensions approx. 2,516 mm × 2,193 mm, installed height approx. 2,203 mm. Please be aware that in the drawing attached, you do not have the overall dimensions of the softener. You do not even have the total height of it .2203mm represents the total width in this positioning.

• AKRO datasheet BlueSoft BS-D2/RV (BlueSoft 3200D2/RV row): H × L × W = 2,425 × 3,200 × 2,750 mm, operating weight 2,430 kg.

Please clarify and provide:

Confirm which set of dimensions applies to the unit offered under quotation S02146 (800 L resin per column, 2 × 1,500 L brine tanks, SUFV 3" filter or FTA alternative).

For the softener please take into account the dimensions from the BlueSoft 3200D2/RV row from the data sheet present with the mention that the brine tanks can be freely positioned anywhere round the unit;

For the SUFV 3” – please take into account the dimensions from the data sheet link - https://akro.ro/public/fise/238-Fisa_tehnica_Filtru_cu_autocuratare_otel_carbon.pdf

Provide the final General Arrangement drawing for the complete supplied package, including: softener tanks; valve skid; brine tanks; filter system; inlet/outlet headers; drain connections; minimum maintenance clearances around the unit.

We cannot provide this drawings – this is design part

Minimum space required for maintenance – at least 0.5m around each unit .

Confirm the final empty weight and operating weight (kg) of the complete package as supplied.

I will give you the fully working total weight , considering the 2 brine tanks full with water + salt for 10 regenerations in each. + filter filled with water – total weight around 6.3 T

Note: The preliminary maximum installation height is 3,900 mm. Final site coordination is subject to design verification.

If this is the total available height of the room, than this is enough for installing the system . We will need around 3.5m for a easy fill of the unit with media.

TQ-5 — DCS Signals & Controller Integration

Your e-mail of 21 April states: "The system is able to send a signal through 2 dry contacts – that can be set only during the regeneration time."

The project specification (FT It-10.1 §1) requires the following signals to be exchanged with the plant central DCS:

Start/Stop command — binary input from DCS to the softening unit.

Unit status Running — binary output from unit to DCS.

Unit status Stopped — binary output from unit to DCS.

Unit status Regenerating — binary output from unit to DCS.

Based on your e-mail, we understand the 2 available dry contacts are active only during regeneration and are designed for triggering an external pump or valve — not for general status reporting or remote start/stop command. Please clarify:

Can the 2 dry contacts be configured to report any of the four DCS signals listed above? Please describe exactly what each contact can be set to signal.

Is a remote Start/Stop input from DCS to the unit possible with the standard RX-D2/RV controller?

Does the electronic controller feature an electronic display as required by the specification?

If the standard controller cannot provide the required DCS signals: can AKRO offer an alternative control panel or PLC upgrade? If yes, please provide specifications and the additional cost.

I will need to wait the producer automation manual to present to you and see what signals you can use . the dry contacts can deliver signal only during backwash steps.

Anyway, I want to assure you that this unit, or any other softener unit, cannot provide the signals you are asking without an external automation.

For example - Start/Stop – A softener unit never STOPS! this happens only when you close the water circuit, but the softener’s automation does not stopping the water flow.

So this control that you are asking, can be done but only with an external automation which is not included

TQ-6 — Upstream Filter: 50 Micron Requirement

Your e-mail confirms that a 50 micron solution would require 3× FTA 180/E 2" in parallel + FTA-DP controller, at approximately 3,200 € without VAT, in lieu of the offered SUFV 3" at 100 microns.

The project specification (FT It-10.1 §1) explicitly requires a self-cleaning filter with a stainless steel mesh rated at 50 microns. This is a stated technical requirement. Acceptance of a 100 micron filter instead of the specified 50 microns can only be considered subject to formal written approval by the project designer.

Please confirm and provide:

Is the mesh of the offered SUFV 3" filter constructed from stainless steel as required by the specification?

Yes, but the filtration efficiency is 100 microns.

Please formally include the 3× FTA 180/E 2" parallel filter configuration as a separate alternative line item in your revised offer, with full technical specifications, dimensional data, and the exact price delta versus the standard SUFV 3".

We do not recommend this solution . We gave it as alternative because you asked specifically for a NOBEL softener and most likely you have consider also their filters in the project. But installing 3 filters in parallel we cannot assure a perfect divide of the water flow through the 3 elements, so in time there might appear operating problems.

For the parallel FTA filter configuration: confirm that water flow to the softener is uninterrupted during automatic backwash of any individual filter element.

As I mentioned we do not recommend this solution. But if the designer included this type of filters in the project than he might answer you .

However, your request is not clear. So you ask for a automated self cleaning filter [ which will clean by itself every time the DP is reached] but it must deliver clean water 24h/day. Of course this is impossible – it is normal that during its cleaning procedure, the filter will not supply filtered water. Anyhow – the total cleaning time for a SUFV is less than a minute. If you still want this filtering stage to assure you non stop filtered water, than you need to mount a secondary SUF in parallel [1 A+1STBy] – the second unit + installing materials are not included in the offer.

TQ-7 — Materials in Contact with Potable Water

The softening station treats potable water (apă potabilă) for preparation of hot make-up water in the district heating circuit. Please confirm:

Now this is not clear at all. So the treated water will be used as make-up water in the closed heating circuit. Why does the system needs potable certificates ? will this closed circuit water be drank ? Please clarify in each point this water will be used as drinking water.

All materials in contact with the water — including resin, internal vessel lining, valves, seals, gaskets and brine tank components — are suitable for potable water application.

We can give you certificates only for:

Internal paint of the filter sufv – WRAS certif

Hygienic certificate for the CANATURE pressure vessels

Hygienic certificate for the resin

Hygienic certificate for the support gravel

Provide relevant certificates or declarations confirming potable water suitability (e.g. ACS, WRAS, KTW, or equivalent European approval).

The above mentioned certificates will be delivered with the equipment

TQ-8 — Warranty: Basis of Calculation

Offer S02146 states: "Warranty: 36 months from delivery of the goods". The project specification (FT It-10.1 §4) requires minimum 36 months from the date of commissioning (PIF — Punere în Funcțiune). Given that delivery and commissioning may be separated by several months, this is a material contractual difference.

Confirm whether you can agree to a warranty period of 36 months calculated from the date of commissioning (PIF).

The warranty will start from the delivery of the goods date

Confirm: defect resolution time ≤ 5 days from notification, and spare parts availability in the post-warranty period ≤ 15 days.

We can assure a <5 days response, not a resolution time.

If different components break [ like a electric valve] – we do not keep this in stock so it must be delivered from the supplier in order to be exchanged. Generally the delivery time is 1-2 weeks + service schedule time less than 7 days.

TQ-9 — CE Marking & Quality Documentation

The Caiet de Sarcini (§10) requires CE marking and ISO 9001 compliance for all supplied equipment. Please provide:

CE Declaration of Conformity (DoC) for the BS3200D2/RV softener and for the upstream filter (SUFV 3" or FTA alternative). If not yet available, confirm CE marking will be provided at delivery.

List of applicable standards used for design and manufacture.

Confirm ISO 9001:2015 certification of the manufacturing facility (or equivalent quality management system).

Confirm that AKRO SRL holds the required importer/distributor authorization or equivalent documentation required for placing and supplying this equipment on the Romanian/EU market, as per the Caiet de Sarcini.

Waiting for the producer response in this direction

TQ-10 — Hydraulic Connections: Interface with Project Piping

The dimensional drawing BS-3200D2-RV confirms Inlet DN80 flanged / Outlet DN80 flanged / Drain 2". The project process line 00GHD01-BR001 is designed with DN100 PN16 flanged connections (carbon steel P265GH). The project drain line is DN50 PN16.

Confirm whether DN80-to-DN100 PN16 flanged transition spools / reducers are included in AKRO's scope of supply.

Yes this was taken into account in the mounting materials. [ mounting section from the offer] . Be aware that we where informed the current piping is PVC-U – Dn100 . If there is other material the costs will differ.

If you do not order this installing services than – flanges/transitions will not be include

Confirm whether a Drain 2"-to-DN50 PN16 flanged adapter is included in AKRO's scope.

Same answer as above. Be aware that if there is a longer distance than 5 m from the softener site up to the drainage – the mounting costs will increase

If any of the above transition pieces are excluded from scope: confirm who is responsible for supply and installation, and provide a budget price.

For all transition spools included in AKRO scope: specify the material, pressure rating, flange standard and confirm that bolts, nuts and gaskets are included.
