Hello Ismail,

Thank you very much for the request!

I had a quick look on the documents you sent.

So based on this documents you are asking for a automatic filter with a screen of 50 microns + 1 duplex softener – dimensioned for 30m3/h considering a 6.22 0G Hardness in the brute water .

Based on my calculation you will need minimum 600 L of media on each column [ tank 36x72 ] – but the filtration velocity in this case will be around 47m/h – which is rather high for a softener!

I suggest using for this application at least 800-850L softener [ the tank used in this case is 42x72 ] – resulting a filtration velocity of 34m/h –assuring a medium contact time, or for a optimal filtration velocity – 48x72 tanks [ and 1000-1100L of resin on each tank] – resulting a velocity of around 26m/h.

For sure you want to integrate an industrial skid softener [ considering you also want to control the unit manually ]. I have sent you several photos with similar softeners integrated in different projects as a reference.

Now what is unclear for me in this tender - from the technical point of view, is the following:

What will this treated water be used for? Is this for a steam boiler?

I am asking this because the treated water parameters are a little problematic to be achieved:

the pH of 9.5-1.5 , but the initial pH is around 7.8 [ I think this can be assured only through dosing of NaOH in the water not to influence hardness ]

The iron level < 0.3μg/L – but the initial iron level is around 10 μg/L – so the softener will most probably adsorb a small part of the iron ions [ this as a secondary effect], but has no control on how much will be retained.

You need the Oxidability of the water to be 30 mgO2/L [ permanganate index] - [ this normally in the water treatment plants – means the water will be very contaminated with mostly organic compounds] – I think this is not correct asked .

Normally for this type of softeners the max operating pressure should not exceed 6-7bar. [ in the tender is asked for a 10bar system]

What is the current state of this tender – you are in construction phase/ project phase ?

I saw you also need a 2d/3d model for the softener in max 2 weeks from order, this I will need to check with the producer if it can be available or not . But first we need to clarify what type of vessel should we use, pipping of the skid, automation etc.

Can you tell me more about the scope of the treated water ?

For sure we can schedule a teams meeting as well in the following days, but I suggest first to have a clear view of what equipment will be proper for your application [ because depending of the options we are limited from each producer].

I am looking forward in receiving your response!

Best regards,

TQ-1 — Cyclic Capacity & Treated Water Quality

Inlet water hardness is 12.50dF – this means it is roughly 70dH.

In this conditions, each column will regenerate after 2640 / 7 = around 375m3 of treated water .

A Sycon 2800 or Testomat panel is around 5-6000 euro

Confirm the minimum number of regeneration cycles achievable with one full brine tank loading (project requires ≥ 10 cycles).

Again this is very hard to assure, because both the draw of the brine and filling is done through venturi injector. So depending of the inlet pressure fluctuation the system will bring more or less water in the brine tank.

The ideal pure salt needed for regeneration of 1L of resin is around 120g/L of resin.

Considering the system has 800 L of resin, than we estimate a salt consumption of around 96kg of salt/ regeneration.

The brine tanks offered have a total capacity of 1500L

To dilute 96 kg of salt – you need around 280 L of water [ at a temperature of 200C]

To sum up, we have 10 x 96 kg /1.25[ salt density] + 280-300L of water for dissolving the salt needed for 1 regeneration = +-1070 L of media - so will fit in a 1500L brine tank .

Hello Ismail,

Thank you very much for the request!

I had a quick look on the documents you sent.

So based on this documents you are asking for a automatic filter with a screen of 50 microns + 1 duplex softener – dimensioned for 30m3/h considering a 6.22 0G Hardness in the brute water .

Based on my calculation you will need minimum 600 L of media on each column [ tank 36x72 ] – but the filtration velocity in this case will be around 47m/h – which is rather high for a softener!

I suggest using for this application at least 800-850L softener [ the tank used in this case is 42x72 ] – resulting a filtration velocity of 34m/h –assuring a medium contact time, or for a optimal filtration velocity – 48x72 tanks [ and 1000-1100L of resin on each tank] – resulting a velocity of around 26m/h.

For sure you want to integrate an industrial skid softener [ considering you also want to control the unit manually ]. I have sent you several photos with similar softeners integrated in different projects as a reference.

Now what is unclear for me in this tender - from the technical point of view, is the following:

What will this treated water be used for? Is this for a steam boiler?

I am asking this because the treated water parameters are a little problematic to be achieved:

the pH of 9.5-1.5 , but the initial pH is around 7.8 [ I think this can be assured only through dosing of NaOH in the water not to influence hardness ]

The iron level < 0.3μg/L – but the initial iron level is around 10 μg/L – so the softener will most probably adsorb a small part of the iron ions [ this as a secondary effect], but has no control on how much will be retained.

You need the Oxidability of the water to be 30 mgO2/L [ permanganate index] - [ this normally in the water treatment plants – means the water will be very contaminated with mostly organic compounds] – I think this is not correct asked .

Normally for this type of softeners the max operating pressure should not exceed 6-7bar. [ in the tender is asked for a 10bar system]

What is the current state of this tender – you are in construction phase/ project phase ?

I saw you also need a 2d/3d model for the softener in max 2 weeks from order, this I will need to check with the producer if it can be available or not . But first we need to clarify what type of vessel should we use, pipping of the skid, automation etc.

Can you tell me more about the scope of the treated water ?

For sure we can schedule a teams meeting as well in the following days, but I suggest first to have a clear view of what equipment will be proper for your application [ because depending of the options we are limited from each producer].

I am looking forward in receiving your response!

Best regards,

TQ-1 — Cyclic Capacity & Treated Water Quality

The AKRO datasheet for the BlueSoft BS-D2/RV series lists for the BS3200D2/RV model: resin volume 2 × 800 L and cyclic capacity 2 × 3,200 m³×°dH, with a salt consumption range of 80–192 kg per regeneration per column and flow rate 32–40 m³/h.

Please confirm and provide:

Confirm that the cyclic capacity of 2 × 3,200 m³×°dH stated in the datasheet applies to the exact unit offered under quotation S02146 (800 L resin per column).

Based on the data sheet of the producer, and the canature resin used inside the vessels, yes this is the theoretical and lab tested capacity.

However based on our experience, considering the brute water has also different metallic ions in smaller or greater concentrations [ like iron, manganese, aluminium and so on] –a cationic resin will be able to retain this ions as well, reducing punctual hardness exchange capacity. We normally do sizing calculations with a exchange capacity of around 3.2-3.3 m3 x 0dH / each L of resin.

Provide the performance calculation for the following evaluation basis: softened water flow rate Q = 30 m³/h; raw water hardness = 12.5 °Fr — please state the equivalent hardness in °dH used in your calculation; one column in service at a time (duplex alternating).

I will do the calculation with the tested physical ion exchange capacity of 3.3 0dH x m3 / L of resin. So we have 800L x 3.30dh = 26400dh x m3 / each tank.

Inlet water hardness is 12.50dF – this means it is roughly 70dH.

In this conditions, each column will regenerate after 2640 / 7 = around 375m3 of treated water .

State the calculated regeneration interval (hours) at the above conditions.

The system will work volumetric – this means it will regenerate each 375m3 of treated water.

If you have a constant 30m3/h flow – this means the regeneration will start each +-12.5 H

Confirm, as a contractual performance guarantee, that treated water hardness at the outlet will be ≤ 0.5 °Fr throughout the full service cycle — not only at the start of the cycle.

We will need to wait for the producer official response, but normally for the capacity presented above, we can guarantee.

However, because I see this is a very sensitive aspect, I suggest you to also install an on-line softener sensor/monitor to continuously check the water hardness on the outlet of the softener.[in this way you can assure all the parts work properly]. A Sycon 2800 or Testomat panel is around 5-6000 euro

Confirm the minimum number of regeneration cycles achievable with one full brine tank loading (project requires ≥ 10 cycles).

Again this is very hard to assure, because both the draw of the brine and filling is done through venturi injector. So depending of the inlet pressure fluctuation the system will bring more or less water in the brine tank.

If we discuss of ideal conditions than:

The ideal pure salt needed for regeneration of 1L of resin is around 120g/L of resin.

Considering the system has 800 L of resin, than we estimate a salt consumption of around 96kg of salt/ regeneration.

The brine tanks offered have a total capacity of 1500L

To dilute 96 kg of salt – you need around 280 L of water [ at a temperature of 200C]

To sum up, we have 10 x 96 kg /1.25[ salt density] + 280-300L of water for dissolving the salt needed for 1 regeneration = +-1070 L of media - so will fit in a 1500L brine tank .

TQ-3 — Operating Pressure & Booster Pump Requirement [CRITICAL]

This is the most critical open item. Two independent sources confirm the pressure gap:

• Your e-mail of 21 April 2026: "The softener unit requires a inlet water pressure of at least 2–2.5 bar – otherwise the system will not work properly."

• AKRO datasheet BS-D2/RV: Min. operating pressure = 200 kPa (2 bar).

The project specification (FT It-10.1 §1) defines the available potable water inlet pressure as 1–1.5 bar. This is the pressure available at the softening station inlet (line 00GHD01-BR001). The confirmed pressure deficit is 0.5–1.5 bar.

Please provide formal written responses to the following:

Confirm the exact minimum inlet pressure required for the BS3200D2/RV to operate correctly and guarantee the treated water performance specified in TQ-1.

MINIMUM WATER PRESSURE MUST BE 2-2.5BAR

MAX WATER PRESSURE 6 BAR

Is a booster/pressure-raising pump upstream of the softening station required to bridge this pressure gap?

We do not know the site conditions to make recommendations. Where does the brute water come from? If it is from municipality than yes a booster pump will help increasing the pressure for the system.

If a booster pump is required: is it included in AKRO's scope of supply under offer S02146? If not, please provide technical specifications and a budget price for a suitable booster pump and confirm whether AKRO can supply and install it within the same contract.

It is not included and the installation will not be included in our scope

If no booster pump is offered: please confirm explicitly that the system cannot be guaranteed to operate correctly at 1–1.5 bar inlet pressure, so that this can be formally assessed by the project designer.

The system will not operate correctly for a inlet water pressure that is not in the interval of 2-6bar

TQ-4 — Dimensions & Installation Envelope

A discrepancy has been identified between two AKRO documents provided:

• Dimensional drawing BS-3200D2-RV (AKRO Romania, January 2023): overall dimensions approx. 2,516 mm × 2,193 mm, installed height approx. 2,203 mm. Please be aware that in the drawing attached, you do not have the overall dimensions of the softener. You do not even have the total height of it .2203mm represents the total width in this positioning.

• AKRO datasheet BlueSoft BS-D2/RV (BlueSoft 3200D2/RV row): H × L × W = 2,425 × 3,200 × 2,750 mm, operating weight 2,430 kg.

Please clarify and provide:

Confirm which set of dimensions applies to the unit offered under quotation S02146 (800 L resin per column, 2 × 1,500 L brine tanks, SUFV 3" filter or FTA alternative).

For the softener please take into account the dimensions from the BlueSoft 3200D2/RV row from the data sheet present with the mention that the brine tanks can be freely positioned anywhere round the unit;

For the SUFV 3” – please take into account the dimensions from the data sheet link - https://akro.ro/public/fise/238-Fisa_tehnica_Filtru_cu_autocuratare_otel_carbon.pdf

Provide the final General Arrangement drawing for the complete supplied package, including: softener tanks; valve skid; brine tanks; filter system; inlet/outlet headers; drain connections; minimum maintenance clearances around the unit.

We cannot provide this drawings – this is design part

Minimum space required for maintenance – at least 0.5m around each unit .

Confirm the final empty weight and operating weight (kg) of the complete package as supplied.

I will give you the fully working total weight , considering the 2 brine tanks full with water + salt for 10 regenerations in each. + filter filled with water – total weight around 6.3 T

Note: The preliminary maximum installation height is 3,900 mm. Final site coordination is subject to design verification.

If this is the total available height of the room, than this is enough for installing the system . We will need around 3.5m for a easy fill of the unit with media.

TQ-5 — DCS Signals & Controller Integration

Your e-mail of 21 April states: "The system is able to send a signal through 2 dry contacts – that can be set only during the regeneration time."

The project specification (FT It-10.1 §1) requires the following signals to be exchanged with the plant central DCS:

Start/Stop command — binary input from DCS to the softening unit.

Unit status Running — binary output from unit to DCS.

Unit status Stopped — binary output from unit to DCS.

Unit status Regenerating — binary output from unit to DCS.

Based on your e-mail, we understand the 2 available dry contacts are active only during regeneration and are designed for triggering an external pump or valve — not for general status reporting or remote start/stop command. Please clarify:

Can the 2 dry contacts be configured to report any of the four DCS signals listed above? Please describe exactly what each contact can be set to signal.

Is a remote Start/Stop input from DCS to the unit possible with the standard RX-D2/RV controller?

Does the electronic controller feature an electronic display as required by the specification?

If the standard controller cannot provide the required DCS signals: can AKRO offer an alternative control panel or PLC upgrade? If yes, please provide specifications and the additional cost.

I will need to wait the producer automation manual to present to you and see what signals you can use . the dry contacts can deliver signal only during backwash steps.

Anyway, I want to assure you that this unit, or any other softener unit, cannot provide the signals you are asking without an external automation.

For example - Start/Stop – A softener unit never STOPS! this happens only when you close the water circuit, but the softener’s automation does not stopping the water flow.

So this control that you are asking, can be done but only with an external automation which is not included

TQ-6 — Upstream Filter: 50 Micron Requirement

Your e-mail confirms that a 50 micron solution would require 3× FTA 180/E 2" in parallel + FTA-DP controller, at approximately 3,200 € without VAT, in lieu of the offered SUFV 3" at 100 microns.

The project specification (FT It-10.1 §1) explicitly requires a self-cleaning filter with a stainless steel mesh rated at 50 microns. This is a stated technical requirement. Acceptance of a 100 micron filter instead of the specified 50 microns can only be considered subject to formal written approval by the project designer.

Please confirm and provide:

Is the mesh of the offered SUFV 3" filter constructed from stainless steel as required by the specification?

Yes, but the filtration efficiency is 100 microns.

Please formally include the 3× FTA 180/E 2" parallel filter configuration as a separate alternative line item in your revised offer, with full technical specifications, dimensional data, and the exact price delta versus the standard SUFV 3".

We do not recommend this solution . We gave it as alternative because you asked specifically for a NOBEL softener and most likely you have consider also their filters in the project. But installing 3 filters in parallel we cannot assure a perfect divide of the water flow through the 3 elements, so in time there might appear operating problems.

For the parallel FTA filter configuration: confirm that water flow to the softener is uninterrupted during automatic backwash of any individual filter element.

As I mentioned we do not recommend this solution. But if the designer included this type of filters in the project than he might answer you .

However, your request is not clear. So you ask for a automated self cleaning filter [ which will clean by itself every time the DP is reached] but it must deliver clean water 24h/day. Of course this is impossible – it is normal that during its cleaning procedure, the filter will not supply filtered water. Anyhow – the total cleaning time for a SUFV is less than a minute. If you still want this filtering stage to assure you non stop filtered water, than you need to mount a secondary SUF in parallel [1 A+1STBy] – the second unit + installing materials are not included in the offer.

TQ-7 — Materials in Contact with Potable Water

The softening station treats potable water (apă potabilă) for preparation of hot make-up water in the district heating circuit. Please confirm:

Now this is not clear at all. So the treated water will be used as make-up water in the closed heating circuit. Why does the system needs potable certificates ? will this closed circuit water be drank ? Please clarify in each point this water will be used as drinking water.

All materials in contact with the water — including resin, internal vessel lining, valves, seals, gaskets and brine tank components — are suitable for potable water application.

We can give you certificates only for:

Internal paint of the filter sufv – WRAS certif

Hygienic certificate for the CANATURE pressure vessels

Hygienic certificate for the resin

Hygienic certificate for the support gravel

Provide relevant certificates or declarations confirming potable water suitability (e.g. ACS, WRAS, KTW, or equivalent European approval).

The above mentioned certificates will be delivered with the equipment

TQ-8 — Warranty: Basis of Calculation

Offer S02146 states: "Warranty: 36 months from delivery of the goods". The project specification (FT It-10.1 §4) requires minimum 36 months from the date of commissioning (PIF — Punere în Funcțiune). Given that delivery and commissioning may be separated by several months, this is a material contractual difference.

Confirm whether you can agree to a warranty period of 36 months calculated from the date of commissioning (PIF).

The warranty will start from the delivery of the goods date

Confirm: defect resolution time ≤ 5 days from notification, and spare parts availability in the post-warranty period ≤ 15 days.

We can assure a <5 days response, not a resolution time.

If different components break [ like a electric valve] – we do not keep this in stock so it must be delivered from the supplier in order to be exchanged. Generally the delivery time is 1-2 weeks + service schedule time less than 7 days.

TQ-9 — CE Marking & Quality Documentation

The Caiet de Sarcini (§10) requires CE marking and ISO 9001 compliance for all supplied equipment. Please provide:

CE Declaration of Conformity (DoC) for the BS3200D2/RV softener and for the upstream filter (SUFV 3" or FTA alternative). If not yet available, confirm CE marking will be provided at delivery.

List of applicable standards used for design and manufacture.

Confirm ISO 9001:2015 certification of the manufacturing facility (or equivalent quality management system).

Confirm that AKRO SRL holds the required importer/distributor authorization or equivalent documentation required for placing and supplying this equipment on the Romanian/EU market, as per the Caiet de Sarcini.

Waiting for the producer response in this direction

TQ-10 — Hydraulic Connections: Interface with Project Piping

The dimensional drawing BS-3200D2-RV confirms Inlet DN80 flanged / Outlet DN80 flanged / Drain 2". The project process line 00GHD01-BR001 is designed with DN100 PN16 flanged connections (carbon steel P265GH). The project drain line is DN50 PN16.

Hello Ismail,

Thank you very much for the request!

I had a quick look on the documents you sent.

So based on this documents you are asking for a automatic filter with a screen of 50 microns + 1 duplex softener – dimensioned for 30m3/h considering a 6.22 0G Hardness in the brute water .

Based on my calculation you will need minimum 600 L of media on each column [ tank 36x72 ] – but the filtration velocity in this case will be around 47m/h – which is rather high for a softener!

I suggest using for this application at least 800-850L softener [ the tank used in this case is 42x72 ] – resulting a filtration velocity of 34m/h –assuring a medium contact time, or for a optimal filtration velocity – 48x72 tanks [ and 1000-1100L of resin on each tank] – resulting a velocity of around 26m/h.

For sure you want to integrate an industrial skid softener [ considering you also want to control the unit manually ]. I have sent you several photos with similar softeners integrated in different projects as a reference.

Now what is unclear for me in this tender - from the technical point of view, is the following:

What will this treated water be used for? Is this for a steam boiler?

I am asking this because the treated water parameters are a little problematic to be achieved:

the pH of 9.5-1.5 , but the initial pH is around 7.8 [ I think this can be assured only through dosing of NaOH in the water not to influence hardness ]

The iron level < 0.3μg/L – but the initial iron level is around 10 μg/L – so the softener will most probably adsorb a small part of the iron ions [ this as a secondary effect], but has no control on how much will be retained.

You need the Oxidability of the water to be 30 mgO2/L [ permanganate index] - [ this normally in the water treatment plants – means the water will be very contaminated with mostly organic compounds] – I think this is not correct asked .

Normally for this type of softeners the max operating pressure should not exceed 6-7bar. [ in the tender is asked for a 10bar system]

What is the current state of this tender – you are in construction phase/ project phase ?

I saw you also need a 2d/3d model for the softener in max 2 weeks from order, this I will need to check with the producer if it can be available or not . But first we need to clarify what type of vessel should we use, pipping of the skid, automation etc.

Can you tell me more about the scope of the treated water ?

For sure we can schedule a teams meeting as well in the following days, but I suggest first to have a clear view of what equipment will be proper for your application [ because depending of the options we are limited from each producer].

I am looking forward in receiving your response!

Best regards,

TQ-1 — Cyclic Capacity & Treated Water Quality

The AKRO datasheet for the BlueSoft BS-D2/RV series lists for the BS3200D2/RV model: resin volume 2 × 800 L and cyclic capacity 2 × 3,200 m³×°dH, with a salt consumption range of 80–192 kg per regeneration per column and flow rate 32–40 m³/h.

Please confirm and provide:

Confirm that the cyclic capacity of 2 × 3,200 m³×°dH stated in the datasheet applies to the exact unit offered under quotation S02146 (800 L resin per column).

Based on the data sheet of the producer, and the canature resin used inside the vessels, yes this is the theoretical and lab tested capacity.

However based on our experience, considering the brute water has also different metallic ions in smaller or greater concentrations [ like iron, manganese, aluminium and so on] –a cationic resin will be able to retain this ions as well, reducing punctual hardness exchange capacity. We normally do sizing calculations with a exchange capacity of around 3.2-3.3 m3 x 0dH / each L of resin.

Provide the performance calculation for the following evaluation basis: softened water flow rate Q = 30 m³/h; raw water hardness = 12.5 °Fr — please state the equivalent hardness in °dH used in your calculation; one column in service at a time (duplex alternating).

I will do the calculation with the tested physical ion exchange capacity of 3.3 0dH x m3 / L of resin. So we have 800L x 3.30dh = 26400dh x m3 / each tank.

Inlet water hardness is 12.50dF – this means it is roughly 70dH.

In this conditions, each column will regenerate after 2640 / 7 = around 375m3 of treated water .

State the calculated regeneration interval (hours) at the above conditions.

The system will work volumetric – this means it will regenerate each 375m3 of treated water.

If you have a constant 30m3/h flow – this means the regeneration will start each +-12.5 H

Confirm, as a contractual performance guarantee, that treated water hardness at the outlet will be ≤ 0.5 °Fr throughout the full service cycle — not only at the start of the cycle.

We will need to wait for the producer official response, but normally for the capacity presented above, we can guarantee.

However, because I see this is a very sensitive aspect, I suggest you to also install an on-line softener sensor/monitor to continuously check the water hardness on the outlet of the softener.[in this way you can assure all the parts work properly]. A Sycon 2800 or Testomat panel is around 5-6000 euro

Confirm the minimum number of regeneration cycles achievable with one full brine tank loading (project requires ≥ 10 cycles).

Again this is very hard to assure, because both the draw of the brine and filling is done through venturi injector. So depending of the inlet pressure fluctuation the system will bring more or less water in the brine tank.

If we discuss of ideal conditions than:

The ideal pure salt needed for regeneration of 1L of resin is around 120g/L of resin.

Considering the system has 800 L of resin, than we estimate a salt consumption of around 96kg of salt/ regeneration.

The brine tanks offered have a total capacity of 1500L

To dilute 96 kg of salt – you need around 280 L of water [ at a temperature of 200C]

To sum up, we have 10 x 96 kg /1.25[ salt density] + 280-300L of water for dissolving the salt needed for 1 regeneration = +-1070 L of media - so will fit in a 1500L brine tank .

Is a booster/pressure-raising pump upstream of the softening station required to bridge this pressure gap?

We do not know the site conditions to make recommendations. Where does the brute water come from? If it is from municipality than yes a booster pump will help increasing the pressure for the system.

If a booster pump is required: is it included in AKRO's scope of supply under offer S02146? If not, please provide technical specifications and a budget price for a suitable booster pump and confirm whether AKRO can supply and install it within the same contract.

It is not included and the installation will not be included in our scope

If no booster pump is offered: please confirm explicitly that the system cannot be guaranteed to operate correctly at 1–1.5 bar inlet pressure, so that this can be formally assessed by the project designer.

The system will not operate correctly for a inlet water pressure that is not in the interval of 2-6bar

TQ-4 — Dimensions & Installation Envelope

A discrepancy has been identified between two AKRO documents provided:

• Dimensional drawing BS-3200D2-RV (AKRO Romania, January 2023): overall dimensions approx. 2,516 mm × 2,193 mm, installed height approx. 2,203 mm. Please be aware that in the drawing attached, you do not have the overall dimensions of the softener. You do not even have the total height of it .2203mm represents the total width in this positioning.

• AKRO datasheet BlueSoft BS-D2/RV (BlueSoft 3200D2/RV row): H × L × W = 2,425 × 3,200 × 2,750 mm, operating weight 2,430 kg.

Please clarify and provide:

Confirm which set of dimensions applies to the unit offered under quotation S02146 (800 L resin per column, 2 × 1,500 L brine tanks, SUFV 3" filter or FTA alternative).

For the softener please take into account the dimensions from the BlueSoft 3200D2/RV row from the data sheet present with the mention that the brine tanks can be freely positioned anywhere round the unit;

For the SUFV 3” – please take into account the dimensions from the data sheet link - https://akro.ro/public/fise/238-Fisa_tehnica_Filtru_cu_autocuratare_otel_carbon.pdf

Provide the final General Arrangement drawing for the complete supplied package, including: softener tanks; valve skid; brine tanks; filter system; inlet/outlet headers; drain connections; minimum maintenance clearances around the unit.

We cannot provide this drawings – this is design part

Minimum space required for maintenance – at least 0.5m around each unit .

Confirm the final empty weight and operating weight (kg) of the complete package as supplied.

I will give you the fully working total weight , considering the 2 brine tanks full with water + salt for 10 regenerations in each. + filter filled with water – total weight around 6.3 T

Note: The preliminary maximum installation height is 3,900 mm. Final site coordination is subject to design verification.

If this is the total available height of the room, than this is enough for installing the system . We will need around 3.5m for a easy fill of the unit with media.

TQ-5 — DCS Signals & Controller Integration

Your e-mail of 21 April states: "The system is able to send a signal through 2 dry contacts – that can be set only during the regeneration time."

The project specification (FT It-10.1 §1) requires the following signals to be exchanged with the plant central DCS:

Start/Stop command — binary input from DCS to the softening unit.

Unit status Running — binary output from unit to DCS.

Unit status Stopped — binary output from unit to DCS.

Unit status Regenerating — binary output from unit to DCS.

Based on your e-mail, we understand the 2 available dry contacts are active only during regeneration and are designed for triggering an external pump or valve — not for general status reporting or remote start/stop command. Please clarify:

Can the 2 dry contacts be configured to report any of the four DCS signals listed above? Please describe exactly what each contact can be set to signal.

Is a remote Start/Stop input from DCS to the unit possible with the standard RX-D2/RV controller?

Does the electronic controller feature an electronic display as required by the specification?

If the standard controller cannot provide the required DCS signals: can AKRO offer an alternative control panel or PLC upgrade? If yes, please provide specifications and the additional cost.

I will need to wait the producer automation manual to present to you and see what signals you can use . the dry contacts can deliver signal only during backwash steps.

Anyway, I want to assure you that this unit, or any other softener unit, cannot provide the signals you are asking without an external automation.

For example - Start/Stop – A softener unit never STOPS! this happens only when you close the water circuit, but the softener’s automation does not stopping the water flow.

So this control that you are asking, can be done but only with an external automation which is not included

TQ-6 — Upstream Filter: 50 Micron Requirement

Your e-mail confirms that a 50 micron solution would require 3× FTA 180/E 2" in parallel + FTA-DP controller, at approximately 3,200 € without VAT, in lieu of the offered SUFV 3" at 100 microns.

The project specification (FT It-10.1 §1) explicitly requires a self-cleaning filter with a stainless steel mesh rated at 50 microns. This is a stated technical requirement. Acceptance of a 100 micron filter instead of the specified 50 microns can only be considered subject to formal written approval by the project designer.

Please confirm and provide:

Is the mesh of the offered SUFV 3" filter constructed from stainless steel as required by the specification?

Yes, but the filtration efficiency is 100 microns.

We do not recommend this solution . We gave it as alternative because you asked specifically for a NOBEL softener and most likely you have consider also their filters in the project. But installing 3 filters in parallel we cannot assure a perfect divide of the water flow through the 3 elements, so in time there might appear operating problems.

For the parallel FTA filter configuration: confirm that water flow to the softener is uninterrupted during automatic backwash of any individual filter element.

As I mentioned we do not recommend this solution. But if the designer included this type of filters in the project than he might answer you .

However, your request is not clear. So you ask for a automated self cleaning filter [ which will clean by itself every time the DP is reached] but it must deliver clean water 24h/day. Of course this is impossible – it is normal that during its cleaning procedure, the filter will not supply filtered water. Anyhow – the total cleaning time for a SUFV is less than a minute. If you still want this filtering stage to assure you non stop filtered water, than you need to mount a secondary SUF in parallel [1 A+1STBy] – the second unit + installing materials are not included in the offer.

TQ-7 — Materials in Contact with Potable Water

The softening station treats potable water (apă potabilă) for preparation of hot make-up water in the district heating circuit. Please confirm:

Now this is not clear at all. So the treated water will be used as make-up water in the closed heating circuit. Why does the system needs potable certificates ? will this closed circuit water be drank ? Please clarify in each point this water will be used as drinking water.

All materials in contact with the water — including resin, internal vessel lining, valves, seals, gaskets and brine tank components — are suitable for potable water application.

We can give you certificates only for:

Hygienic certificate for the CANATURE pressure vessels

Hygienic certificate for the resin

Hygienic certificate for the support gravel

Provide relevant certificates or declarations confirming potable water suitability (e.g. ACS, WRAS, KTW, or equivalent European approval).

The above mentioned certificates will be delivered with the equipment

TQ-8 — Warranty: Basis of Calculation

Offer S02146 states: "Warranty: 36 months from delivery of the goods". The project specification (FT It-10.1 §4) requires minimum 36 months from the date of commissioning (PIF — Punere în Funcțiune). Given that delivery and commissioning may be separated by several months, this is a material contractual difference.

Confirm whether you can agree to a warranty period of 36 months calculated from the date of commissioning (PIF).

The warranty will start from the delivery of the goods date

Confirm: defect resolution time ≤ 5 days from notification, and spare parts availability in the post-warranty period ≤ 15 days.

We can assure a <5 days response, not a resolution time.

If different components break [ like a electric valve] – we do not keep this in stock so it must be delivered from the supplier in order to be exchanged. Generally the delivery time is 1-2 weeks + service schedule time less than 7 days.

TQ-9 — CE Marking & Quality Documentation

The Caiet de Sarcini (§10) requires CE marking and ISO 9001 compliance for all supplied equipment. Please provide:

CE Declaration of Conformity (DoC) for the BS3200D2/RV softener and for the upstream filter (SUFV 3" or FTA alternative). If not yet available, confirm CE marking will be provided at delivery.

List of applicable standards used for design and manufacture.

Confirm that AKRO SRL holds the required importer/distributor authorization or equivalent documentation required for placing and supplying this equipment on the Romanian/EU market, as per the Caiet de Sarcini.

Waiting for the producer response in this direction

TQ-10 — Hydraulic Connections: Interface with Project Piping

The dimensional drawing BS-3200D2-RV confirms Inlet DN80 flanged / Outlet DN80 flanged / Drain 2". The project process line 00GHD01-BR001 is designed with DN100 PN16 flanged connections (carbon steel P265GH). The project drain line is DN50 PN16.

Hello Ismail,

Thank you very much for the request!

I had a quick look on the documents you sent.

So based on this documents you are asking for a automatic filter with a screen of 50 microns + 1 duplex softener – dimensioned for 30m3/h considering a 6.22 0G Hardness in the brute water .

Based on my calculation you will need minimum 600 L of media on each column [ tank 36x72 ] – but the filtration velocity in this case will be around 47m/h – which is rather high for a softener!

I suggest using for this application at least 800-850L softener [ the tank used in this case is 42x72 ] – resulting a filtration velocity of 34m/h –assuring a medium contact time, or for a optimal filtration velocity – 48x72 tanks [ and 1000-1100L of resin on each tank] – resulting a velocity of around 26m/h.

For sure you want to integrate an industrial skid softener [ considering you also want to control the unit manually ]. I have sent you several photos with similar softeners integrated in different projects as a reference.

Now what is unclear for me in this tender - from the technical point of view, is the following:

What will this treated water be used for? Is this for a steam boiler?

I am asking this because the treated water parameters are a little problematic to be achieved:

the pH of 9.5-1.5 , but the initial pH is around 7.8 [ I think this can be assured only through dosing of NaOH in the water not to influence hardness ]

The iron level < 0.3μg/L – but the initial iron level is around 10 μg/L – so the softener will most probably adsorb a small part of the iron ions [ this as a secondary effect], but has no control on how much will be retained.

You need the Oxidability of the water to be 30 mgO2/L [ permanganate index] - [ this normally in the water treatment plants – means the water will be very contaminated with mostly organic compounds] – I think this is not correct asked .

Normally for this type of softeners the max operating pressure should not exceed 6-7bar. [ in the tender is asked for a 10bar system]

What is the current state of this tender – you are in construction phase/ project phase ?

I saw you also need a 2d/3d model for the softener in max 2 weeks from order, this I will need to check with the producer if it can be available or not . But first we need to clarify what type of vessel should we use, pipping of the skid, automation etc.

Can you tell me more about the scope of the treated water ?

For sure we can schedule a teams meeting as well in the following days, but I suggest first to have a clear view of what equipment will be proper for your application [ because depending of the options we are limited from each producer].

I am looking forward in receiving your response!

Best regards,

Subject: Solicitare sistem complet tratare apa uz menajer, sursa put forat, debit 20 mc/h

Buna, Alexandru,

Poti te rog sa imi recomanzi o solutie completa de tratare a apei pentru un client. Datele sunt urmatoarele:

susa de apa din put forat, are infiltratii- a transmis buletinul de analiza a apei

debit max 20 mc/h ( nominal 16.2 mc/h) pentru uz menajer campus (grup hotelier),

doreste o solutie completa de tratare a apei: eventual osmoza daca este cazul, filtru mecanic cu autocuratare, sistem UV cu curatare automata a tecilor (are impuritati in apa), rezervor tampon, pompa.

Am vorbit cu clientul. Nu are alte informatii inafara de cele de mai sus si buletinul atasat. In principiu a zius ac doreste sa rezolve urmatoarele aspecte ale apei: clorurile, NH4, fier, mangan, bacteriile prezente. Vrea sa includem si un rezervor tampon.

Daca totusi mai sunt necesare informatii, te rog sa imi spui si voi reveni catre client.

Multumesc!

Cu stima/Best regards,

MVB
Standard multi-cartridge filter housings
MVB are typical general purpose multi-cartridge filter housings, the largest
ones can handle flow-rates to 45 m3/h.

Standard material is 316 stainless steel to offer a wide chemical compatibility
and easy cleaning.

Internals are designed to hold the most common cartridge configurations:

x
x
A1M – double open ended with polypropylene internals

x
A1S – double open ended with stainless-steel internals

x
P8 – 2-222 standard o rings with spear

x
C8 – 2-222 standard o rings with flat end
P7 – 2-226 standard o rings with bayonet and spear

All MVB filter housings can accept every kind of standard elements; melt-
blown cartridges, string-wound elements, pleated disposable and metallic
cleanable.

By changing the bell, different cartridge length can fit the same housing, this
enhance the flexibility of the filter offering the possibility of future increase of
the flow-rate just making few easy interventions.

Standard IN-OUT connections are BSP threaded male or female. Many
adaptors are available to fit different standards such as DIN 11851, Tri Clover
etc.
All MVB’s can also be provided with standard flanges.
Standard finish is pickling plus outer mechanical polishing, electro-polishing
is also available on application.
All filters are provided with stainless steel adjustable legs as standard.

messages.body:
Ziua buna Dl Pancescu,

Daca sistemul curge la Flansa tankului, atunci cel mai probabil problema este de etansare [ ori tankul a crapat la nivelul gatului, ori adaptorul [ care este pus intre vana si tank] – este uzat/garnituri uzate.

Daca vana nu indica probleme electronice [ face ce trebuie] – atunci aceasta nu trebuie schimbata.

Ati putea sa desfasurati carpa din jurul gatului de la dedurizare? [ sa vedeti exact ce este acolo si de unde curge].

Vom mai avea nevoie sa mai cunoastem:

Dimensiunea tankului de presiune [ vedeti daca gasiti eticheta pe acesta – fotografie la ea] – daca nu, avem nevoie de circumferinta / inaltime totata si o poza de ansamblu a tankului]

Vom avea nevoie de o poza de pe capul de vana [ in lateralul vanei – chiar pe gatul vanei care intra in tank , este de regula un cod WS1…. ] – avem nevoie de o poza si la aceasta .

Asteptam cu interes raspunsul dumneavoastra !

Numai bine,

TQ-1 — Cyclic Capacity & Treated Water Quality

The AKRO datasheet for the BlueSoft BS-D2/RV series lists for the BS3200D2/RV model: resin volume 2 × 800 L and cyclic capacity 2 × 3,200 m³×°dH, with a salt consumption range of 80–192 kg per regeneration per column and flow rate 32–40 m³/h.

Please confirm and provide:

Confirm that the cyclic capacity of 2 × 3,200 m³×°dH stated in the datasheet applies to the exact unit offered under quotation S02146 (800 L resin per column).

Based on the data sheet of the producer, and the canature resin used inside the vessels, yes this is the theoretical and lab tested capacity.

However based on our experience, considering the brute water has also different metallic ions in smaller or greater concentrations [ like iron, manganese, aluminium and so on] –a cationic resin will be able to retain this ions as well, reducing punctual hardness exchange capacity. We normally do sizing calculations with a exchange capacity of around 3.2-3.3 m3 x 0dH / each L of resin.

Provide the performance calculation for the following evaluation basis: softened water flow rate Q = 30 m³/h; raw water hardness = 12.5 °Fr — please state the equivalent hardness in °dH used in your calculation; one column in service at a time (duplex alternating).

I will do the calculation with the tested physical ion exchange capacity of 3.3 0dH x m3 / L of resin. So we have 800L x 3.30dh = 26400dh x m3 / each tank.

Inlet water hardness is 12.50dF – this means it is roughly 70dH.

In this conditions, each column will regenerate after 2640 / 7 = around 375m3 of treated water .

State the calculated regeneration interval (hours) at the above conditions.

The system will work volumetric – this means it will regenerate each 375m3 of treated water.

If you have a constant 30m3/h flow – this means the regeneration will start each +-12.5 H

Confirm, as a contractual performance guarantee, that treated water hardness at the outlet will be ≤ 0.5 °Fr throughout the full service cycle — not only at the start of the cycle.

We will need to wait for the producer official response, but normally for the capacity presented above, we can guarantee.

However, because I see this is a very sensitive aspect, I suggest you to also install an on-line softener sensor/monitor to continuously check the water hardness on the outlet of the softener.[in this way you can assure all the parts work properly]. A Sycon 2800 or Testomat panel is around 5-6000 euro

Confirm the minimum number of regeneration cycles achievable with one full brine tank loading (project requires ≥ 10 cycles).

Again this is very hard to assure, because both the draw of the brine and filling is done through venturi injector. So depending of the inlet pressure fluctuation the system will bring more or less water in the brine tank.

If we discuss of ideal conditions than:

The ideal pure salt needed for regeneration of 1L of resin is around 120g/L of resin.

Considering the system has 800 L of resin, than we estimate a salt consumption of around 96kg of salt/ regeneration.

The brine tanks offered have a total capacity of 1500L

To dilute 96 kg of salt – you need around 280 L of water [ at a temperature of 200C]

To sum up, we have 10 x 96 kg /1.25[ salt density] + 280-300L of water for dissolving the salt needed for 1 regeneration = +-1070 L of media - so will fit in a 1500L brine tank .

The max operating water pressure for this type of systems is 6 BAR

System works automatically based on volume of treated water. You can activate regeneration also manually from the control panel. Be aware you cannot individually close/open the electrical valves from the skid manually.

Regarding the signals. The system is able to send a signal through 2 dry contacts – that can be set only during the regeneration time. [ this 2 contacts are normally used when the system needs to start a external pump in case of different source of water for backwash or a valve] .

We can also separately present you a list of mandatory components for the proposed system [ mostly electrical valves ], but we are able to provide this only if you agree with the technical solution.

I am looking forward in receiving your feedback.

Hello Ismail,

Thank you very much for the request!

I had a quick look on the documents you sent.

So based on this documents you are asking for a automatic filter with a screen of 50 microns + 1 duplex softener – dimensioned for 30m3/h considering a 6.22 0G Hardness in the brute water .

Based on my calculation you will need minimum 600 L of media on each column [ tank 36x72 ] – but the filtration velocity in this case will be around 47m/h – which is rather high for a softener!

I suggest using for this application at least 800-850L softener [ the tank used in this case is 42x72 ] – resulting a filtration velocity of 34m/h –assuring a medium contact time, or for a optimal filtration velocity – 48x72 tanks [ and 1000-1100L of resin on each tank] – resulting a velocity of around 26m/h.

For sure you want to integrate an industrial skid softener [ considering you also want to control the unit manually ]. I have sent you several photos with similar softeners integrated in different projects as a reference.

Now what is unclear for me in this tender - from the technical point of view, is the following:

What will this treated water be used for? Is this for a steam boiler?

I am asking this because the treated water parameters are a little problematic to be achieved:

the pH of 9.5-1.5 , but the initial pH is around 7.8 [ I think this can be assured only through dosing of NaOH in the water not to influence hardness ]

The iron level < 0.3μg/L – but the initial iron level is around 10 μg/L – so the softener will most probably adsorb a small part of the iron ions [ this as a secondary effect], but has no control on how much will be retained.

You need the Oxidability of the water to be 30 mgO2/L [ permanganate index] - [ this normally in the water treatment plants – means the water will be very contaminated with mostly organic compounds] – I think this is not correct asked .

Normally for this type of softeners the max operating pressure should not exceed 6-7bar. [ in the tender is asked for a 10bar system]

What is the current state of this tender – you are in construction phase/ project phase ?

I saw you also need a 2d/3d model for the softener in max 2 weeks from order, this I will need to check with the producer if it can be available or not . But first we need to clarify what type of vessel should we use, pipping of the skid, automation etc.

Can you tell me more about the scope of the treated water ?

For sure we can schedule a teams meeting as well in the following days, but I suggest first to have a clear view of what equipment will be proper for your application [ because depending of the options we are limited from each producer].

I am looking forward in receiving your response!

Buna ziua,

Revin la discutia telefonica avuta mai devreme,

Lucrarea in discutie a fost aprobata la nivel de necesitate, in componenta de pachet propusa de dvs in oferta S02384 / 09.06.2026.

Am confirmat ca pachetul va include si urmatoarele elemente:

- livrarea statiei in stare premontata si programata la setarile comunicate de reprezentantul tehnic Airbus inainte de premontaj / livrare;

Livrarea se face cu toate setarile vanelor efectuate + instructiuni de asamblare si incarcare pe pozitie.

- certificate CE si declaratii de conformitate pentru elementele componente ale statiei;

Anexat trimitem toate certificarile disponibile pentru gama aceasta de produs

- certificat pentru utilizare in industria alimentara;

Anexate

- manual de instructiuni de utilizare in limba romana;

Anexat manualul operatorului in limba romana. Las anexat si manualul in limba engleza al capului de vana

- disponbilitatea reprezentantului dvs de a acorda asistenta telefonica (sau online) la momentul punerii in functiune, daca va fi nevoie.

Putem asigura asistenta tehnica telefonica

Suplimentar, este nevoie de:

- garantie de 24 luni - va rog specificati daca sunt conditii speciale de intretinere de respectat; - se va acorda garantie 24 de luni de la livrarea produselor

- termen de plata de 30 de zile final de luna – se accepta plata integrala la 30 de zile de la livrare

- buget achizitie - trebuie sa ne apropiem de valoarea de 9000 eur; s-a acordat suplimentar 1% discount la oferta

Va rog sa regasiti anexata oferta actualizata conform noilor conditii – in moneda RON

In alta ordine de idei, procesul nostru formal va dura aprox 1 saptamana - colectare date furnizor, creare in sistem, screening, contractare, comanda.

Pentru a demara, va trimit pentru completare:

- formularul cu datele dvs de identificare,

- acord Codul de conduita al furnizorilor

Care este termenul de livrare realizabil pentru o comanda lansata pana la finele saptamanii viitoare?

Estimatul de livrare este de aprox 3-5 saptamani in cazul in care comanda ajunge la noi saptamana viitoare [ in luna august furnizorii lucreaza cu capacitate redusa sau au inchis 2 saptamani – vacanta de vara] .

Multumesc, astept raspunsul dvs,

Kind regards / Mit freundlichen Gruessen / Cu stima,

messages.body:
Buna ziua Dl Dumitru,

Va multumim pentru solicitarea dumneavoastra!

Turbiditatea [ coloritul apei] – poate fi retinuta numai prin filtrare in profunzime [ fie cartuse , dar cel mai bine prin masa filtranta].

De asemenea turbiditatea, poate fi cauzata de anumiti compusi dizolvati in apa bruta, care in momentul in care iau contact cu aerul oxideaza [ cum ar fi fierul, manganul ]. Aveti un buletin de analiza al apei brute?

Firma AKRO furnizeaza solutii si echipamente de tratare apa primara – in aplicatii industriale.

Va rog sa ne lasati si un numar de contact .

TQ-1 — Cyclic Capacity & Treated Water Quality

The AKRO datasheet for the BlueSoft BS-D2/RV series lists for the BS3200D2/RV model: resin volume 2 × 800 L and cyclic capacity 2 × 3,200 m³×°dH, with a salt consumption range of 80–192 kg per regeneration per column and flow rate 32–40 m³/h.

Please confirm and provide:

Confirm that the cyclic capacity of 2 × 3,200 m³×°dH stated in the datasheet applies to the exact unit offered under quotation S02146 (800 L resin per column).

Based on the data sheet of the producer, and the canature resin used inside the vessels, yes this is the theoretical and lab tested capacity.

However based on our experience, considering the brute water has also different metallic ions in smaller or greater concentrations [ like iron, manganese, aluminium and so on] –a cationic resin will be able to retain this ions as well, reducing punctual hardness exchange capacity. We normally do sizing calculations with a exchange capacity of around 3.2-3.3 m3 x 0dH / each L of resin.

Provide the performance calculation for the following evaluation basis: softened water flow rate Q = 30 m³/h; raw water hardness = 12.5 °Fr — please state the equivalent hardness in °dH used in your calculation; one column in service at a time (duplex alternating).

I will do the calculation with the tested physical ion exchange capacity of 3.3 0dH x m3 / L of resin. So we have 800L x 3.30dh = 26400dh x m3 / each tank.

Inlet water hardness is 12.50dF – this means it is roughly 70dH.

In this conditions, each column will regenerate after 2640 / 7 = around 375m3 of treated water .

State the calculated regeneration interval (hours) at the above conditions.

The system will work volumetric – this means it will regenerate each 375m3 of treated water.

If you have a constant 30m3/h flow – this means the regeneration will start each +-12.5 H

Confirm, as a contractual performance guarantee, that treated water hardness at the outlet will be ≤ 0.5 °Fr throughout the full service cycle — not only at the start of the cycle.

We will need to wait for the producer official response, but normally for the capacity presented above, we can guarantee.

However, because I see this is a very sensitive aspect, I suggest you to also install an on-line softener sensor/monitor to continuously check the water hardness on the outlet of the softener.[in this way you can assure all the parts work properly]. A Sycon 2800 or Testomat panel is around 5-6000 euro

Confirm the minimum number of regeneration cycles achievable with one full brine tank loading (project requires ≥ 10 cycles).

Again this is very hard to assure, because both the draw of the brine and filling is done through venturi injector. So depending of the inlet pressure fluctuation the system will bring more or less water in the brine tank.

If we discuss of ideal conditions than:

The ideal pure salt needed for regeneration of 1L of resin is around 120g/L of resin.

Considering the system has 800 L of resin, than we estimate a salt consumption of around 96kg of salt/ regeneration.

The brine tanks offered have a total capacity of 1500L

To dilute 96 kg of salt – you need around 280 L of water [ at a temperature of 200C]

To sum up, we have 10 x 96 kg /1.25[ salt density] + 280-300L of water for dissolving the salt needed for 1 regeneration = +-1070 L of media - so will fit in a 1500L brine tank .

The max operating water pressure for this type of systems is 6 BAR

System works automatically based on volume of treated water. You can activate regeneration also manually from the control panel. Be aware you cannot individually close/open the electrical valves from the skid manually.

Regarding the signals. The system is able to send a signal through 2 dry contacts – that can be set only during the regeneration time. [ this 2 contacts are normally used when the system needs to start a external pump in case of different source of water for backwash or a valve] .

We can also separately present you a list of mandatory components for the proposed system [ mostly electrical valves ], but we are able to provide this only if you agree with the technical solution.

I am looking forward in receiving your feedback.

Hello Ismail,

Thank you very much for the request!

I had a quick look on the documents you sent.

So based on this documents you are asking for a automatic filter with a screen of 50 microns + 1 duplex softener – dimensioned for 30m3/h considering a 6.22 0G Hardness in the brute water .

Based on my calculation you will need minimum 600 L of media on each column [ tank 36x72 ] – but the filtration velocity in this case will be around 47m/h – which is rather high for a softener!

I suggest using for this application at least 800-850L softener [ the tank used in this case is 42x72 ] – resulting a filtration velocity of 34m/h –assuring a medium contact time, or for a optimal filtration velocity – 48x72 tanks [ and 1000-1100L of resin on each tank] – resulting a velocity of around 26m/h.

For sure you want to integrate an industrial skid softener [ considering you also want to control the unit manually ]. I have sent you several photos with similar softeners integrated in different projects as a reference.

Now what is unclear for me in this tender - from the technical point of view, is the following:

What will this treated water be used for? Is this for a steam boiler?

I am asking this because the treated water parameters are a little problematic to be achieved:

the pH of 9.5-1.5 , but the initial pH is around 7.8 [ I think this can be assured only through dosing of NaOH in the water not to influence hardness ]

The iron level < 0.3μg/L – but the initial iron level is around 10 μg/L – so the softener will most probably adsorb a small part of the iron ions [ this as a secondary effect], but has no control on how much will be retained.

You need the Oxidability of the water to be 30 mgO2/L [ permanganate index] - [ this normally in the water treatment plants – means the water will be very contaminated with mostly organic compounds] – I think this is not correct asked .

Normally for this type of softeners the max operating pressure should not exceed 6-7bar. [ in the tender is asked for a 10bar system]

What is the current state of this tender – you are in construction phase/ project phase ?

I saw you also need a 2d/3d model for the softener in max 2 weeks from order, this I will need to check with the producer if it can be available or not . But first we need to clarify what type of vessel should we use, pipping of the skid, automation etc.

Can you tell me more about the scope of the treated water ?

For sure we can schedule a teams meeting as well in the following days, but I suggest first to have a clear view of what equipment will be proper for your application [ because depending of the options we are limited from each producer].

I am looking forward in receiving your response!

Buna ziua Dl Mihai,

Intelegem punctul dumneavoastra de vedere.

Va spun drept chiar nu am timp de astfel de abordari!

Ati comunicat anterior ca sistemul este oprit de 4 luni , va rog sa precizati de ce si de ce nu ati semnalat ca este o problema [ daca intr-adevar a fost oprit pentru o problema]?

Ati anuntat prin domnul Iliescu in data de 11.08 la ora 3:34 PM – in care deja transmiteti ca vreti sa intervina alta firma. AKRO nu va poate recomanda alta firma pentru interventie, iar programarile le facem in avans cu 1-2 saptamani.

Ca si informatie:

In cazul functionarii normale - Apa clorinata la 0.4-0.5ppm – miroase a clor. Singurul motiv fondat pentru care scoateti din priza sistemul, este daca acesta nu functioneaza corect – aduce prea mult clor in apa [ vizibil atat pe analizor cat si testat printr-un buletin pentru clorul rezidual – in apa tratata] – si in astfel de cazuri sunt sigur ca ati fi anuntat din timp [ pentru a avea o dovada de nefunctionare – si solutionare a situatiei in fata unui posibil control DSP].

Va rog sa ne transmiteti motivul real pentru care se umbla la analizor de dumneavoastra sau beneficiar?

Iar legat de aceste interventii solicitate , va rog sa raspundeti oficial :

Cand ati solicitat AKRO sa se intervina asupra sistemului [ la alta data decat cea de punere in functiune]?

Va rog sa ne transmiteti facturile in baza carora ati facut dumneavoastra plata acestor interventii efectuate de AKRO [ altceva in afara deplasarii de punere in functiune] – de care mentionati – Eu va las anexata fisa client CONRAD .

Ca si informatie , orice deplasare executata de AKRO se incheie cu un process verbal de service!

Va las din nou anexat procesul verbal de punere in functiune cand sistemul a fost lasat in functiune! [data de 12.03.2026] – semnat de administrator - ALEXANDRU IONITA

Referitor la posibili furnizori pentru clorinare, Dl Daniel vin in ajutorul dumneavoastra cu alte branduri de clorinare disponibile pe piata din Romania :

Prominent

Grundfos

Emec

Nu cunoastem si cine le distribuie , dar stiu ca sunt prezente .

Referitor la returul echipamentelor, din pacate va transmit ca sistemul livrat in 12.11.2025 si pornit la data de 12.03.2026 – nu mai poate fi luat retur!

Va multumim pentru intelegere!

Numai bine,

messages.body:
Daca vrei sa te distrezi

From: Marian Mihai <marian.mihai@conradinstal.ro>
Sent: Thursday, August 13, 2026 12:32 PM
To: AKRO Romania , Alexandru Soare <alexandru.soare@akro.ro>; daniel.iliescu@conradinstal.ro
Cc: 'Akro Filtrare' <office@akro.ro>; andrei.dobrei@akro.ro; 'Aurel CARAS - AKRO' <aurel.caras@akro.ro>; vanzari@seko.ro
Subject: Re: Statie clorinare Teisani8_reglaje

Daniel,

Te rog sa ne spuna Alexandru Ionita tot istoricul, deoareceel.stie cat a functionat, de cate ori a venit tehnicul si de ce din aprilie.pana in prezent nu a fost chemat tehnicul. Eu in acest moment am o instalatie ce nu functioneaza iar persoana ce a venit la punerea in functiune pentru mine este si reprezentantul dumnevoastra.

Inca odata, va rog sa ma anuntati cand ve it sa fiu prezent sa facem hartiile cum trebuie.

Din punctul meu de vedere colegul vostru ce s a ocupat de aceasta situatie a fost informat ca nu functioneaza, fapt ce il putem dovedi.

Alexandru Ionita, de ce nu au fost anuntati de 4 luni.pana astazi, sau pe.cine am.anuntat?

Ce va poy.spune este ca clorul a cresxut foarte mult si.colegul vostru ne a spus sa il scoatem din priza, cel.putin asa stiu eu.

Aceasta instalatie trebuie sa functioneze si aveti obligatia sa veniti in locatie si sa il verificati, daca nu se preteaza pentru noi sa stim, astazi are.o alarma si nu.functioneaza.

Probabil puteri vedea cat timp a functionat si veti constata ca mai.mult nu a functionat si cu 3 interventii platite .

In concluzie , astept interventia cat mai.curand si colegii mei sa faca ce le.am.spus.

In ceea ce priveste relatia cu dumneavoastra undeva este un scurt pe.care il vom.clarifica in locatie.

Mm

Trimis de pe Outlook pentru Android

De la: AKRO Romania , Alexandru Soare <alexandru.soare@akro.ro>
Trimis: joi, august 13, 2026 11:54:46 AM
Către: 'Marian Mihai' <marian.mihai@conradinstal.ro>; daniel.iliescu@conradinstal.ro <daniel.iliescu@conradinstal.ro>
Cc: 'Akro Filtrare' <office@akro.ro>; andrei.dobrei@akro.ro <andrei.dobrei@akro.ro>; 'Aurel CARAS - AKRO' <aurel.caras@akro.ro>; vanzari@seko.ro <vanzari@seko.ro>
Subiect: RE: Statie clorinare Teisani8_reglaje

Buna ziua Dl Mihai,

Intelegem punctul dumneavoastra de vedere.

Va spun drept chiar nu am timp de astfel de abordari!

Ati comunicat anterior ca sistemul este oprit de 4 luni , va rog sa precizati de ce si de ce nu ati semnalat ca este o problema [ daca intr-adevar a fost oprit pentru o problema]?

Ati anuntat prin domnul Iliescu in data de 11.08 la ora 3:34 PM – in care deja transmiteti ca vreti sa intervina alta firma. AKRO nu va poate recomanda alta firma pentru interventie, iar programarile le facem in avans cu 1-2 saptamani.

Ca si informatie:

In cazul functionarii normale - Apa clorinata la 0.4-0.5ppm – miroase a clor. Singurul motiv fondat pentru care scoateti din priza sistemul, este daca acesta nu functioneaza corect – aduce prea mult clor in apa [ vizibil atat pe analizor cat si testat printr-un buletin pentru clorul rezidual – in apa tratata] – si in astfel de cazuri sunt sigur ca ati fi anuntat din timp [ pentru a avea o dovada de nefunctionare – si solutionare a situatiei in fata unui posibil control DSP].

Va rog sa ne transmiteti motivul real pentru care se umbla la analizor de dumneavoastra sau beneficiar?

Iar legat de aceste interventii solicitate , va rog sa raspundeti oficial :

Cand ati solicitat AKRO sa se intervina asupra sistemului [ la alta data decat cea de punere in functiune]?

Va rog sa ne transmiteti facturile in baza carora ati facut dumneavoastra plata acestor interventii efectuate de AKRO [ altceva in afara deplasarii de punere in functiune] – de care mentionati – Eu va las anexata fisa client CONRAD .

Ca si informatie , orice deplasare executata de AKRO se incheie cu un process verbal de service!

Va las din nou anexat procesul verbal de punere in functiune cand sistemul a fost lasat in functiune! [data de 12.03.2026] – semnat de administrator - ALEXANDRU IONITA

Referitor la posibili furnizori pentru clorinare, Dl Daniel vin in ajutorul dumneavoastra cu alte branduri de clorinare disponibile pe piata din Romania :

Prominent

Grundfos

Emec

Nu cunoastem si cine le distribuie , dar stiu ca sunt prezente .

Referitor la returul echipamentelor, din pacate va transmit ca sistemul livrat in 12.11.2025 si pornit la data de 12.03.2026 – nu mai poate fi luat retur!

Va multumim pentru intelegere!

Numai bine,

From: Marian Mihai <marian.mihai@conradinstal.ro>
Sent: Thursday, August 13, 2026 10:41 AM
To: AKRO Romania , Alexandru Soare <alexandru.soare@akro.ro>; daniel.iliescu@conradinstal.ro; Marian Mihai <marian.mihai@conradinstal.ro>
Cc: 'Akro Filtrare' <office@akro.ro>; andrei.dobrei@akro.ro; 'Aurel CARAS - AKRO' <aurel.caras@akro.ro>
Subject: Re: Statie clorinare Teisani8_reglaje

Daniel,

Va solicit expres sa cautati un alt furnizor care sa detina pe.stoc o statie de genul acesta in mod urgent si cu domnii de.la Akro daca nu avem interventia saptamana aceasta urmam procedura contractuala. Beneficiarul final nu vrea sa mai astepte nici macar o zi. A fost mintit 2 saptamani ca vine.

Trimis de pe Outlook pentru Android

De la: Marian Mihai <marian.mihai@conradinstal.ro>

Subiect: Re: Statie clorinare Teisani8_reglaje

Buna ziua,

Numele meu este Marian Mihai si sunt pm lucrarii de la UM Teisani. Va rog sa imi explicati de ce nu a functionat nicipdata aceasta statie de clorinare, avand probleme cu ea in mai.multe randuri pentru care am platit interventii.

Sunt de acord sa plat8m aceasta deplasare cu mentiunea ca daca nu se pune in functiune sau nu ni se face un raport complet si corect sa returnam produsul si sa cautam alta varianta.

In locatie se afla o gradinita de copii care au primit clor de.la.aceasta statie incat sa.miroasa foarte tare.

Colegul dumneavoastra ne a promis ca luni sau marti va fi in locatoe si nu s a intamplat asta.

Astept urgent data de interventie pentru a fi si eu acolo sa facem.un peoces verbal.

Marian Mihai

Trimis de pe Outlook pentru Android

Buna ziua Dl Iliescu,

Ne pare rau sa auzim ca sistemul este oprit din nou, nu intelegem de ce se intampla asta….

Va trimitem anexata propunerea noastra pentru deplasarea la locatie , verificare si repornirea statiei de clorinare.

Va rog sa ne transmiteti daca ramane comanda ferma pentru a emite si factura proforma. Asa cum am transmis si anterior, putem programa interventia in maxim 7-14 zile din momentul in care primim confirmarea de plata.

Vom face tot posibilul sa programam pentru finalul saptamanii urmatoare in cazul in care rezolvam cu plata pana maine.

Asteptam raspuns!

Numai bine,

Subject: RE: Statie clorinare Teisani8_reglaje

Buna ziua Dl Iliescu,

Am fost contactat astazi de echipa SEKO din Cluj cu privire la instalatia de clorinare montata la UM Teisani de catre AKRO. Las mai jos si solicitarea dumneavoastra de ieri, precum si raspunsul AKRO la solicitarea dumneavoastra + procesul verbal de PIF.

Asa cum am transmis si anterior, furnizarea si instalarea sistemelor de clorinare SEKO se face doar prin distribuitori autorizati.

De asemenea precizez ca sistemele de clorinare automate nu ajung sa se decalibreze intr-un timp asa de scurt, iar date fiind cele doua interventii anterioare cu titlu gratuit ale colaboratorului de service [ cand s-a constatat oprirea sistemului respectiv schimbarea setarilor initiale executate de AKRO] – am solicitat din partea dumneavoastra o diagnoza pentru aceasta noua solicitare de reglare!

In cazul in care doriti interventie din partea unui alt distribuitor SEKO, poate chiar din Bucuresti – fac atunci apel la echipa din Cluj sa va redirectioneze la cineva mai aproape.

Asteptam cat de repede raspunsul dumneavoastra ca toata lumea sa stie ce are de facut!

Numai bine,

From: AKRO Romania , Alexandru Soare <alexandru.soare@akro.ro>
Sent: Tuesday, August 11, 2026 4:05 PM
To: 'daniel.iliescu@conradinstal.ro' <daniel.iliescu@conradinstal.ro>
Cc: 'marian.mihai@conradinstal.ro' <marian.mihai@conradinstal.ro>; 'Akro Filtrare' <office@akro.ro>; 'andrei.dobrei@akro.ro' <andrei.dobrei@akro.ro>; 'Aurel CARAS - AKRO' <aurel.caras@akro.ro>
Subject: RE: Statie clorinare Teisani8_reglaje

Buna ziua Dl Iliescu,

Va multumim pentru solicitare si informare!

Am discutat cu colegul de service, care mi-a transmis ca ulterior datei la care s-a facut PIF-ul, acesta a mai fost pentru reglaje de 2 ori la dumneavoastra [ o data pentru ca s-a umblat la setari, si a doua oara pentru ca ati oprit sistemul]. [ Din ce am inteles aceste interventii au fost efectuate gratuit].

Pana in prezent, nu am stiu despre aceste deplasari si nu cunosc nici motivul pentru care a fost solicitat a -3-a oara. Astazi colaboratorul nostru este la BUZAU si per total are programari pana la finalul acestei saptamani.

Prin urmare, tot ce pot face la acest moment este sa va intreb punctual ce este in neregula cu sistemul de solicitati aceasta deplasare [ descriere ]– va rog sa trimiteti inclusiv poze cu sistemul actual [ ce afiseaza panoul ] – pentru a va putea intocmi o propunere comerciala .

Dupa ce se achita factura proforma, putem programa interventia in termen de maxim 1-2 saptamani.

Asteptam cu interes raspuns!

Numai bine,

To: alexandru.soare@akro.ro
Cc: marian.mihai@conradinstal.ro
Subject: Statie clorinare Teisani8_reglaje

BUna ziua,

Avand in vedere ca subcontractorul dumneavoastra pentru reglarea instalatiei de clorinare pe care am achizitionat-o de la dumneavoastra nu s-a tinut de cuvant in mod repetat in privinta datei la care sa efectueze interventiile de reglaj ale instalatiei, am rugamintea sa ne recomandati urgent alta firma, de preferat din Bucuresti. Suntem pasibili de penalitati foarte mari din aceasta cauza, lucru care ar fi bine sa fie evitat de catre toti. Va rog sa imi trimiteti urgent un alt contact.

Multumesc

Cu respect,

Daniel Iliescu

messages.conversation_topic: Cerere de ofertă – sistem de tratare a apei pentru unitate de producție cosmetice și suplimente – Suceava
messages.body:
Buna ziua,

Am verificat si buletinele puse la dispozitie.

Desi sunt cateva valori care nu intelegem de ce fluctueaza [ spre exemplu nitratii] va confirm ca in cazul actual, cu o varianta de tratare standard veti reusi sa obtineti apa demineralizata cu conductivitate < 50 microS . pH-ul in schimb cred ca se va apropia de valoare5.5-6 .

De asemenea , estimez o rata de inlocuire a membranelor de aproximativ 1 data /an.

Fluxul este urmatorul:

Filtrul NW400

Fcc150 – carbune activ – cu racord de 1.25”

Statie dedurizare duplex Dec 150L – cu vane de 1.25” si MAV

Statie de osmoza semi-industriala MO240000TP5 cu 4 membrane 4040 filmtec

Bazin de stocare din PP 2mc

Pompe CMBE cu convertizor de 2mc/h

Sistem Uv Viqua Vh 410.

Furnizarea echipamentelor de mai sus [ strict livrare] – ajunge la 18200 euro fara TVA.

Cu fluxul propus – se va obtine permeat cu un debit de 700-1000L/h la o conductivitate < 50 microS/cm , dar nu putem discuta de industrie pharma.

S-ar putea sa mai fie nevoie de :

1 grup de pompare pentru crestere presiune, daca reteaua actuala nu furnizeaza o presiune stabila pe intrare de minim 4-4.5 bar.

Aveti nevoie sa trimitem o oferta oficiala in acest sens? Daca Da, va rugam sa ne furnizati un Cui de firma.

Referitor la intreg procesul solicitat pentru acest proiect [ proiectare, executie , constructie statie neutralizare ape uzate] – dupa o reanaliza, consider ca la acest moment nu suntem pregatiti sa acceptam un astfel de proiect.

In plus daca bugetul este de 20000 euro pentru intreaga linie, atunci cu parere de rau transmit ca acest proiect este mult subbugetat.

Rog un raspuns in aceasta directie.

Cu respect,

From: dragos aluionut <drgmotorsconcept@yahoo.com>
Sent: Thursday, August 13, 2026 4:56 AM
To: AKRO Romania , Alexandru Soare <alexandru.soare@akro.ro>

vă transmit atașat buletinele de analiză a apei din rețeaua publică, precum și buletinul de analiză finală emis de partener.

Buna ziua,

Va multumim pentru raspuns!

Ideea este ca fara a avea un buletin de analiza al apei brute , nu putem definitiva un flux de tratare pentru a va prezenta un document conform solicitarii – sustinut de fise tehnice, calcul consumabile si altele.

Pot in schimb sa confirm, ca in situatii standard [ de ape putin incarcate] , da bugetele pentru echipamente se apropie de bugetele transmise de dumneavoastra

12-20000 euro pentru echipamente demineralizare cu 0.5-1mc/h [ atentie vorbim strict de echipamente] – care ar include standard:

Filtrare mecanica

Carbune activ

Dedurizare

Osmoza

Bazin stocare din PE

Uv iesire din bazin

Si o pompa de consum 1-2mc/h

In bugetul acesta nu se poate discuta de confectie pe inox, si nu acopera cerinte precum – sa acopere montajul sau o automatizare SCADA -control de la distanta sau altele .

Pentru orice alte informatii sau intrebari va stau cu placere la dispozitie!

Bună ziua,

Vă mulțumim pentru informațiile și sprijinul oferit. Fiind la început de drum, există încă numeroase aspecte pe care le aprofundăm pe parcurs, motiv pentru care experiența, îndrumarea și disponibilitatea dumneavoastră ne sunt deosebit de valoroase.

Apreciem sprijinul acordat și sperăm să dezvoltăm o colaborare cât mai bună și de durată.

O zi plăcută!

Cu stima,

Murariu ionut

Pe miercuri, 29 iulie 2026 la 10:34:54 EEST, AKRO Romania , Alexandru Soare <alexandru.soare@akro.ro> a scris:

Buna ziua,

Va multumim pentru solicitarea dumneavoastra!

Firma Akro este specializata in furnizarea de solutii si echipamente de tratare a apelor primare cu scopul de a obtine – ape potabile sau ape tehnice [ inclusiv apa demineralizata].

Trebuie sa clarificam daca doriti ca anumite produse sa fie si certificate pharma [ trebuie discutat cu producatorii in functie de cerinta pentru a valida acest aspect] .

In cee ace priveste cererea trimisa, in forma in care ati solicitat sa furnizam instalatia, va confirmam ca da, putem executa intreaga linie , dar numai prin colaborare cu anumiti terti. Principalele etape :

· Colaborare cu un laborator acreditat – pentru executie analize – apa bruta – contra cost

· Stabilire calitate produs finit si caracteristici clare de

§ Debit de productie

§ Stocare

§ Consum 24 h

§ Dimensiuni camera tehnica s.a.

Beneficiarul transmite aceste informatii

· Dimensionare instalatie conform informatii furnizate – stabilire flux de tratat. [ tot aici avem o situatie clara a apelor reziduale obtinute , volume si incarcatura]. Trebuie sa clarificati daca la aceste incarcari de ape uzate se mai adauga si alte ape din productie si ce incarcatura aduc.

· Apoi, pentru partea de ape uzate – nu suntem specialisti in tratare, prin urmare - vom discuta si cu o firma dedicata – pentru dimensionarea instalatiei de tratare a apelor uzate/epurare! – Trebuie sa mentionam ca toate serviciile de dimensionare, furnizare , montaj – vor trebui achitate in avans .

· Dupa ce totul este clar din punct de vedere al fluxului, - apelam la un proiectant [ pentru executie – scheme de flux, amplasament, proiect tehnic] – contra cost

· Furnizare echipamente

· Materiale si manopera de montaj –[aici in functie de cerinte, va trebui sa apelam la colaboratori [ daca de exemplu se doreste montaj pe inox – pharma – luciu oglinda s.a.]. Pentru montaj standard putem trimite echipele noastre

· PIF

Las anexata o fotografie cu o statie de osmoza de 3mc/h – ce este utilizata intr-o fabrica de productie de servetele umede.

Pentru a putea merge mai departe vom avea nevoie din partea dumneavoastra de urmatoarele informatii:

· Cine este beneficiarul acestei instalatii ? Pe ce firma se vor intocmi propunerile comerciale si tehnice?

· In ce stadiu se afla proiectul? Studiu de fezabilitate , constructie sau alta etapa? Cand se preconizeaza ca aceasta instalatie va intra in etapa de achizitie ?

· Care este bugetul pentru furnizarea la cheie a acestui proiect?

· Va rog sa ne transmiteti si un numar de contact

Asteptam cu interes raspuns!

Numai bine,
