TQ-1 — Cyclic Capacity & Treated Water Quality

The AKRO datasheet for the BlueSoft BS-D2/RV series lists for the BS3200D2/RV model: resin volume 2 × 800 L and cyclic capacity 2 × 3,200 m³×°dH, with a salt consumption range of 80–192 kg per regeneration per column and flow rate 32–40 m³/h.

Please confirm and provide:

Confirm that the cyclic capacity of 2 × 3,200 m³×°dH stated in the datasheet applies to the exact unit offered under quotation S02146 (800 L resin per column).

Based on the data sheet of the producer, and the canature resin used inside the vessels, yes this is the theoretical and lab tested capacity.

However based on our experience, considering the brute water has also different metallic ions in smaller or greater concentrations [ like iron, manganese, aluminium and so on] –a cationic resin will be able to retain this ions as well, reducing punctual hardness exchange capacity. We normally do sizing calculations with a exchange capacity of around 3.2-3.3 m3 x 0dH / each L of resin.

Provide the performance calculation for the following evaluation basis: softened water flow rate Q = 30 m³/h; raw water hardness = 12.5 °Fr — please state the equivalent hardness in °dH used in your calculation; one column in service at a time (duplex alternating).

I will do the calculation with the tested physical ion exchange capacity of 3.3 0dH x m3 / L of resin. So we have 800L x 3.30dh = 26400dh x m3 / each tank.

Inlet water hardness is 12.50dF – this means it is roughly 70dH.

In this conditions, each column will regenerate after 2640 / 7 = around 375m3 of treated water .

State the calculated regeneration interval (hours) at the above conditions.

The system will work volumetric – this means it will regenerate each 375m3 of treated water.

If you have a constant 30m3/h flow – this means the regeneration will start each +-12.5 H

Confirm, as a contractual performance guarantee, that treated water hardness at the outlet will be ≤ 0.5 °Fr throughout the full service cycle — not only at the start of the cycle.

We will need to wait for the producer official response, but normally for the capacity presented above, we can guarantee.

However, because I see this is a very sensitive aspect, I suggest you to also install an on-line softener sensor/monitor to continuously check the water hardness on the outlet of the softener.[in this way you can assure all the parts work properly]. A Sycon 2800 or Testomat panel is around 5-6000 euro

Confirm the minimum number of regeneration cycles achievable with one full brine tank loading (project requires ≥ 10 cycles).

Again this is very hard to assure, because both the draw of the brine and filling is done through venturi injector. So depending of the inlet pressure fluctuation the system will bring more or less water in the brine tank.

If we discuss of ideal conditions than:

The ideal pure salt needed for regeneration of 1L of resin is around 120g/L of resin.

Considering the system has 800 L of resin, than we estimate a salt consumption of around 96kg of salt/ regeneration.

The brine tanks offered have a total capacity of 1500L

To dilute 96 kg of salt – you need around 280 L of water [ at a temperature of 200C]

To sum up, we have 10 x 96 kg /1.25[ salt density] + 280-300L of water for dissolving the salt needed for 1 regeneration = +-1070 L of media - so will fit in a 1500L brine tank .

Water consumption per regeneration (litres/cycle).

This again can be calculated only as theoretical. I can do all the math but please clarify:

What kind of water will the softener use for regeneration ? Brute water or the system needs to have a different connection for feeding with clean water during regeneration?

If the system will use brute water to regenerate, than what will be the total available water inlet flow ? if the available flow remains is 30m3/h – than the system will adsorb around 20-30% [ depending of backwash step] – and through it to the drainage. Also this means that during regeneration the production will be reduced with 20-30% because the other tank is using the water for regeneration. [ all clear?]

Now a system this big will consume around 10-15m3/ regeneration [ but again this can change through local settings and physical conditions in site]

Regeneration duration (minutes).

Again this will be parametrises in site. Generally you have the following steps/duration:

Backwash – around 8-10mins

Brine absorbtion – around 30-50 mins

Rinse – around 10-15 mins

Fill – around 15 mins

Maximum drain/backwash flow rate during regeneration (m³/h or L/min).

For softener application you need to assure a 20m/h velocity for correct backwash [ this is the main parameter that must be assured]. – the tanks of the system proposed are 42x72 – this means you need to assure a 15-17m3/h for initial backwash

Volume of water required simultaneously during the regeneration phase (litres).

I do not understand the question. If the question is how much flow you need to assure in order to have a 30m3/h of treated water and considering the system is using brute water also for regeneration, than the answer is 45 m3/h during regeneration.

TQ-3 — Operating Pressure & Booster Pump Requirement [CRITICAL]

This is the most critical open item. Two independent sources confirm the pressure gap:

• Your e-mail of 21 April 2026: "The softener unit requires a inlet water pressure of at least 2–2.5 bar – otherwise the system will not work properly."

• AKRO datasheet BS-D2/RV: Min. operating pressure = 200 kPa (2 bar).

The project specification (FT It-10.1 §1) defines the available potable water inlet pressure as 1–1.5 bar. This is the pressure available at the softening station inlet (line 00GHD01-BR001). The confirmed pressure deficit is 0.5–1.5 bar.

Please provide formal written responses to the following:

Confirm the exact minimum inlet pressure required for the BS3200D2/RV to operate correctly and guarantee the treated water performance specified in TQ-1.

MINIMUM WATER PRESSURE MUST BE 2-2.5BAR

MAX WATER PRESSURE 6 BAR

Is a booster/pressure-raising pump upstream of the softening station required to bridge this pressure gap?

We do not know the site conditions to make recommendations. Where does the brute water come from? If it is from municipality than yes a booster pump will help increasing the pressure for the system.

If a booster pump is required: is it included in AKRO's scope of supply under offer S02146? If not, please provide technical specifications and a budget price for a suitable booster pump and confirm whether AKRO can supply and install it within the same contract.

It is not included and the installation will not be included in our scope

If no booster pump is offered: please confirm explicitly that the system cannot be guaranteed to operate correctly at 1–1.5 bar inlet pressure, so that this can be formally assessed by the project designer.

The system will not operate correctly for a inlet water pressure that is not in the interval of 2-6bar

TQ-4 — Dimensions & Installation Envelope

A discrepancy has been identified between two AKRO documents provided:

• Dimensional drawing BS-3200D2-RV (AKRO Romania, January 2023): overall dimensions approx. 2,516 mm × 2,193 mm, installed height approx. 2,203 mm. Please be aware that in the drawing attached, you do not have the overall dimensions of the softener. You do not even have the total height of it .2203mm represents the total width in this positioning.

• AKRO datasheet BlueSoft BS-D2/RV (BlueSoft 3200D2/RV row): H × L × W = 2,425 × 3,200 × 2,750 mm, operating weight 2,430 kg.

Please clarify and provide:

Confirm which set of dimensions applies to the unit offered under quotation S02146 (800 L resin per column, 2 × 1,500 L brine tanks, SUFV 3" filter or FTA alternative).

For the softener please take into account the dimensions from the BlueSoft 3200D2/RV row from the data sheet present with the mention that the brine tanks can be freely positioned anywhere round the unit;

For the SUFV 3” – please take into account the dimensions from the data sheet link - https://akro.ro/public/fise/238-Fisa_tehnica_Filtru_cu_autocuratare_otel_carbon.pdf

Provide the final General Arrangement drawing for the complete supplied package, including: softener tanks; valve skid; brine tanks; filter system; inlet/outlet headers; drain connections; minimum maintenance clearances around the unit.

We cannot provide this drawings – this is design part

Minimum space required for maintenance – at least 0.5m around each unit .

Confirm the final empty weight and operating weight (kg) of the complete package as supplied.

I will give you the fully working total weight , considering the 2 brine tanks full with water + salt for 10 regenerations in each. + filter filled with water – total weight around 6.3 T

Note: The preliminary maximum installation height is 3,900 mm. Final site coordination is subject to design verification.

If this is the total available height of the room, than this is enough for installing the system . We will need around 3.5m for a easy fill of the unit with media.

TQ-5 — DCS Signals & Controller Integration

Your e-mail of 21 April states: "The system is able to send a signal through 2 dry contacts – that can be set only during the regeneration time."

The project specification (FT It-10.1 §1) requires the following signals to be exchanged with the plant central DCS:

Start/Stop command — binary input from DCS to the softening unit.

Unit status Running — binary output from unit to DCS.

Unit status Stopped — binary output from unit to DCS.

Unit status Regenerating — binary output from unit to DCS.

Based on your e-mail, we understand the 2 available dry contacts are active only during regeneration and are designed for triggering an external pump or valve — not for general status reporting or remote start/stop command. Please clarify:

Can the 2 dry contacts be configured to report any of the four DCS signals listed above? Please describe exactly what each contact can be set to signal.

Is a remote Start/Stop input from DCS to the unit possible with the standard RX-D2/RV controller?

Does the electronic controller feature an electronic display as required by the specification?

If the standard controller cannot provide the required DCS signals: can AKRO offer an alternative control panel or PLC upgrade? If yes, please provide specifications and the additional cost.

I will need to wait the producer automation manual to present to you and see what signals you can use . the dry contacts can deliver signal only during backwash steps.

Anyway, I want to assure you that this unit, or any other softener unit, cannot provide the signals you are asking without an external automation.

For example - Start/Stop – A softener unit never STOPS! this happens only when you close the water circuit, but the softener’s automation does not stopping the water flow.

So this control that you are asking, can be done but only with an external automation which is not included

TQ-6 — Upstream Filter: 50 Micron Requirement

Your e-mail confirms that a 50 micron solution would require 3× FTA 180/E 2" in parallel + FTA-DP controller, at approximately 3,200 € without VAT, in lieu of the offered SUFV 3" at 100 microns.

The project specification (FT It-10.1 §1) explicitly requires a self-cleaning filter with a stainless steel mesh rated at 50 microns. This is a stated technical requirement. Acceptance of a 100 micron filter instead of the specified 50 microns can only be considered subject to formal written approval by the project designer.

Please confirm and provide:

Is the mesh of the offered SUFV 3" filter constructed from stainless steel as required by the specification?

Yes, but the filtration efficiency is 100 microns.

Please formally include the 3× FTA 180/E 2" parallel filter configuration as a separate alternative line item in your revised offer, with full technical specifications, dimensional data, and the exact price delta versus the standard SUFV 3".

We do not recommend this solution . We gave it as alternative because you asked specifically for a NOBEL softener and most likely you have consider also their filters in the project. But installing 3 filters in parallel we cannot assure a perfect divide of the water flow through the 3 elements, so in time there might appear operating problems.

For the parallel FTA filter configuration: confirm that water flow to the softener is uninterrupted during automatic backwash of any individual filter element.

As I mentioned we do not recommend this solution. But if the designer included this type of filters in the project than he might answer you .

However, your request is not clear. So you ask for a automated self cleaning filter [ which will clean by itself every time the DP is reached] but it must deliver clean water 24h/day. Of course this is impossible – it is normal that during its cleaning procedure, the filter will not supply filtered water. Anyhow – the total cleaning time for a SUFV is less than a minute. If you still want this filtering stage to assure you non stop filtered water, than you need to mount a secondary SUF in parallel [1 A+1STBy] – the second unit + installing materials are not included in the offer.

TQ-7 — Materials in Contact with Potable Water

The softening station treats potable water (apă potabilă) for preparation of hot make-up water in the district heating circuit. Please confirm:

Now this is not clear at all. So the treated water will be used as make-up water in the closed heating circuit. Why does the system needs potable certificates ? will this closed circuit water be drank ? Please clarify in each point this water will be used as drinking water.

All materials in contact with the water — including resin, internal vessel lining, valves, seals, gaskets and brine tank components — are suitable for potable water application.

We can give you certificates only for:

Internal paint of the filter sufv – WRAS certif

Hygienic certificate for the CANATURE pressure vessels

Hygienic certificate for the resin

Hygienic certificate for the support gravel

Provide relevant certificates or declarations confirming potable water suitability (e.g. ACS, WRAS, KTW, or equivalent European approval).

The above mentioned certificates will be delivered with the equipment

TQ-8 — Warranty: Basis of Calculation

Offer S02146 states: "Warranty: 36 months from delivery of the goods". The project specification (FT It-10.1 §4) requires minimum 36 months from the date of commissioning (PIF — Punere în Funcțiune). Given that delivery and commissioning may be separated by several months, this is a material contractual difference.

Confirm whether you can agree to a warranty period of 36 months calculated from the date of commissioning (PIF).

The warranty will start from the delivery of the goods date

Confirm: defect resolution time ≤ 5 days from notification, and spare parts availability in the post-warranty period ≤ 15 days.

We can assure a <5 days response, not a resolution time.

If different components break [ like a electric valve] – we do not keep this in stock so it must be delivered from the supplier in order to be exchanged. Generally the delivery time is 1-2 weeks + service schedule time less than 7 days.

TQ-9 — CE Marking & Quality Documentation

The Caiet de Sarcini (§10) requires CE marking and ISO 9001 compliance for all supplied equipment. Please provide:

CE Declaration of Conformity (DoC) for the BS3200D2/RV softener and for the upstream filter (SUFV 3" or FTA alternative). If not yet available, confirm CE marking will be provided at delivery.

List of applicable standards used for design and manufacture.

Confirm ISO 9001:2015 certification of the manufacturing facility (or equivalent quality management system).

Confirm that AKRO SRL holds the required importer/distributor authorization or equivalent documentation required for placing and supplying this equipment on the Romanian/EU market, as per the Caiet de Sarcini.

Waiting for the producer response in this direction

TQ-10 — Hydraulic Connections: Interface with Project Piping

The dimensional drawing BS-3200D2-RV confirms Inlet DN80 flanged / Outlet DN80 flanged / Drain 2". The project process line 00GHD01-BR001 is designed with DN100 PN16 flanged connections (carbon steel P265GH). The project drain line is DN50 PN16.

Confirm whether DN80-to-DN100 PN16 flanged transition spools / reducers are included in AKRO's scope of supply.

Yes this was taken into account in the mounting materials. [ mounting section from the offer] . Be aware that we where informed the current piping is PVC-U – Dn100 . If there is other material the costs will differ.

If you do not order this installing services than – flanges/transitions will not be include

Confirm whether a Drain 2"-to-DN50 PN16 flanged adapter is included in AKRO's scope.

Same answer as above. Be aware that if there is a longer distance than 5 m from the softener site up to the drainage – the mounting costs will increase

If any of the above transition pieces are excluded from scope: confirm who is responsible for supply and installation, and provide a budget price.

For all transition spools included in AKRO scope: specify the material, pressure rating, flange standard and confirm that bolts, nuts and gaskets are included.

Hello Ismail,

Thank you very much for the request!

I had a quick look on the documents you sent.

So based on this documents you are asking for a automatic filter with a screen of 50 microns + 1 duplex softener – dimensioned for 30m3/h considering a 6.22 0G Hardness in the brute water .

Based on my calculation you will need minimum 600 L of media on each column [ tank 36x72 ] – but the filtration velocity in this case will be around 47m/h – which is rather high for a softener!

I suggest using for this application at least 800-850L softener [ the tank used in this case is 42x72 ] – resulting a filtration velocity of 34m/h –assuring a medium contact time, or for a optimal filtration velocity – 48x72 tanks [ and 1000-1100L of resin on each tank] – resulting a velocity of around 26m/h.

For sure you want to integrate an industrial skid softener [ considering you also want to control the unit manually ]. I have sent you several photos with similar softeners integrated in different projects as a reference.

Now what is unclear for me in this tender - from the technical point of view, is the following:

What will this treated water be used for? Is this for a steam boiler?

I am asking this because the treated water parameters are a little problematic to be achieved:

the pH of 9.5-1.5 , but the initial pH is around 7.8 [ I think this can be assured only through dosing of NaOH in the water not to influence hardness ]

The iron level < 0.3μg/L – but the initial iron level is around 10 μg/L – so the softener will most probably adsorb a small part of the iron ions [ this as a secondary effect], but has no control on how much will be retained.

You need the Oxidability of the water to be 30 mgO2/L [ permanganate index] - [ this normally in the water treatment plants – means the water will be very contaminated with mostly organic compounds] – I think this is not correct asked .

Normally for this type of softeners the max operating pressure should not exceed 6-7bar. [ in the tender is asked for a 10bar system]

What is the current state of this tender – you are in construction phase/ project phase ?

I saw you also need a 2d/3d model for the softener in max 2 weeks from order, this I will need to check with the producer if it can be available or not . But first we need to clarify what type of vessel should we use, pipping of the skid, automation etc.

Can you tell me more about the scope of the treated water ?

For sure we can schedule a teams meeting as well in the following days, but I suggest first to have a clear view of what equipment will be proper for your application [ because depending of the options we are limited from each producer].

I am looking forward in receiving your response!

Best regards,

messages.subject: Interventie de mentenanta - 13.08.2026
messages.body:
Buna ziua,

Va informam ca interventia de mentenanta s-a finalizat cu success.

Va las anexat copie la procesul verbal de service.

Ca si mentiuni:

Locatie 1 – LUDWA 1 - Statie dedurizare

Sistemul de dedurizare lucreaza, are si debit prin instalatie si apa tratata este dedurizata.

Este intr-adevar acel tremurat in tevi – in special din traseul principal si pana la racordul flexibil ce alimenteaza sistemului de dedurizare - Colegul a scris in procesul verbal despre circuitul hidraulic, insa eu tind sa cred ca este o problema strict la una din VANE sau Reductori montati pe acest traseu care sunt pe punctul de a ceda. [ cel mai probabil reductorul imi poate creea aceste vibratii]. Poate reusiti sa verificati cu un instalator aceste piese

Locatie 2 – Ludwa 2 – Statie dedurizare

Aici totul este absolut in regula .

Timpul de umplere al tankului de saramura a fost micsorat inca de acum 2-3 luni cand am venit si am schimbat ansamblul de actionare. Aici am scazut putin timpul de umplere pentru ca mi s-a sesizat ca mereu a adus apa foarte multa! .

Colegul oricum a efectuat o dedurizare completa si butoiul a fost reumplut automat cu apa cam 1/3 din tank [ e foarte bine asa] . Nivelul de apa trebuie sa treaca peste platan cu minim 5-10 cm la statia dumneavoastra, dar nu mai mult de 30cm [ statia are nevoie de 30-40 de L de saramura in total]

Daca totusi considerati ca este nevoie de mai multa apa [ se poate mari timpul de umplere inapoi ]- dar din constatarea de astazi consideram ca nu este cazul !

Colegii mei vor reveni cu factura pentru interventia de astazi.

Cu respect,

Cu respect,

Nr. Produs: La cerere

The Grundfos CMBE booster is a compact booster system for water supply in domestic applications.
The integrated speed controller enables the CMBE booster to keep constant pressure in the pipe system.
A pressure sensor monitoring changes in the water consumption signals the speed controller to change motor speed to adapt
performance to the new state.
The CMBE booster is very easy to install. When the system has been connected to the pipes, it is all a matter of inserting the plug into a
power supply socket, and the system is operational.
The CMBE booster consists of the following:
• CME pump with integrated frequency converter
• Five-way valve
• expansion tank
• pressure gauge

The Grundfos CMBE booster requires no external motor protection.
The MGE motor incorporates thermal protection against slow overloading and blocking (IEC 34.11: TP 211).

The Grundfos CMBE booster is mainly used for domestic and light commercial water supply or booster systems.

messages.subject: RE: AKRO :: Cerere oferta
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Veselin Mitev,

Thank you very much for your request!

Ozone Air 3000 – together with the smaller versions + the air disinfection generators – are all for residential purpose.

The producer is : KRAUSEN

Regarding the functionality of the residential equipment – the system has a build in air pump - that is feeding the ozone module directly with no other – molecular sleeve. I am sending you the data sheet for the ozone air 3000 .

This systems cost in the range of 200-400 euro and for sure they are not built to work in laboratory conditions.

Could you please clarify what is the scope of this ozone generator request? In this way we can supply you a recommendation

Why do you need a ozone generator ? [ the purpose of its dosing?] – oxidation or disinfection?

Can you describe the application ? [ it is for industrial or residential purpose?]

What is the capacity of ozone required /h? [ ozone dosing capacity g/h?]

I am looking forward in receiving your response!

Best regards,

From: Akro <office@akro.ro>
Sent: Monday, August 17, 2026 9:27 AM
To: sales@akro.ro
Subject: AKRO :: Cerere oferta

O noua cerere a fost trimisa de pe site:

Denumire produs: Generator de ozon OZONE AIR 1000-3000 WATER
Link produs: https://akro.ro/produse/produs/generator-de-ozon-ozone-air-1000-3000-water/

Nume: Veselin
Prenume: Mitev
Adresa de email: veselin_8211@abv.bg
Numar de telefon: 359878277669
Cantitate:
Companie:
Mesaj: Hello, I am interested in the OZONE AIR 3000 WATER generator and I would like to clarify a few technical details before purchasing: What ozone generation technology does it use (Corona Discharge, DBD, electrolysis, etc.)? What is the material and construction of the ozone-generating cell/tube? Is it ceramic, quartz, titanium or another material? Does it use ambient air or pure oxygen as the feed gas? Does it have an air dryer? What is the actual ozone concentration at the outlet (mg/L or g/mÂł) and what is the gas flow rate for the 3000 mg/h model? DATASHEET

Sorbotech® GE 604
Sorbotech® GE 604 is an extruded activated carbon manufactured
from selected grades of coal. Its high developed surface area allows
effective adsorption of a wide range of organic compounds present
in gases or air streams. Its perfectly available pore distribution makes
it an excellent medium for industrial applications and ventilation
systems.

SPECIFICATION

CTC min. 60 % Typical applications
Granulation 4 mm
 Volitale organic compounds
Moisture content max. 5 % removal
Bulk denisty approx. 480 kg/m3  Fume hood filters production
 Spray booth filters
Hardness min. 95 %
 Asphalt, solvent and fuel
Ash content max. 15 % fumes filtration
 Odor removal
STORAGE  Siloxanes removal

Packaging
Activated carbon should be stored in sealed, unopened packages
in dry place with temperature 5 – 40° C, away from sources of ignition and solvent  20 kg bags
vapours. Exposure to direct sunlight and moisture should be limited.
 500/550 kg big bags

SAFETY

Wet activated carbon adsorbs oxygen from the air, what causes danger while
working inside containers with activated carbon in closed or poorly ventilated
places.

Under certain conditions, during contact with oxidizing agents and some organic
compounds such as ketones (e.g. acetone), acrylates, esters, volatile acids,
amines etc. activated carbon may react exothermally. In case of rapid
temperature increase cooling with water is recommended.

messages.subject: Recommendation of treatment water flux
messages.body:
Hello Ansgar,

The client with the GP 60 [ that I asked for several weeks ago] – wants to use the unit to doze ozone in water in order to obtain – disinfection water [ mostly used for cleaning the treatment lines / backwash / technological water].

The brute water is excellent [ conductivity no more than 200 microS/cm , iron, manganese levels are nearly 0 , no microbiology or other parameters that can be oxidize]

I am sending you the flux our client wants to build in his Fabric with the GP 60.

Could you please send us you recommendation of where to mount the ozone generator in order to obtain the maximum potential of it ? [ it will be better to mount it in a closed loop on one of the tanks?]

How should we make the injection into the water ? [ I mean through venturi injector and based on what parameter?]

Please also support us with a general automation that they need to built [ when the system to stop/start – maybe it must be controlled 4-20mA].

I am looking forward for your response!

Best regards,

EnergyMetering

Modul de comunicații EDC
Modul atașabil pe contoarele de apă pentru
citirea sigură de la distanță pentru
integrarea contoarelor de apă în Sistemele
de Contorizare Inteligentă AMR/AMI

Tot ce contează.
EnergyMetering

Modul de comunicații EDC
Modul de comunicații AMR/AMI
pentru contoarele de apă

Aplicații tipice:
■ Citirea wireless de la distanță a contoarelor de apă cu sistemul

inteligent de contorizare
■ Citirea de la distanță a contoarelor cu Sisteme M-Bus

■ Citirea de la distanță prin modulul GSM

■ Contorizarea precisă a fluidelor din sectorul industrial și comercial

■ Informații despre volumul debitului și consum cu

ajutorul traductorului
Modul de Captură Electronică a Datelor (EDC)
pentru detectarea impulsurilor electronice, nereactive a
tuturor contoarelor de apă ZENNER ale căror sisteme
de înregistrare sunt echipate cu disc modulator ce
permite citirea în siguranță de la distanță și integrarea
contoarelor de apă în sistemele de Contorizare
Inteligentă.

Modulul EDC a fost dezvoltat pentru:
■ Contoarele cu cadran uscat monojet ETKD/ETWD

■ Contoarele cu cadran uscat multijet MTKD/MTWD

■ Contoarele cu pistom rotativ RTKD-S

■ Contoarele industriale WPHD / WSD

3
EnergyMetering

1. Modul radio wireless M-Bus conform Standardului
Modulul EDC este
OMS (868 MHz), EN 13757-4
disponibil în patru
2. Modul cu fir M-Bus, EN 13757-3
versiuni diferite
3. Modul cu impuls de înaltă definiție cu

detecție a debitului de tur și retur
4. Modul combinat M-Bus și de impuls

Contorul de apă poate fi dotat cu modulul EDC necesar
în timpul producției sau ulterior, putându-i-se atașa un
modul adaptor.

Caracteristici de performanță:
■ Baterie cu durata de viață de până la 15 ani

■ Detectarea modificărilor

■ Clasa de protecție IP68

■ Adaptabil fără distrugerea etanșărilor

■ Detectarea direcției de curgere a apei

■ Colectarea datelor în siguranță fără folosirea

comutatoarelor ermetice cu gaz inert
■ Interfață optică pentru configurare

■ Potrivit pentru contoarele de apă ZENNER cu jet unic,

jet multiplu, tip piston și Woltman cu disc modulator

4
Modulul EDC oferă toate funcțiile
importante pentru contoarele inteligente

Funcțiile Contoarelor Inteligente:
■ Auto-monitorizare

■ Detectarea modificărilor

■ Detectarea demontării modulului și contorului

■ Detectarea fluxului invers al apei

■ Detectarea scurgerilor

■ Detectarea opririi contorului

■ Detectarea supradimensionării contorului

■ Detectarea subdimensionării contorului și respectiv detectarea spargerii conductei

Configurație:
Configurația modulului EDC în cazul modernizării de exemplu se
face prin interfața optică folosind ZENNER MinoConnect cu
ZENNER IrCombiHead și software de configurare GMM. Soluții
software alternative la cerere.

messages.subject: FW: Recommendation of treatment water flux
messages.body:
Raspuns de la AIRTREE

From: a.brockamp@airtree-europe.com <a.brockamp@airtree-europe.com>
Sent: Thursday, August 20, 2026 12:35 PM
To: 'AKRO Romania , Alexandru Soare' <alexandru.soare@akro.ro>
Subject: AW: Recommendation of treatment water flux

Dear Alexandru,

thank you for the inquiry.

First of all, you have to make sure if this application falls under the strict European Biocidal Products Regulation.

This requires special certificates (product approval) for ozone generators used for disinfection.

You are right: The ozone should be in contact with as much water as possible and for the longest possible duration of time.

For more precise design recommendations we are interested into the following information:

What is the water flow rate (average, min., max.) for consumer fabric (box no. 8)?

Is the consumption continuous or discontinuous?

What pressure do we have in pipes and tanks?

Is a residual ozone concentration in the water allowed for customers production?

Is there critical material in the entire process which could be not ozone resistant (e.g. gaskets, filter,…)?

Are the tanks covered, is there a breathing pipe?

Which water temperatures in the tanks could be expected in summer?

Thanks and best regards

Ansgar

Hello Ansgar,

The client with the GP 60 [ that I asked for several weeks ago] – wants to use the unit to doze ozone in water in order to obtain – disinfection water [ mostly used for cleaning the treatment lines / backwash / technological water].

The brute water is excellent [ conductivity no more than 200 microS/cm , iron, manganese levels are nearly 0 , no microbiology or other parameters that can be oxidize]

I am sending you the flux our client wants to build in his Fabric with the GP 60.

Could you please send us you recommendation of where to mount the ozone generator in order to obtain the maximum potential of it ? [ it will be better to mount it in a closed loop on one of the tanks?]

How should we make the injection into the water ? [ I mean through venturi injector and based on what parameter?]

Please also support us with a general automation that they need to built [ when the system to stop/start – maybe it must be controlled 4-20mA].

I am looking forward for your response!

Best regards,

Dear Sir/Madam,

The ozone generator is intended for residential use, mainly for:

treatment of drinking/water for household use;

washing and treatment of fruits and vegetables;

occasional disinfection/oxidation applications.

The main reason I am interested in the Ozone Air 3000 is the 3000 mg/h capacity. I am looking for a reliable residential ozone generator with good ozone production and good long-term durability.

I would therefore appreciate it if you could clarify one more technical point:

What exact ozone-generation technology is used in the KRAUSEN Ozone Air 3000, and what is the material/construction of the ozone-generating cell or module (ceramic, quartz, titanium, etc.)?

Thank you in advance.

Best regards,

От: AKRO Romania , Alexandru Soare
Относно: RE: AKRO :: Cerere oferta
До:

Dear Mr. Veselin Mitev,

Thank you very much for your request!

Ozone Air 3000 – together with the smaller versions + the air disinfection generators – are all for residential purpose.

The producer is : KRAUSEN

Regarding the functionality of the residential equipment – the system has a build in air pump - that is feeding the ozone module directly with no other – molecular sleeve. I am sending you the data sheet for the ozone air 3000 .

This systems cost in the range of 200-400 euro and for sure they are not built to work in laboratory conditions.

Could you please clarify what is the scope of this ozone generator request? In this way we can supply you a recommendation

Why do you need a ozone generator ? [ the purpose of its dosing?] – oxidation or disinfection?

Can you describe the application ? [ it is for industrial or residential purpose?]

What is the capacity of ozone required /h? [ ozone dosing capacity g/h?]

I am looking forward in receiving your response!

Best regards,

Subject: Project in aquisition state.

Hello Gokhan,

I hope this e-mail finds you well!

We are working on a project for ARTROM STEELTUBES – and we are in the acquisition state for this [ we need just to receive some water analysis to confirm the solution and we will be ready to order]

I will explain. The Client has some problems with tetra and trichloroethylene . We should normally be able to remove this from well water with a simple chlorination and then activated carbon filtration [ we have chose a special carbon for this application ] . We have sent a small pilot filter – to test the solution at a scale and we are waiting for the water analysis to confirm it. If everything is well, and it should, we need to start the acquisition process in the following days.

What I need from you is a price quotation and estimated delivery time for :

3 automatic filters with valve skid – with FRP tank 48x72:

We need the skid to be built with electric actuated valves

The filters will be offered without media [ we will bring the special carbon which we already tested]

The filters must start regeneration at a set time

The filters will be mount in parallel – all active . So we can built this with only a general PLC

The filters will backwash with water from the same source .

If possible to offer also the connection between the 3 filters [ we are looking for a general DN 80 distributor for inlet and a DN 80 general distributor for outlet.

It will be good to have 2 extra electric actuated valves for spare parts

We have initially offered to the client this project with BS-4872 filters [ data sheet attached] – but we want to order this from AO SMITH [ to start the collaboration].

messages.body:
Buna ziua,

Firma AKRO nu activeaza in tratarea apelor uzate, prin urmare nu va putem prezenta o propunere in aceasta directie.

Suntem specializati in tot tratarea apelor primare cu scop de potabilizare sau obtinere ape tehnice.

Pentru orice alte intrebari din domeniul tratarii apelor, va stam cu placere la dispozitie!

Numai bine,

From: Petru Rumega <petru.rumega@luzconstruct.ro>
Sent: Tuesday, August 25, 2026 8:41 AM
To: terradinamic@gmail.com
Subject: Cerere de ofertă DNK-010-16 – Stație de tratare și dezinfectare ape uzate medicale

Stimate Domnule / Stimată Doamnă,

Prin prezenta, vă rugăm să ne transmiteți o ofertă de preț și termenul de livrare pentru o stație compactă de tratare și dezinfectare a apelor uzate medicale (sau componentele aferente), destinată unei clinici dentare.

Cerințe și specificații tehnice:

Debit de procesare: 3 m³/zi (funcționare în flux continuu)

Gabarit maxim disponibil: L = 4,0 m × l = 2,0 m × H = 2,0 m

Putere electrică maximă consumată: 4 kW (alimentare 230V / 400V)

Temperatura mediului de lucru: +5°C

Calitate apă evacuată: Conform normativ NTPA 002/2002 (deversare în rețeaua publică)

Configurație tehnologică / Echipamente incluse:

Bazin sterilizare cu Ozon: Ø 800 mm, H 1000 mm (1 buc) + Generator ozon (capacitate 8 g/h)

Bazin sterilizare cu UV: Ø 800 mm, H 1000 mm (1 buc) + Lămpi UV imersate (2 buc)

Bazin sterilizare cu Clor: Ø 800 mm, H 1000 mm (1 buc)

Sistem dozare NaClO: Rezervor stocare 20 L + Pompă dozatoare hipoclorit ($Q_{\text{max}} = 8\text{ l/h}$)

Pompe recirculare/transvazare: Rezistente la medii oxidante (3 buc)

Automatizare: Tablou electric complet de comandă și control

Auxiliare: Set complet de montaj și racordare

Vă rugăm să ne precizați în ofertă:

Prețul unitar (fără TVA) și condițiile de plată

Termenul de livrare și garanția oferită

Asistența la montaj / punere în funcțiune (dacă este inclusă)

Așteptăm răspunsul dumneavoastră pe această adresă de e-mail.

Vă mulțumim!

Cu stimă,

--

Petru Rumega

Manager de Proiect

+40 775 382 796

petru.rumega@luzconstruct.ro

Building Value. Building Legacy.

messages.subject: RE: Modul separare -filtrare particule solide
messages.body:
Salutare Sorin,

Variante de filtre cu spalare automata asa de mici nu avem in portofoliu.

Problema este ca daca crepina actuala se infunda rapid tind sa cred ca este o turbiditate > 20 NTU in apa [ sau ceva particule mari sunt antrenate de pompa [ adica pompa este supradimensionata sau pozitionata gresit].

Oricum ar fi sunt doua solutii pe care le pot recomanda , sa fie si intr-un buget nu foarte ridicat:

1 – sa faceti o linistire inainte de alimentarea filtrelor [un decantor] - [ asa se asigura si o mai buna oxidare a fierului/manganului iar particulele mari ar trebui sa ramana la fundul vasului.

Eventual sa montati un filtru cu purjare manuala si ceva element filtrant lavabil. Noi lucram cu CINTROPUR – si as recomanda un filtru NW400 [ pentru suprafata mai mare, echipat cu membrana de 150 sau 300 microni. La acest filtru exista si purjare manuala.

Eventual daca se doreste o automatizare se poate monta o electrovana de ½” cu timer pe aceasta purjare dar nu avem astfel de produs in stoc .

Fisa tehnica NW400 - https://akro.ro/public/fise/282-Fisa_tehnica_Filtru_mecanic_sedimente_NW280-340-400.pdf

Pret Filtru NW400 - pentru ICPE - complet echipat - 270 euro fara TVA

Carcasa de filtru – cu 2 o-ladnezi de 1.5” ,

2 manometre

Consola de prindere

Cheie

Cartus din PP dur – echipat cu membrana 300 microni sau 150 [ la cerere]

Doar ca momentan nu avem in stoc – estimam reaprovizionarea in 2-3 saptamani.

Cu respect,

From: Sorin Ulinici <sorin_ulinici@icpebn.ro>
Sent: Tuesday, August 25, 2026 12:18 PM
To: AKRO Romania , Alexandru Soare <alexandru.soare@akro.ro>
Subject: Modul separare -filtrare particule solide

Salut Alexandru,

Acum mai multa veme discutasem cu voi in legatura cu sisteme de separare mecanica, cred ca la momentul respectiv era vorba de ceva sisteme dedicate pentru irigatii (daca imi aduc aminte..)

Am o problema la un sistem semidomestic, acasa la unul din colaboratorii nostri , unde are un filtru cu pirolusita sub presiune de 16" alimentat cu apa dintr-un foraj, utilizat pentru apa de spalat caile de acces (dale cu pretentii...) si gazon (apa din foraj are continut ridicat de Fe, pentru declorinare are si un filtru CAG dupa pirolusita)

Problema consta in faptul ca particulele solide antrenate din foraj infunda fantele crepinei superioare (0.4 mm cred ) si presiunea pe filtru creste mult, cu scaderea debitului, chiar si dupa spalari succesive. Am desfacut filtrul si colegul meu a gasit particule "indesate" in sectiunea fantei.

Puteti recomannda o varianta de filtru cu ciclon, care sa poata functiona la debit emici de 0,8-1,2 mc/ h, pentru separarea particulelor solide ?

Dupa unitatea cu ciclon as vrea sa pun si un filtru cu cartus detasabil.

Multumesc.

-- Sorin ULINICIS.C. ICPE Bistrita S.A.Manager produs- Tehnologii si statii de tratare apa potabilawww.icpebn.ro sorin_ulinici@icpebn.roTel.0263210938/0263210747Mobil: 0723-151451

Hello Gokhan,

I hope this e-mail finds you well!

We are working on a project for ARTROM STEELTUBES – and we are in the acquisition state for this [ we need just to receive some water analysis to confirm the solution and we will be ready to order]

I will explain. The Client has some problems with tetra and trichloroethylene . We should normally be able to remove this from well water with a simple chlorination and then activated carbon filtration [ we have chose a special carbon for this application ] . We have sent a small pilot filter – to test the solution at a scale and we are waiting for the water analysis to confirm it. If everything is well, and it should, we need to start the acquisition process in the following days.

What I need from you is a price quotation and estimated delivery time for :

3 automatic filters with valve skid – with FRP tank 48x72:

We need the skid to be built with electric actuated valves

The filters will be offered without media [ we will bring the special carbon which we already tested]

The filters must start regeneration at a set time

The filters will be mount in parallel – all active . So we can built this with only a general PLC

The filters will backwash with water from the same source .

If possible to offer also the connection between the 3 filters [ we are looking for a general DN 80 distributor for inlet and a DN 80 general distributor for outlet.

It will be good to have 2 extra electric actuated valves for spare parts

We have initially offered to the client this project with BS-4872 filters [ data sheet attached] – but we want to order this from AO SMITH [ to start the collaboration].

I also attached a drawing with the filter battery – just as for info!

I am looking forward in receiving your response!

If you need any other clarifications , I am at your dispose !

Best regards,

Referitor la problema semnalata, singurul mod in care rasina sa ajunga in flux , este ca partea de jos [ spirala cu crepina] – sa fie taiata/rupta/ cu probleme.

Problema este ca la tipul acesta de butelii, nu putem ajunge la crepina de jos pentru ca circuitul este confectionat tot din inox. [ Vom face niste fotografii cu butelia goala]

Buna ziua Dl. Saramet!

Gasiti atasat oferta de pret pentru un generator de 60 grame, dublu la capacitate in comparatie cu cel care trebuie livrat in urmatoarele zile.

Pentru solutia de tratare a apei tehnologice o sa apelam la furnizorul nostru din Germania pentru a primi o recomandare tehnica.

Mai sunt cateva chestiuni tehnice de lamurit. Vezi lista de intrebari mai jos.

Am atasat o schema generala pentru a avea o baza de discutie.

Debitul maxim și debitul mediu la iesirea din bazinul de stocare apa bruta, în m³/h.

Care este consumul zilnic estimat pentru apa tehnologica?

Care este debitul maxim instantaneu către consumatori, de la cele doua bazine de apa filtrata?

Cele două bazine funcționează:

în serie, bazinul 1 alimentând bazinul 2;

alternativ;

sau independent?

Cele doua bazina cu apa filtrata se umplu direct din aceeași linie de apa bruta prin selectarea unui bazin sau vor fi două linii separate care alimenteaza cele doua bazine?

Timpul maxim în care apa poate rămâne în fiecare bazin.

Bazinele sunt închise și au conducte de aerisire controlabile?

Se acceptă un rezidual de ozon la consumator sau se doreste o valoare nedetectabilă a ozonului in apa?

Daca apa este distribuită către angajați ca apă potabilă, aceast detaliu schimbă criteriul de ozon rezidual la ieșire si implicit fluxul tehnologic. Va rog clarificati.

Astept cu interesraspunsul dvs.

Remanenta ozonului este de 30 de minute iar o recirculare pe bazinele de apa filtrate necesita pompe foarte mari;

Daca se face dozare pe iesirea apei din bazinul de filtrare am nevoie de un bazin de contact pentru amestec; Daca nu am bazin nu pot controla doza de ozon la iesire;

Tehnologia este mai complexa si necesita monitorizare ridicata;

Investitia este mai mare in comparatie cu UV-ul

Apa este foarte buna fizico-chimic si microbiologic;

Solutia tehnica este mai usor de implementat si de exploatat iar valoarea de achizitie a echipamentelor este mai mica in comparatie cu ozonatorul.

Varianta prezentata contine un system de filtrare in trei trepte cu saci filtranti sau cartuse filtrante, cu system UV dupa filtrare, system UV cu recircularea apei in bazin sau UV imersat in bazin pentru eliminarea contaminarii microbiologice din aer.

Detalii statie tratare apa tehnologica cu ozon

Buna ziua Dl. Saramet!

Gasiti atasat oferta de pret pentru un generator de 60 grame, dublu la capacitate in comparatie cu cel care trebuie livrat in urmatoarele zile.

Pentru solutia de tratare a apei tehnologice o sa apelam la furnizorul nostru din Germania pentru a primi o recomandare tehnica.

Mai sunt cateva chestiuni tehnice de lamurit. Vezi lista de intrebari mai jos.

Am atasat o schema generala pentru a avea o baza de discutie.

Debitul maxim și debitul mediu la iesirea din bazinul de stocare apa bruta, în m³/h.

Care este consumul zilnic estimat pentru apa tehnologica?

Care este debitul maxim instantaneu către consumatori, de la cele doua bazine de apa filtrata?

Cele două bazine funcționează:

în serie, bazinul 1 alimentând bazinul 2;

alternativ;

sau independent?

Cele doua bazina cu apa filtrata se umplu direct din aceeași linie de apa bruta prin selectarea unui bazin sau vor fi două linii separate care alimenteaza cele doua bazine?

Timpul maxim în care apa poate rămâne în fiecare bazin.

Bazinele sunt închise și au conducte de aerisire controlabile?

Se acceptă un rezidual de ozon la consumator sau se doreste o valoare nedetectabilă a ozonului in apa?

Daca apa este distribuită către angajați ca apă potabilă, aceast detaliu schimbă criteriul de ozon rezidual la ieșire si implicit fluxul tehnologic. Va rog clarificati.

Astept cu interesraspunsul dvs.

From: Mihai Saramet <mihai.saramet@valvis-holding.com>
Sent: Tuesday, July 28, 2026 1:36 PM

Cc: 'AKRO Romania , Alexandru Soare' <alexandru.soare@akro.ro>; 'Alexandru Soare' <sales@akro.ro>
Subject: RE: Detalii statie tratare apa tehnologica cu ozon

Stimate domn ,

In urama analizei interne , am ales petru tratarea apei tehnologice , varianta cu ozon . In consecinta vom redesena fluxul de tratare -filtrare stocare . In principiu tancurile dr stocare vor fi aceleasi , 3x150 mc , unul pt apa bruta si celelalte doua pt apa tratata filtrata .

Va rog sa ne propuneti un dozator de ozon , similar cu cel acceptat deja pt linia de sticla dar pt debitul mai mare al apei tratate .

Daca sunt necesare detalii , in afara de cele comunicate pt fluxul de tratare cu UV , va rog sa-mi spuneti .

Multumesc .

Cu stima/Best regards ,

Mihail Gavril Saramet

+40 740 307653

From: aurel.caras@akro.ro <aurel.caras@akro.ro>

Subject: RE: Detalii statie tratare apa tehnologica cu ozon

Buna ziua Dl. Saramet,

Am analizat informatiile primite de la dvs si vin cu o propunere pentru a pastra apa tehnologica filtrate si dezinfectata..

Vezi atasat schita Draft 1 care suporta modificari in functie de dorinta dvs.

De ce NU am propus ozon?

Remanenta ozonului este de 30 de minute iar o recirculare pe bazinele de apa filtrate necesita pompe foarte mari;

Daca se face dozare pe iesirea apei din bazinul de filtrare am nevoie de un bazin de contact pentru amestec; Daca nu am bazin nu pot controla doza de ozon la iesire;

Apa nu poate fi potabila datorita nivelului de ozon; pentru potabilizare trebuie eliminat ozonul remanent din apa;

Tehnologia este mai complexa si necesita monitorizare ridicata;

Investitia este mai mare in comparatie cu UV-ul

De ce am ales UV?

Apa este foarte buna fizico-chimic si microbiologic;

Solutia tehnica este mai usor de implementat si de exploatat iar valoarea de achizitie a echipamentelor este mai mica in comparatie cu ozonatorul.

Varianta prezentata contine un system de filtrare in trei trepte cu saci filtranti sau cartuse filtrante, cu system UV dupa filtrare, system UV cu recircularea apei in bazin sau UV imersat in bazin pentru eliminarea contaminarii microbiologice din aer.

In functie de solutia aleasa si debitele stabilite putem contura un budget pentru acest proiect.

Astept cu interes raspunsul dvs.

Cu consideratie,

From: Mihai Saramet <mihai.saramet@valvis-holding.com>
Sent: Friday, July 17, 2026 3:42 PM

Stimate domn ,

Referitor la compozitia apei , am trimis si ieri i-l trimit astazi din nou , sunt suficiente date pt a-l analiza si trata cu ozon pt utilizarea sursei ca apa tehnologica .

Este apa de izvor si va fi utilizata ca apa tehnologica si menajera .

Calitatea sa fie de potabila , pt ca presupun ca mai beau de la robinet oamenii din fabrica .

Debitul pt tratare ar trebui sa veniti dvs cu o sugestie , sursa are debit variabil pt ca este mai de suprafata , acum are doar 1.7 l/s dar poate creste chiar dublu in sezonul ploios sau primavara .

Depinde de tipul de filtre , daca vor fi de unica folosinta sau cu spalare inversa . Daca vor fi cu spalare inversa se va utiliza apa tratata/filtrata din tancurile de stocare ale statiei .

Statie filtrare , tancuri , legaturi , etc. numai inox . Nu stiu ce presupune instalatia dvs , din aceasta cauza v-am solicitat o propunere dar vad ca trece timpul si nu am avansat deloc. V-am spus de la inceput ca va fi apa tehnologica si nu de imbuteliere , sa fie ffff clar , va rog . O sa-mi spuneti dvs ce spatiu necesita instalatia propusa de dvs .

Ati venit cu o serie de intrebari ca pentru cei de la o Primarie , cred ca v-am raspuns suficient ca sa-mi faceti o propunere de instalatie daca se doreste sa fim parteneri si in acest proiect .

Multumesc .

Cu stima/Best regards ,

Mihail Gavril Saramet

+40 740 307653

From: AKRO Romania , Alexandru Soare <alexandru.soare@akro.ro>

Buna ziua Dl Saramet,

Va rog clarificati :

In primul rand , va rog sa imi furnizati buletinul de analiza – daca s-a trimis anterior, acesta s-a pierdut pe undeva

In al doilea rand – la ce va fi folosita aceasta apa si ce tip de apa este aceasta? Apa minerala naturala, de masa, de izvor etc?

La ce calitate se doreste a se ajunge cu apa tratata?

Care este debitul orar de tratare?

Care este necesarul de productie in 24h

Ati spus ca se doreste ca eventualele filtre sa se spele dintr-o alta sursa de apa. Asigurati dumneavoastra aceasta apa si pomparea ?Daca nu, va rog sa ne transmiteti:

Daca exista un bazin de stocare apa spalare si capacitatea lui

La ce calitate este apa de spalare?

Care este diferenta de nivel intre bazinul stocator si platforma unde vor fi montate filtrele?

Se poate monta o pompa care lucreaza innecat [ ma gandesc totusi ca da , din moment ce ati spus ca va fi o cladire anexa bazinelor , dedicata pentru pompe]

Se doreste ca filtrele sa se goleasca complet la finalul ciclurilor de spalare , astfel incat sa nu fie contaminat produsul?

Se doreste o oferta la cheie cu montaj? – daca da , rugam si o disponibilitate de spatiu – sau desen de amplasament;

Rog informatii cu privire la preferintele de montaj. Se doreste lucrat in inox?

Pe partea de automatizare a statiei, ne puteti trimite daca:

Se doreste un PLC general de unde sa puteti controla intreaga instalatie?

Se doreste monitorizare sau/si control de la distanta?

Se doreste SCADA?

Aveti preferinte despre monitorizarea/ inregistrarea si afisarea anumitor parametrii?

[ Spre exemplu – consum de apa de spalare, sau monitorizare ozon remanent in apa, sau monitorizare pH etc..]

Va rog un raspuns in aceasta directie, Dl Caras, m-a asignat acestui proiect pentru dimensionare.

Numai bine,

Sent: Friday, July 17, 2026 12:40 PM

Cc: 'AKRO Romania , Alexandru Soare' <alexandru.soare@akro.ro>
Subject: RE: Detalii statie tratare apa tehnologica cu ozon

Stimate domn ,

Va rog sa vedeti mai jos ceea ce am discutat si la telefon .

Este un proiect care pleaca de la zero , exista sursa cu buletinul de analiza transmis anterior si locul unde se va amplasa Statie de Filtrare si Stocare apa tehnologica . Vor fi 3 tancuri de 150 mc fiecare , suprateran , cu fundatii conforme , din care unul va fi pentru apa bruta iar celelalte doua pentru filtrata . Subject: AW: Recommendation of treatment water flux_Aqua Carpatica

Dear Alexandru,,

thank you for customers information.

We are not able to design and engineer the complete ozone treatment process, but we would like to give you some recommendations:

If there is no residual ozone in the water allowed at the consumption point you have to destruct it.

UV lamps (254 nm) with higher dosage (e.g. 850 J/m2) are often used for this application. Approx 0,2 ppm of ozone in the water in front of such a lamp will convert to 0 ppm after the lamp.

Of course, to be sure a measurement should be installed.

On the drawing it is not clear how the tanks are connected.

Ozone could be injected e.g. in a tank circulation of the first tank. The ozonized water of this tank flows further to the other tanks where the ozone concentration decreases so that only a rest of ozone (if any) must be destructed by UV.

At the tank with ozone injection the highest ozone concentration in the gas phase must be expected. The ozone gas that has not dissolved in the water escapes into the atmosphere and leaves the tank via the “breathing pipe”. This gas is toxic and corrosive and must be destroyed by an ozone destructor. The catalyst material converts ozone back into oxygen.

Size of destructor depends on the total gas flow rate at the “breathing pipe”.

Please find enclosed sketch of the principle “first tank ozone circulation”.

A measurement device between pump and injector can control the ozone generator by 4 – 20 mA signal.

If the water residence time in the other tanks becomes too long, recirculating the water to the first tank could be an option.

Best regards

Subject: Cerere oferta HCS SANISHOP SRL

Bina ziua

Rog pret pt o statie de dedurizare:

DATE TEHNICE PENTRU CEREREA NOASTRA : Am un apartament cu urmatorii consumatori care pot fi simultani : dus A- 30 l/min ,dus B cu 12 l/min si bucatarie cu 12 l/min.Am un boiler de 300 l acm ,bransament de apa de Dn 32.Presiunea satatica din reteaua orasului Brasov este de 5-6 bari (necesita un regulator de presiune) .Ce statie de dedurizare ar trebui sa am pentru a deserve acesti consumatori care pot fi simultani.Mentionez ca am suficent loc de montaj in camera tehnica.

Pentru a deservi toți consumatorii simultan la parametrii optimi, aveți nevoie de o stație de dedurizare care să asigure un debit nominal de cel puțin 3,24 m³/h. Din gama oferită de Black Sea Suppliers, modelul ideal pentru cerințele dumneavoastră este Statie dedurizare simplex STILLWATER & PRATT – STP-S 70V CLACK, care oferă un debit de 4,2 m³/h. [1]

1. Calculul debitului simultan de vârf

• Duș 1: 30 l/min

• Duș 2: 12 l/min

• Bucătărie: 12 l/min

• Total: 54 l/min \(\times \) 60 min = 3.240 l/h (3,24 m³/h)

2. De ce modelul STP-S 70V CLACK?

• Debitul nominal: Modelul imediat inferior (STP-S 50V) asigură doar 3,0 m³/h, fiind sub consumul maxim simultan calculat. Modelul STP-S 70V CLACK acoperă integral vârful de sarcină (4,2 m³/h) fără a genera pierderi mari de presiune în momentele de utilizare intensivă. [1]

• Capacitate ciclică mare: Având un volum de 70 de litri de rășină, stația se va regenera mai rar, protejând boilerul masiv de 300 litri și reducând consumul de sare și apă la regenerare. [1, 2]

• Componente de top: Vana de control CLACK (SUA) este recunoscută pentru fiabilitate ridicată și configurare volumetrică precisă. [1]

3. Recomandări tehnice pentru montaj în camera tehnică

• Regulatorul de presiune: Este obligatoriu. Presiunea statică de 5-6 bari din Brașov se află exact la limita maximă de lucru a stației (6 bar). Se recomandă montarea unui regulator de presiune robust pe racordul principal DN 32, reglat la o valoare de 3,5 - 4 bari, pentru a proteja atât dedurizatorul, cât și restul instalației (inclusiv boilerul). [1]

• Dimensionare racorduri: Deși branșamentul este DN 32, vana Clack standard are de regulă conexiuni de 1" sau 1 1/4". Se vor folosi reducții adecvate fără a strangula debitul. [1]

• Filtrare preliminară: Înainte de stația de dedurizare, montați un filtru mecanic de sedimente (de exemplu, un filtru cu cartuș lavabil sau cu autocurățare tot din gama Black Sea Suppliers) pentru a opri impuritățile care pot deteriora vana Clack.

Pentru rețeaua publică din Brașov administrată de Compania Apa Brașov, duritatea apei este moderată, având o valoare medie de aproximativ 14 grade germane (°dH) (echivalentul a ~250 ppm CaCO₃). [1, 2]

Folosind această valoare de 14 °dH pentru modelul STP-S 70V CLACK (care are 70 de litri de rășină schimbătoare de ioni), iată datele de exploatare:

Autonomie și consum estimat

• Capacitate ciclică utilă pe regenerare: ~210 °dH*m³ (70 litri rășină × ~3.000 g echivalent CaCO3/l).

• Volum de apă tratată între două regenerări: 210 / 14 = 15 metri cubi (15.000 litri) de apă dedurizată.

• Consum de sare la o regenerare: ~7 - 8 kg de sare tabletiată.

Dacă aveți un consum mediu zilnic de 500 litri (0,5 m³/h), stația se va regenera o dată la aproximativ 30 de zile.

Oferta de pret

Black Sea Suppliers comercializează brandul Stillwater & Pratt ca importator oficial exclusiv în regim B2B (către firme de instalații, revânzători și proiectanți), prețurile exacte de listă nu sunt afișate public pe site-ul lor. Cu toate acestea, pe piața de retail din România, prețul standard pentru acest echipament este bine definit. [1]

Ofertarea estimativă pentru configurația dumneavoastră se prezintă astfel:

Subject: Cerere oferta HCS SANISHOP SRL

Bina ziua

Rog pret pt o statie de dedurizare:

DATE TEHNICE PENTRU CEREREA NOASTRA : Am un apartament cu urmatorii consumatori care pot fi simultani : dus A- 30 l/min ,dus B cu 12 l/min si bucatarie cu 12 l/min.Am un boiler de 300 l acm ,bransament de apa de Dn 32.Presiunea satatica din reteaua orasului Brasov este de 5-6 bari (necesita un regulator de presiune) .Ce statie de dedurizare ar trebui sa am pentru a deserve acesti consumatori care pot fi simultani.Mentionez ca am suficent loc de montaj in camera tehnica.

Pentru a deservi toți consumatorii simultan la parametrii optimi, aveți nevoie de o stație de dedurizare care să asigure un debit nominal de cel puțin 3,24 m³/h. Din gama oferită de Black Sea Suppliers, modelul ideal pentru cerințele dumneavoastră este Statie dedurizare simplex STILLWATER & PRATT – STP-S 70V CLACK, care oferă un debit de 4,2 m³/h. [1]

1. Calculul debitului simultan de vârf

• Duș 1: 30 l/min

• Duș 2: 12 l/min

• Bucătărie: 12 l/min

• Total: 54 l/min \(\times \) 60 min = 3.240 l/h (3,24 m³/h)

2. De ce modelul STP-S 70V CLACK?

• Componente de top: Vana de control CLACK (SUA) este recunoscută pentru fiabilitate ridicată și configurare volumetrică precisă. [1]

3. Recomandări tehnice pentru montaj în camera tehnică

• Regulatorul de presiune: Este obligatoriu. Presiunea statică de 5-6 bari din Brașov se află exact la limita maximă de lucru a stației (6 bar). Se recomandă montarea unui regulator de presiune robust pe racordul principal DN 32, reglat la o valoare de 3,5 - 4 bari, pentru a proteja atât dedurizatorul, cât și restul instalației (inclusiv boilerul). [1]

messages.subject: RE: RESTAURANT HESBURGER A1 STANGA DREAPTA
messages.body:
Buna ziua,

Va multumim pentru solicitarea dumneavoastra!

Conform discutiei telefonice, va transmitem si in scris ca apa conform buletinului trimis este potabila.

Am inteles de la dumneavoastra ca se doreste oricum o dedurizare totala la apa [ apa va fi utilizata pentru aparate de cafea, masini de spalat si alte electrocasnice, precum si in scop menajer]. In acest caz , recomandam urmatorul flux de tratare dimensionat sa poata furniza apa 24/24 cu un debit maxim de 4.8mc/h:

Un filtru de impuritati NW400 – cu purjare manuala [ acesta este montat preventiv pentru a preveni posibile impuritati sa ajunga in vanele dedurizatorului si sa il blocheze. - https://akro.ro/public/fise/282-Fisa_tehnica_Filtru_mecanic_sedimente_NW280-340-400.pdf

O statie de dedurizare duplex alternant cu vane clack de 1.25” – si 100L rasina pe fiecare coloana [ aceasta este dimensiunea minima de statie ca si gabarit ca sa puteti trata cu success debitul de 4.8mc/h] - https://akro.ro/public/fise/146-Fisa_tehnica_-_Statii_de_dedurizare_-_duplex,_1.25.pdf

Un sistem UV de 96 W – capabil sa trateze un debit de pana la 8 mc/h [ acest sistem este necesar pentru a distrug microbiologia ce se poate dezvolta in sistemul de tratare ] - https://www.spectra.ro/public/produse_files/viqua_dezinfectare-apa_spectra.pdf

Oferta anexata include livrarea produselor la beneficiar.

Montajul , asamblarea si PIF-ul nu sunt incluse!

Statia de mai sus, va produce o apa dedurizata si dezinfectata - cu un debit de 4.8mc/h - 24/24

In cazul in care se modifica debitul de tratat sau aveti alte informatii despre gabaritul statiilor necesare, va rog sa ne scrieti pentru o redimensionare.

Numai bine,

FISA TEHNICA
FILTRU IMPURITATI CU MEMBRANA FILTRANTA
NW500/650/800

Filtrele de impuritati NW 500/650/800 sunt fabricate din
materiale sintetice de cea mai buna calitate, cu o rezistenta marita, fiind
adecvate pentru aplicatiile din industria alimentara si pentru apa
potabila.
Componentele acestui filtru sunt:
- capacul (polipropilena armata);
- 2 manometre (20 bar, 1/4”);
- carcasa (transparenta, rezistenta la socuri: permite inspectia vizuala a
elementului filtrant si a depozitelor formate fara a deschide filtrul.
Carcasa se poate desface manual cu ajutorul kit-ului);
- cartus;
- membrana filtranta: fibra sintetica. Se recomanda inlocuirea
membranei la un interval de 3-6 luni sau ori de cate ori este nevoie in
functie de calitatea apei brute;
- robinet de purjare 3/4”;
- kit pentru desfacere carcasa.
Aceste filtre retin particulele solide aflate in suspensie (pamant,
nisip, rugina). Dispozitivul tip turbina imprima fluxului de apa un efect
de ciclon, antrenand impuritatile solide mai grele in partea de jos a
filtrului. Finetea de filtrare este data de tipul de membrana filtranta
aleasa: 1 µm, 5 µm, 10 µm, 25 µm (membrana standard cu care este
echipat filtrul), 50 µm, 100 µm, 150 µm (lavabil), 300 µm (lavabil).

Debitmetru electromagnetic PEM-1000

- diametru nominal: DN10....1000 (ANSI 0,5”...40”)
- Presiune maxima de functionare 16 bar, 25 bar sau 40 bar
- Precizie ±0,5% (optional ±0,2%)
- Iesire analogica: 4...20mA
- Interfata de comunicare: Modbus RTU / RS485
- Iesire in puls / frecventa (unidirectionala sau bidirectionala)

Utilizare

Debitmetru electromagnetic pentru masurarea bidirectionala a lichidelor cu conductivitate minima de 5µS:
- apa, ape uzate
- acizi, baze
- vopsele
- diverse substante vascoase etc.

Principiu de masurare:

Conform legii inductiei magnetice enuntate de Faraday o tensiune este indusa intr-un conductor aflat in miscare printr-un
camp magnetic. In cadrul principiului de masurare electromagnetic fluidul este conductorul in miscare. Tensiunea indusa
este proportionala cu viteza de curgere si este transmisa la un amplificator prin intermediul a doi electrozi de masura, iar
volumul vehiculat este calculat prin adaugarea in formula a ariei transversale a conductei.

Sistemul de masura

Sistemul de masura este alcatuit dintr-un traductor si un senzor.

Exista doua versiuni constructive:
varianta compacta PEM1000-ALW: Traductorul si senzorul formeaza un ansamblu mecanic
varianta modulara PEM1000-NW: Senzorul este montat separat de traductor

messages.subject: Solutie filtrare - turbiditate
messages.body:
Buna ziua Dl Barna,

Las anexata si propunerea minima de filtre - pentru a avea un randament cat de cat in retinerea turbiditatii din apa.

Pentru debitul de 10m3/h - am considerat o viteza de filtrare de <18m/h [ care in mod normal este o filtrare medie].

La aceasta viteza se reduce turbiditatea de la maxim 14-15 NTU la valori de 0-2NTU.

Sistemul este gandit in urmatoare configuratie:

Filtru grosier NW500 [ ca cel ce il punem mereu la dedurizatoare – dar cu un mesh mai grosier – 300 microni] - https://akro.ro/public/fise/132-Fisa_tehnica_Filtru_mecanic_sedimente_NW500-650-800.pdf

2 filtre cu cate 250L nisip + antracit – ce vor trebui montate in paralel - https://akro.ro/public/fise/188-Fisa_tehnica_-_Filtre_multimedia,_racord_1.5.pdf

Oferta include livrarea produselor la beneficiar.

Montajul si PIF-ul nu sunt incluse.

Termenul de livrare aprox 2-3 saptamani de la comanda ferma.

Cu respect,

messages.subject: RE: Statie clorinare Teisani8_reglaje
messages.body:
Ziua buna Dl Mihai,

Da , exista riscul ca acest lucru sa se repete – daca se va ocoli din nou instalatia de tratare existenta.

Problema majora pentru care sistemul a fost afectat in reglaje , a fost ca apa la nivelul bazinului a ajuns NETRATATA . [ furtunele , filtrul si toata camera de analiza a panoului k800 - erau pline de o roseala /mal ]. Malul a infundat trecerea apei si sistemul a intrat in avarie – lipsa apa.

Instalatia de clorinare lucreaza doar pe apa curata iar scopul acesteia este de a mentine apa la un anume nivel de clor.

Ca si elemente de verificat :

In bazinul de 6mc [ pe care se intampla recircularea ] – apa trebuie sa fie curata /limpede [ se vede acest lucru inclusiv pe furtunistica panoului]

Verificati debitul pe intrarea in analizor – [ exista un rotametru exact pe intrarea in analizor – debitul trebuie sa fie in jur de 60-70l/h] – verificati, dar NU REGLATI. Camera de masura – trebuie sa fie mereu plina cu apa .

Verificati vizual daca exista lichid pe furtunele pompei de dozare [ atat pe aspiratie cat si pe refulare] [ daca spre exemplu se omite sa se puna hipoclorit in bazinul din care trage – pompa are risc de dezamorsare si atunci lucreaza in gol/uscat] – risc de spargere membrana.

Sa se completeze periodic cu hipoclorit – consumul oricum nu va fi mare

Se verifica nivelul de clor afisat pe panoul k800 , si daca sistemul afiseaza vreo eroare

In rest statia lucreaza automat.

Numai bine,

Iti multumesc frumos pentru ajutor si sper ca nu te am suparat foarte mult.

Crezi ca exista posibilitatea sa se intample din nou aceasta situatie?

Daca inteleg cum trebuie a fost o problema de mentenanta mai mult decat o problema de echipament, intreb asta deoarece vreau sa vorbesc cu institutia sa inteleaga ca aceste interventii care pentru noi inseamna costuri sunt bonusuri din partea noastra si nu obligatii de garantie.

Statia a fost gasita cu urmatoarele probleme:

Pompa de recirculare apa – dezamorsata [ colegul a amorsat pompa ]

Filtrul de impuritati colmatat [ au fost probleme cu apa bruta care a livrat impuritati in sistem] Colegul a curatat intreg circuitul de apa si camera de analiza + cartusul la filtru.

S-au refacut setarile, s-a reglat debitul prin instalatie si s-a testat sistemul pe automat.

Totul este functional la acest moment!

Daniel,

Te rog sa ne spuna Alexandru Ionita tot istoricul, deoareceel.stie cat a functionat, de cate ori a venit tehnicul si de ce din aprilie.pana in prezent nu a fost chemat tehnicul. Eu in acest moment am o instalatie ce nu functioneaza iar persoana ce a venit la punerea in functiune pentru mine este si reprezentantul dumnevoastra.

Inca odata, va rog sa ma anuntati cand ve it sa fiu prezent sa facem hartiile cum trebuie.

Din punctul meu de vedere colegul vostru ce s a ocupat de aceasta situatie a fost informat ca nu functioneaza, fapt ce il putem dovedi.

Alexandru Ionita, de ce nu au fost anuntati de 4 luni.pana astazi, sau pe.cine am.anuntat?

Ce va poy.spune este ca clorul a cresxut foarte mult si.colegul vostru ne a spus sa il scoatem din priza, cel.putin asa stiu eu.

Aceasta instalatie trebuie sa functioneze si aveti obligatia sa veniti in locatie si sa il verificati, daca nu se preteaza pentru noi sa stim, astazi are.o alarma si nu.functioneaza.

messages.subject: RE: Filter cartridge - spare part SUFV4''
messages.body:
Hello Dear Kiriaki,

Thank you for the response!

I will explain bellow the actual water flux:

The client is a ceramic fabric from Alba Iulia;

In the end of the production process, they have some water baths where all the ceramic produced is washed and then dry – for final painting .

Small particles of clay remain in this water so the client made a sort of recirculation, where he installed 2 types of filters:

A coarse filtration – with a manual filter – at around 400microns

And SUFV 4” -standard.

On this loop- [ which is made on 4”] – they have around 35-40m3/h flow – and the pump is providing around 2.5-3 bar .

I initially recommended them a third filtration through filter bag [ which for sure will resolve their actual problem] – but they resumed only at this 2 stages- because they do not want consumables.

I also initially recommended them sand filters [ as this are best in retaining turbidity ] – but again they refused because this filters are consuming a lot of water during backwash.

Now the client asked me if we can provide a smaller filtration mesh for the SUFV 4” , because he said with the standard mesh – the water remains murky .

In this problem I will need to know what is the smallest mesh you can provide for a sufv4” [ that will fit into it and work properly with it] – and a cost as a spare part [ even if it is the standard 100 microns one].

With kind regards,

From: exports@drop.gr <exports@drop.gr>
Sent: Tuesday, September 1, 2026 3:44 PM
To: 'AKRO Romania , Alexandru Soare' <alexandru.soare@akro.ro>
Cc: 'Akro Filtrare' <office@akro.ro>; andrei.dobrei@akro.ro; 'Int.Sales@drop.gr' <intsales@drop.gr>
Subject: RE: Filter cartridge - spare part SUFV4''

Good day Dear Alexandru,

Apologies for the delayed response to your request. We have just returned from our summer holidays.

Kindly note that a 40–50 micron cartridge for the SUFV 4” filter is not available.

Could you please provide us with a brief description of the problem you are experiencing? In particular, do you have fine particles (<100 microns) passing through the screen?

It would also be helpful if you could provide us with a rough layout of the installation, together with a description of the problem you are facing, as well as the minimum/maximum flow rates filtrated and minimum/maximum working pressures.

This information will enable us to better understand your requirements and propose a solution that meets your current needs.

Thank you in advance for your cooperation.

Best regards

messages.subject: RE: Cartus filtrant
messages.body:
Buna ziua Dl Dorogan,
Am primit raspuns de la producatorul DROP, ca o varianta de cartus de filtrare mai fina la modelul SUFV 4" - nu este disponibila .

Acestia mi-au recomandat o filtrare suplimentara dupa acest filtru - din care mi-au recomandat:

- Filtrare cu discuri - de pana la 20 microni [ tot automate] - doar ca aceste sisteme se macina in timp si va trebui sa inlocuiti discurile periodic; [ Insa nu pot garanta pentru retinerea acelor particule de care discutati - in principiu cand vorbim de filtrare mecanica prin site/ fante - filtrarea este relativa la turbiditate/ mal sau particule usor deformabile;

Varianta recomandata - filtrare de profunzime:

- Cele mai potrivite ar fi filtrele cu nisip , insa pentru debit de 30-35mc/h ar fi nevoie de 3 filtre de 1000mm in diametru - vorbim de costuri de 25000 euro [ nu cred ca este fezabil nici din punct de vedere al costului si nici al spatiului]

- filtrare finala prin cartuse [ insa aceasta varianta mi se pare destul de inghesuita, daca sunt multe particule ] - risc mare de colmatare rapida data fiind suprafata mica de filtrare si este necesara inlocuirea cartuselor;

- filtrare prin saci - cred ca cea mai fezabila varianta - va fi nevoie de 2 carcase montate in paralel marimea 2 . [ sacii se inlocuiesc la colmatare - dar un sac costa in jur de 50-60 de lei]

In aceste conditii, va rog sa ne transmiteti daca doriti sa va prezentam o propunere comerciala din cele de mai sus prezentate.
Asteptam cu interes raspuns!
Numai bine,

Alexandru SOARE

messages.subject: Informare Proiect CAHUL
messages.body:
Buna ziua,

Avem detaliile despre dimensiunea pachetelor si cum se va desfasura din punct de vedere fiscal :

Raspuns producator:

“

Hi Alex,

Yes, the shipment data is correct as you have wrote them.

Canada - 40HC [ 12.2m x 2.44mx2.9m height] - Single container - October 1
USA - 3 pallets - LCL - October 29

They arrive on different dates so you will have to organize 2 pick ups.

You will receive 2 invoices from us.
For the accessories we'll create it early next week.
For the blocks most likely we will manage it around end of next week.

You will be able to clear the customs with them.

I hope I answered your questions.
In case you have any other remark, let me know.

Br.
David

“

Solicitarea mea:

“

Dear David,
Thank you for the information!
Since I do not have experience in maritime transport and it is not very clear to me how the products will arrive in Constanta, I would need a confirmation from your side to organize the subsequent transport to Moldova.
Please confirm the following:
Products from Canada:
- Delivered in a single container – 40HC [ 12.2m x 2.44mx2.9m height].

Products from the USA:
- Delivered palletized – 3 pallets – consolidated with other goods in a container [LCL].
The palletized cargo to be collected:
- 80x120x55cm – 375 kg
- 110x110x90cm – 181 kg
- 255x60x45cm – 161 kg
Therefore, we need to find a truck that can directly pick up the 40HC container around October 29, 2026, and a tautliner (curtain-side truck) for the 3 pallets, with an estimated loading date of October 1, 2026. Is this correct?

Also, please clarify one thing for me, as I am not familiar with this type of shipping. If the products arrive separately on different dates and vessels, shouldn't we have commercial invoices for each shipment? Otherwise, how can we clear the customs and export the goods further to Moldova?
Please assist me with this information so I can forward the instructions to my logistics colleagues.
Thank you!
BR,
Alex

“

FISA TEHNICA
FILTRU IMPURITATI CU MEMBRANA FILTRANTA
NW500/650/800

Filtrele de impuritati NW 500/650/800 sunt fabricate din
materiale sintetice de cea mai buna calitate, cu o rezistenta marita, fiind
adecvate pentru aplicatiile din industria alimentara si pentru apa
potabila.
Componentele acestui filtru sunt:
- capacul (polipropilena armata);
- 2 manometre (20 bar, 1/4”);
- carcasa (transparenta, rezistenta la socuri: permite inspectia vizuala a
elementului filtrant si a depozitelor formate fara a deschide filtrul.
Carcasa se poate desface manual cu ajutorul kit-ului);
- cartus;
- membrana filtranta: fibra sintetica. Se recomanda inlocuirea
membranei la un interval de 3-6 luni sau ori de cate ori este nevoie in
functie de calitatea apei brute;
- robinet de purjare 3/4”;
- kit pentru desfacere carcasa.
Aceste filtre retin particulele solide aflate in suspensie (pamant,
nisip, rugina). Dispozitivul tip turbina imprima fluxului de apa un efect
de ciclon, antrenand impuritatile solide mai grele in partea de jos a
filtrului. Finetea de filtrare este data de tipul de membrana filtranta
aleasa: 1 µm, 5 µm, 10 µm, 25 µm (membrana standard cu care este
echipat filtrul), 50 µm, 100 µm, 150 µm (lavabil), 300 µm (lavabil).

attachments.text:
Debitmetru electromagnetic PEM-1000

- diametru nominal: DN10....1000 (ANSI 0,5”...40”)
- Presiune maxima de functionare 16 bar, 25 bar sau 40 bar
- Precizie ±0,5% (optional ±0,2%)
- Iesire analogica: 4...20mA
- Interfata de comunicare: Modbus RTU / RS485
- Iesire in puls / frecventa (unidirectionala sau bidirectionala)

Utilizare

Debitmetru electromagnetic pentru masurarea bidirectionala a lichidelor cu conductivitate minima de 5µS:
- apa, ape uzate
- acizi, baze
- vopsele
- diverse substante vascoase etc.

Principiu de masurare:

Conform legii inductiei magnetice enuntate de Faraday o tensiune este indusa intr-un conductor aflat in miscare printr-un
camp magnetic. In cadrul principiului de masurare electromagnetic fluidul este conductorul in miscare. Tensiunea indusa
este proportionala cu viteza de curgere si este transmisa la un amplificator prin intermediul a doi electrozi de masura, iar
volumul vehiculat este calculat prin adaugarea in formula a ariei transversale a conductei.

Sistemul de masura

Sistemul de masura este alcatuit dintr-un traductor si un senzor.

Exista doua versiuni constructive:
varianta compacta PEM1000-ALW: Traductorul si senzorul formeaza un ansamblu mecanic
varianta modulara PEM1000-NW: Senzorul este montat separat de traductor

-

I will keep you informed [ please announce me what to do with the delivered board – which at this moment is mounted in the ozone generator].
